text: Case Study -A company is building a web-based AI application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company needs to use the central model registry to manage different versions of models in the application. Which action will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model.
choices.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version.
choices.C: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models.
choices.D: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to use the central model registry to manage different versions of models in the application. Which action will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, central model registry, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker Model Registry organizes successive versions of a model into a model group and records their metadata and approval state.

A. Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model. — An ECR repository stores container images. A separate repository per model does not supply model-package versioning, evaluation metadata, or approval workflows.

B. Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version. — ECR tags identify container images, not the complete model lifecycle record. The team would need to build the missing model-registry behavior.

C. Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models. — Registering model versions in a model group uses the registry's native versioning and lifecycle management without a custom catalog.

D. Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version. — Tags can add searchable metadata, but they do not replace the model group's native version relationship. A custom tag-based version convention adds work.

notes: Model groups provide native model version cataloging.

text: Case Study -A company is building a web-based AI application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company is experimenting with consecutive training jobs. How can the company MINIMIZE infrastructure startup times for these jobs?

choices.A: Use Managed Spot Training.
choices.B: Use SageMaker managed warm pools.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Training Compiler.
choices.D: Use the SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) library.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company is experimenting with consecutive training jobs. How can the company MINIMIZE infrastructure startup times for these jobs?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MINIMIZE infrastructure startup times for these jobs, central model registry, consecutive training jobs, MINIMIZE
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker managed warm pools retain provisioned training infrastructure for reuse by compatible subsequent jobs, reducing repeated infrastructure startup time.

A. Use Managed Spot Training. — Managed Spot Training targets compute cost and may wait for or lose Spot capacity. It does not preserve an immediately reusable warm training environment.

B. Use SageMaker managed warm pools. — Warm pools reuse the retained instances for matching jobs within the keep-alive period, avoiding repeated infrastructure provisioning between consecutive experiments. Retained capacity remains billable.

C. Use SageMaker Training Compiler. — Training Compiler optimizes supported model computation during training. It does not retain infrastructure between jobs or remove the provisioning stage.

D. Use the SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) library. — SMDDP distributes training computation across workers. It targets training throughput rather than the infrastructure startup delay before a job begins.
notes: Managed warm pools and the startup-latency requirement have been checked against the AWS warm-pool documentation.

text: Case Study -A company is building a web-based AI application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company must implement a manual approval-based workflow to ensure that only approved models can be deployed to production endpoints. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Experiments to facilitate the approval process during model registration.
choices.B: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking on the central model registry. Create tracking entities for the approval process.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Model Monitor to evaluate the performance of the model and to manage the approval.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Pipelines. When a model version is registered, use the AWS SDK to change the approval status to "Approved."

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must implement a manual approval-based workflow to ensure that only approved models can be deployed to production endpoints. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: manual approval, central model registry
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A manual deployment gate registers a model as PendingManualApproval and changes its registry status only after an authorized reviewer approves it.

A. Use SageMaker Experiments to facilitate the approval process during model registration. — Experiments organizes training runs and comparisons. It does not itself enforce a model-package approval gate for production deployment.

B. Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking on the central model registry. Create tracking entities for the approval process. — Lineage tracks relationships among data, jobs, and artifacts. Recording approval-related entities does not enforce the deployment decision.

C. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to evaluate the performance of the model and to manage the approval. — Model Monitor detects quality or drift issues. It does not manage the registry's manual approval transition.

D. Use SageMaker Pipelines. When a model version is registered, use the AWS SDK to change the approval status to "Approved." — Pipelines and the registry can support the gate when a reviewer uses the SDK to mark the registered version Approved and deployment checks that status. Automatically approving every registration would defeat the manual-review requirement.

notes: The SDK approval update must follow an authorized human decision; automatically approving every registration does not implement manual approval.

text: Case Study -A company is building a web-based AI application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company needs to run an on-demand workflow to monitor bias drift for models that are deployed to real-time endpoints from the application. Which action will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Configure the application to invoke an AWS Lambda function that runs a SageMaker Clarify job.
choices.B: Invoke an AWS Lambda function to pull the sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer built-in SageMaker image.
choices.C: Use AWS Glue Data Quality to monitor bias.
choices.D: Use SageMaker notebooks to compare the bias.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to run an on-demand workflow to monitor bias drift for models that are deployed to real-time endpoints from the application. Which action will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time, bias drift, central model registry
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Bias monitoring compares configured bias metrics on current data with a reference baseline; an application can submit an on-demand Clarify processing job.

A. Configure the application to invoke an AWS Lambda function that runs a SageMaker Clarify job. — Lambda can start the Clarify job and return while managed processing runs. The job needs appropriate facets, labels or predictions, and a baseline to evaluate drift; Clarify is no longer open to new customers.

B. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to pull the sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer built-in SageMaker image. — Pulling the model-monitor-analyzer image is not a bias-analysis workflow, and that analyzer primarily supplies data-quality statistics and constraints.

C. Use AWS Glue Data Quality to monitor bias. — Glue Data Quality checks dataset quality rules. It does not directly calculate the model fairness metrics and baseline comparisons supplied by Clarify.

D. Use SageMaker notebooks to compare the bias. — A notebook can run custom comparisons, but requires interactive or separately automated code execution rather than a simple application-triggered managed job.
notes: On-demand bias analysis requires configured facets and a comparison baseline. Clarify is no longer open to new customers; existing customers can continue to use it.
Service availability: SageMaker Clarify is closed to new customers; existing customers can continue using it. This answer describes its documented capabilities.

text: Case study -An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model on AWS. The training dataset includes transaction logs, customer profiles, and tables from an on-premises MySQL database. The transaction logs and customer profiles are stored in Amazon S3. The dataset has a class imbalance that affects the learning of the model's algorithm. Additionally, many of the features have interdependencies. The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data. Which AWS service or feature can aggregate the data from the various data sources?

choices.A: Amazon EMR Spark jobs
choices.B: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
choices.C: Amazon DynamoDB
choices.D: AWS Lake Formation

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data. Which AWS service or feature can aggregate the data from the various data sources?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: class imbalance
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Lake Formation can coordinate a governed data lake and ingestion workflows, while Spark can also combine S3 and JDBC data. The question does not state a constraint that uniquely excludes either approach.

A. Amazon EMR Spark jobs — Spark jobs on EMR can read S3 and an accessible MySQL JDBC source and join their records. More cluster configuration does not make this technically invalid when the prompt only asks what can aggregate the data.

B. Amazon Kinesis Data Streams — Kinesis Data Streams ingests event records. It does not by itself extract and join the existing S3 datasets and on-premises database tables.

C. Amazon DynamoDB — DynamoDB stores key-value and document data. It does not automatically aggregate the heterogeneous existing sources into a training dataset.

D. AWS Lake Formation — Lake Formation's Glue-backed ingestion workflows can bring database data into a governed S3 lake. This supports the source's intended answer, but the wording also permits the Spark alternative, so the key is not finalized.

notes: Both EMR Spark and Lake Formation ingestion workflows can combine the stated sources. The prompt does not provide a constraint that uniquely excludes Spark.

explanation:
Key Concept: Data Wrangler offers anomaly-detection analysis together with visual inspection in the data-preparation workflow.

C. Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to automatically detect the anomalies and to visualize the result. — Data Wrangler's anomaly-detection visualization can identify unusual records and display their distribution without building a separate detector and dashboard pipeline.

D. Use AWS Batch to automatically detect the anomalies. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the result. — Batch schedules compute jobs but contains no built-in detector for this dataset. The team would need to implement the analysis and integrate its output with QuickSight.

Additionally, many of the features have interdependencies. The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data. The training dataset includes categorical data and numerical data. The ML engineer must prepare the training dataset to maximize the accuracy of the model. Which action will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Use AWS Glue to transform the categorical data into numerical data.
choices.B: Use AWS Glue to transform the numerical data into categorical data.
choices.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to transform the categorical data into numerical data.
choices.D: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to transform the numerical data into categorical data.

explanation:
Key Concept: Categorical features often need an appropriate numeric encoding before they can be consumed by the chosen ML algorithm.

A. Use AWS Glue to transform the categorical data into numerical data. — Glue can encode categories, but configuring an ETL transformation requires more work than selecting the relevant built-in Data Wrangler transform for this preparation task.

B. Use AWS Glue to transform the numerical data into categorical data. — Discretizing numeric values can be useful in some models, but it does not encode the existing categorical features and can discard useful numeric detail.

C. Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to transform the categorical data into numerical data. — Data Wrangler provides categorical-encoding transforms through a visual flow, reducing custom preparation work. Choose the encoding based on cardinality and whether the categories have a meaningful order.

D. Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to transform the numerical data into categorical data. — Changing numeric features into categories does not address the unencoded categorical inputs. Such binning needs a separate modeling justification rather than being a general accuracy improvement.
notes: Data Wrangler supplies built-in categorical encoding operations. Encoding suitability depends on the selected algorithm and feature.

explanation:
Key Concept: Gradient-boosted decision trees capture nonlinear relationships and feature interactions in labeled tabular data.

A. LightGBM — LightGBM builds an ensemble of trees that can represent the interdependent fraud signals the current model misses. Class imbalance still needs appropriate weighting, resampling, or evaluation choices.

B. Linear learner — A linear learner cannot directly express complex interactions unless suitable interaction features are engineered first, making it less suitable for the described missing nonlinear patterns.

C. К-means clustering — K-means forms unlabeled clusters. It does not directly learn the known fraud outcome or optimize supervised fraud detection.

D. Neural Topic Model (NTM) — NTM discovers topics in document representations. It is not the appropriate classifier for the combined transaction and customer table.
notes: LightGBM captures nonlinear interactions in tabular data.

text: A company has deployed an XGBoost prediction model in production to predict if a customer is likely to cancel a subscription. The company uses Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect deviations in the F1 score. During a baseline analysis of model quality, the company recorded a threshold for the F1 score. After several months of no change, the model's F1 score decreases significantly. What could be the reason for the reduced F1 score?

choices.A: Concept drift occurred in the underlying customer data that was used for predictions.
choices.B: The model was not sufficiently complex to capture all the patterns in the original baseline data.
choices.C: The original baseline data had a data quality issue of missing values.
choices.D: Incorrect ground truth labels were provided to Model Monitor during the calculation of the baseline.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: After several months of no change, the model's F1 score decreases significantly. What could be the reason for the reduced F1 score?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Concept drift changes the relationship between input features and the target, so a previously effective model may lose predictive quality over time.

A. Concept drift occurred in the underlying customer data that was used for predictions. — A change in how current customer behavior relates to cancellation can reduce F1 after a stable period. The metric drop is consistent with concept drift, though it should trigger investigation rather than be treated as proof of one cause.

B. The model was not sufficiently complex to capture all the patterns in the original baseline data. — Insufficient complexity would generally affect the original evaluation too. It does not explain a new decline after months of stable quality as directly as a changed data-to-target relationship.

C. The original baseline data had a data quality issue of missing values. — Missing values in the original baseline would already have influenced the initial evaluation. The scenario describes a later change rather than an identified original data defect.

D. Incorrect ground truth labels were provided to Model Monitor during the calculation of the baseline. — Incorrect baseline labels could make the reference misleading, but no such error is reported. A later performance decline on changing customer data makes drift the stronger listed explanation.

text: A company has a team of data scientists who use Amazon SageMaker notebook instances to test ML models. When the data scientists need new permissions, the company attaches the permissions to each individual role that was created during the creation of the SageMaker notebook instance. The company needs to centralize management of the team's permissions. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Create a single IAM role that has the necessary permissions. Attach the role to each notebook instance that the team uses.
choices.B: Create a single IAM group. Add the data scientists to the group. Associate the group with each notebook instance that the team uses.
choices.C: Create a single IAM user. Attach the AdministratorAccess AWS managed IAM policy to the user. Configure each notebook instance to use the IAM user.
choices.D: Create a single IAM group. Add the data scientists to the group. Create an IAM role. Attach the AdministratorAccess AWS managed IAM policy to the role. Associate the role with the group. Associate the group with each notebook instance that the team uses.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to centralize management of the team's permissions. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A SageMaker notebook uses an execution role for AWS API permissions. Reusing a suitably scoped role centralizes updates across notebooks that need the same access.

A. Create a single IAM role that has the necessary permissions. Attach the role to each notebook instance that the team uses. — Attaching one shared execution role to the team's notebooks lets the company update the relevant permissions in one place, provided those notebooks should have the same access scope.

B. Create a single IAM group. Add the data scientists to the group. Associate the group with each notebook instance that the team uses. — IAM groups contain users and receive identity policies, but a notebook cannot use a group as its execution role.

C. Create a single IAM user. Attach the AdministratorAccess AWS managed IAM policy to the user. Configure each notebook instance to use the IAM user. — A notebook should use temporary role credentials, not a shared IAM user's credentials. AdministratorAccess also grants far more permissions than the stated task requires.

D. Create a single IAM group. Add the data scientists to the group. Create an IAM role. Attach the AdministratorAccess AWS managed IAM policy to the role. Associate the role with the group. Associate the group with each notebook instance that the team uses. — Roles cannot be associated with groups as notebook execution identities in the proposed way. The broad administrator policy does not solve the unsupported identity arrangement.
notes: Notebook execution permissions can be centralized through a shared role when all notebooks need the same scope.

text: An ML engineer needs to use an ML model to predict the price of apartments in a specific location. Which metric should the ML engineer use to evaluate the model's performance?

choices.A: Accuracy
choices.B: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)
choices.C: F1 score
choices.D: Mean absolute error (MAE)

hint:

explanation:
Key Concept: Apartment-price prediction is regression, so evaluation should measure the difference between predicted and observed numeric prices.

A. Accuracy — Accuracy counts correctly classified categories. It is not the standard metric for continuous price errors.

B. Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) — ROC AUC evaluates classification ranking across thresholds, not the magnitude of a numeric price prediction error.

C. F1 score — F1 combines classification precision and recall. Apartment prices are continuous targets rather than positive and negative labels.

D. Mean absolute error (MAE) — MAE averages absolute price errors and expresses the typical error in the same currency units as the target, making it directly interpretable.

notes: MAE is a regression metric in the target units.

text: An ML engineer has trained a neural network by using stochastic gradient descent (SGD). The neural network performs poorly on the test set. The values for training loss and validation loss remain high and show an oscillating pattern. The values decrease for a few epochs and then increase for a few epochs before repeating the same cycle. What should the ML engineer do to improve the training process?

choices.A: Introduce early stopping.
choices.B: Increase the size of the test set.
choices.C: Increase the learning rate.
choices.D: Decrease the learning rate.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The values decrease for a few epochs and then increase for a few epochs before repeating the same cycle. What should the ML engineer do to improve the training process?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: An excessively large SGD learning rate can repeatedly overshoot useful parameter values, causing high, oscillating training and validation losses.

A. Introduce early stopping. — Early stopping can prevent later overfitting, but does not fix a training process that remains unstable and poorly fitted throughout the observed cycles.

B. Increase the size of the test set. — A larger test set improves evaluation precision but does not change the optimizer or its training behavior.

C. Increase the learning rate. — Increasing the learning rate makes parameter updates larger and can worsen the suspected overshooting.

D. Decrease the learning rate. — Reducing the learning rate makes SGD updates smaller and can stabilize convergence. If oscillation persists, investigate scaling, batch noise, and other optimization issues as well.

analysis.keyConcept: An excessively large SGD learning rate can repeatedly overshoot useful parameter values, causing high, oscillating training and validation losses.

options.A: Early stopping can prevent later overfitting, but does not fix a training process that remains unstable and poorly fitted throughout the observed cycles.
options.B: A larger test set improves evaluation precision but does not change the optimizer or its training behavior.
options.C: Increasing the learning rate makes parameter updates larger and can worsen the suspected overshooting.
options.D: Reducing the learning rate makes SGD updates smaller and can stabilize convergence. If oscillation persists, investigate scaling, batch noise, and other optimization issues as well.

text: An ML engineer needs to process thousands of existing CSV objects and new CSV objects that are uploaded. The CSV objects are stored in a central Amazon S3 bucket and have the same number of columns. One of the columns is a transaction date. The ML engineer must query the data based on the transaction date. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Use an Amazon Athena CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) statement to create a table based on the transaction date from data in the central S3 bucket. Query the objects from the table.
choices.B: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data. Set up S3 replication from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Object Lambda to query the objects based on transaction date.
choices.C: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data. Use AWS Glue for Apache Spark to create a job to query the CSV objects based on transaction date. Configure the job to store the results in the new S3 bucket. Query the objects from the new S3 bucket.
choices.D: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to transfer the data from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket. Configure Firehose to run an AWS Lambda function to query the data based on transaction date.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must query the data based on the transaction date. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Athena CTAS can transform and partition existing S3 data for date-based queries, but a CTAS result is not automatically refreshed when new source objects arrive.

A. Use an Amazon Athena CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) statement to create a table based on the transaction date from data in the central S3 bucket. Query the objects from the table. — CTAS is a low-overhead way to build a date-partitioned table from the existing CSVs. The solution is incomplete for ongoing arrivals unless it adds incremental INSERT INTO or an equivalent refresh process.

B. Create a new S3 bucket for processed data. Set up S3 replication from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Object Lambda to query the objects based on transaction date. — S3 replication copies objects without creating a date-query engine. Object Lambda transforms individual object reads and does not provide the proposed cross-object SQL query workflow.

C. Create a new S3 bucket for processed data. Use AWS Glue for Apache Spark to create a job to query the CSV objects based on transaction date. Configure the job to store the results in the new S3 bucket. Query the objects from the new S3 bucket. — A Glue Spark job can process the existing and newly selected objects, but needs job scheduling and incremental-selection logic. It has more configuration than Athena SQL for the initial transformation.

D. Create a new S3 bucket for processed data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to transfer the data from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket. Configure Firehose to run an AWS Lambda function to query the data based on transaction date. — Firehose does not automatically read historical CSV objects from an S3 bucket as its stream source. Lambda record transformation is not a substitute for the requested date-query table.

text: A company has a large, unstructured dataset. The dataset includes many duplicate records across several key attributes. Which solution on AWS will detect duplicates in the dataset with the LEAST code development?

choices.B: Use Amazon QuickSight ML Insights to build a custom deduplication model.
choices.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to pre-process and detect duplicates.
choices.D: Use the AWS Glue FindMatches transform to detect duplicates.

explanation:
Key Concept: Glue FindMatches performs learned record matching across attributes, including cases where equivalent entities are represented by slightly different values.

A. Use Amazon Mechanical Turk jobs to detect duplicates. — A human-labeling workforce does not provide an efficient automated deduplication pipeline for a large existing dataset.

B. Use Amazon QuickSight ML Insights to build a custom deduplication model. — QuickSight ML Insights targets analytical insights such as anomalies and forecasts, not training a general entity-deduplication model.

C. Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to pre-process and detect duplicates. — Data Wrangler can remove exact duplicate rows after preparation. It is a valid simpler choice for exact duplicates, but does not supply the same learned fuzzy entity-matching workflow as FindMatches.

D. Use the AWS Glue FindMatches transform to detect duplicates. — FindMatches uses labeled match examples and multiple attributes to detect records describing the same entity with little custom matching code. If the question means exact duplicates only, the Data Wrangler alternative is also plausible.
notes: FindMatches fits fuzzy entity resolution, but Data Wrangler can remove exact duplicates. The question does not specify which type of duplication is present.

text: A company needs to run a batch data-processing job on Amazon EC2 instances. The job will run during the weekend and will take 90 minutes to finish running. The processing can handle interruptions. The company will run the job every weekend for the next 6 months. Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

choices.C: On-Demand Instances
choices.D: Dedicated Instances

explanation:
Key Concept: Spot capacity is suited to short, retryable batch workloads that can tolerate interruption and flexible completion times.

A. Spot Instances — The weekend job can recover from interruption, so Spot discounts reduce compute cost without requiring a long-term commitment for mostly idle capacity.

B. Reserved Instances — Reserved Instances require a longer commitment and are poorly matched to only 90 minutes of usage each week for six months.

C. On-Demand Instances — On-Demand avoids commitment and interruption risk, but costs more than available Spot capacity for the same interruption-tolerant work.

D. Dedicated Instances — Dedicated Instances pay for hardware isolation, a requirement not present here, and do not provide the most economical batch option.

text: An ML engineer has an Amazon Comprehend custom model in Account A in the us-east-1 Region. The ML engineer needs to copy the model to Account В in the same Region. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

choices.A: Use Amazon S3 to make a copy of the model. Transfer the copy to Account B.
choices.B: Create a resource-based IAM policy. Use the Amazon Comprehend ImportModel API operation to copy the model to Account B.
choices.C: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the model from Account A to Account B.
choices.D: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between Account A and Account В to transfer the model.

explanation:
Key Concept: Comprehend supports importing a custom model from another account in the same Region when the source model has an authorizing resource policy.

A. Use Amazon S3 to make a copy of the model. Transfer the copy to Account B. — A managed Comprehend model is not copied into another account simply by duplicating arbitrary S3 objects. The service provides a model-import operation.

B. Create a resource-based IAM policy. Use the Amazon Comprehend ImportModel API operation to copy the model to Account B. — The source account grants ImportModel permission through the model's resource policy, and the destination account imports the source model ARN in the same Region.

D. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between Account A and Account В to transfer the model. — A VPN provides network connectivity, not authorization or a model-copy operation. The managed ImportModel API does not require an account-to-account VPN.
notes: Cross-account import requires a resource policy on the source custom model and matching Regions.

text: An ML engineer is training a simple neural network model. The ML engineer tracks the performance of the model over time on a validation dataset. The model's performance improves substantially at first and then degrades after a specific number of epochs. Which solutions will mitigate this problem? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Enable early stopping on the model.
choices.B: Increase dropout in the layers.
choices.C: Increase the number of layers.
choices.D: Increase the number of neurons.
choices.E: Investigate and reduce the sources of model bias.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which solutions will mitigate this problem? (Choose two.)

explanation:
Key Concept: Validation performance that improves and then degrades suggests overfitting after the useful training phase.

A. Enable early stopping on the model. — Early stopping selects or restores a checkpoint from before validation performance deteriorates, avoiding unnecessary overfitting epochs.

B. Increase dropout in the layers. — Increasing dropout adds regularization and reduces reliance on particular internal units, which can improve generalization when tuned appropriately.

C. Increase the number of layers. — More layers increase capacity and can worsen the tendency to overfit the training data.

D. Increase the number of neurons. — More neurons also increase capacity rather than directly controlling the observed late-training overfitting.

E. Investigate and reduce the sources of model bias. — Reducing high bias is a remedy for underfitting. The improvement followed by validation deterioration points more directly to excessive fitting and variance.

text: A company wants to predict the success of advertising campaigns by considering the color scheme of each advertisement. An ML engineer is preparing data for a neural network model. The dataset includes color information as categorical data. Which technique for feature engineering should the ML engineer use for the model?

choices.A: Apply label encoding to the color categories. Automatically assign each color a unique integer.
choices.B: Implement padding to ensure that all color feature vectors have the same length.
choices.C: Perform dimensionality reduction on the color categories.
choices.D: One-hot encode the color categories to transform the color scheme feature into a binary matrix.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The dataset includes color information as categorical data. Which technique for feature engineering should the ML engineer use for the model?

explanation:
Key Concept: Nominal categories such as color names have no inherent numeric order, so their encoding should not introduce a false ordering.

A. Apply label encoding to the color categories. Automatically assign each color a unique integer. — Arbitrary integer labels suggest numeric distances or order between colors when fed directly into the network as scalar values.

B. Implement padding to ensure that all color feature vectors have the same length. — Padding makes sequence or vector lengths consistent. It does not define a meaningful representation of the color categories.

C. Perform dimensionality reduction on the color categories. — Dimensionality reduction requires an existing numeric representation and does not itself encode the categorical color values.

D. One-hot encode the color categories to transform the color scheme feature into a binary matrix. — One-hot encoding gives each color a separate binary indicator, representing category membership without imposing an ordinal relationship.
notes: One-hot encoding avoids an artificial order among nominal color categories.

explanation:
Key Concept: Macie discovers sensitive information in S3 objects; a separate remediation workflow must remove or replace the affected content before the model uses it.

A. Deploy the model on Amazon SageMaker. Create a set of AWS Lambda functions to identify and remove the sensitive data. — Moving the model to SageMaker does not solve sensitive-data discovery and adds a migration unrelated to cleaning the existing S3 data.

B. Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate. Create an AWS Batch job to identify and remove the sensitive data. — Migrating to ECS and operating a Batch redaction job adds infrastructure without providing a built-in sensitive-data discovery service.

Create a set of AWS Lambda functions to remove the sensitive data. — Macie supplies S3-sensitive-data findings, and Lambda can orchestrate a validated redaction or quarantine workflow. D. Use Amazon Comprehend to identify the sensitive data. Launch Amazon EC2 instances to remove the sensitive data. — Comprehend can detect supported PII in text, but managing EC2 instances for removal adds operational work compared with the proposed serverless S3 discovery and remediation workflow.

text: A company that has hundreds of data scientists is using Amazon SageMaker to create ML models. The models are in model groups in the SageMaker Model Registry. The data scientists are grouped into three categories: computer vision, natural language processing (NLP), and speech recognition. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to organize the existing models into these groups to improve model discoverability at scale. The solution must not affect the integrity of the model artifacts and their existing groupings. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a custom tag for each of the three categories. Add the tags to the model packages in the SageMaker Model Registry.
choices.B: Create a model group for each category. Move the existing models into these category model groups.
choices.C: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking to automatically identify and tag which model groups should contain the models.
choices.D: Create a Model Registry collection for each of the three categories. Move the existing model groups into the collections.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution must not affect the integrity of the model artifacts and their existing groupings. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: Model Registry collections organize existing model groups into a discoverable hierarchy without changing their model versions or underlying artifacts.

A. Create a custom tag for each of the three categories. Add the tags to the model packages in the SageMaker Model Registry. — Tags help filtering, but a collection provides the native category hierarchy and group-level organization requested at this scale.

B. Create a model group for each category. Move the existing models into these category model groups. — Moving model versions into new category model groups changes the existing version groupings that the requirement says to preserve.

C. Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking to automatically identify and tag which model groups should contain the models. — Lineage tracks relationships among artifacts and executions. It does not automatically infer and reorganize the requested business categories.

D. Create a Model Registry collection for each of the three categories. Move the existing model groups into the collections. — Creating CV, NLP, and speech collections and adding the existing model groups supplies the category structure while preserving each group's models and artifacts.
notes: Collections organize existing model groups without changing their underlying artifacts.

text: A company runs an Amazon SageMaker domain in a public subnet of a newly created VPC. The network is configured properly, and ML engineers can access the SageMaker domain. Recently, the company discovered suspicious traffic to the domain from a specific IP address. The company needs to block traffic from the specific IP address. Which update to the network configuration will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the security group to the domain.
choices.B: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the rule to the default network Ad for the subnet where the domain is located.
choices.C: Create a shadow variant for the domain. Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send traffic from the specific IP address to the shadow endpoint.
choices.D: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the route table to the domain.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to block traffic from the specific IP address. Which update to the network configuration will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Network ACLs support explicit IP-deny rules for traffic crossing their associated subnets, but Studio browser access may use a service-managed path outside that boundary.

A. Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the security group to the domain. — Security groups contain allow rules rather than explicit deny rules, so the proposed single-IP deny rule cannot be created there.

B. Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the rule to the default network Ad for the subnet where the domain is located. — A subnet ACL can deny the source IP for traffic that actually traverses that subnet. The domain's public access path is unspecified, so this cannot be assumed to block all browser access to a service-managed Studio endpoint.

C. Create a shadow variant for the domain. Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send traffic from the specific IP address to the shadow endpoint. — Shadow variants and Inference Recommender apply to model serving and testing, not network access control for a Studio domain.

D. Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the route table to the domain. — Route tables choose next hops for destination networks. They do not implement the proposed source-IP inbound deny policy.
notes: Đáp án theo nguồn, chưa được kiểm chứng AWS trong lần gộp này.
Q161 lặp Q25; Q25 có lỗi chữ 'network Ad' thay cho 'network ACL'. Giữ nguyên bản gốc trong hồ sơ nguồn.
A subnet ACL blocks only traffic crossing that subnet. The prompt does not establish that public Studio access uses that path, and PublicInternetOnly uses a SageMaker-managed VPC for non-EFS traffic.

text: A company is gathering audio, video, and text data in various languages. The company needs to use a large language model (LLM) to summarize the gathered data that is in Spanish. Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST amount of time?

choices.B: Use Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Translate to convert the data into English text. Use Amazon Bedrock with the Jurassic model to summarize the text.
choices.C: Use Amazon Rekognition and Amazon Translate to convert the data into English text. Use Amazon Bedrock with the Anthropic Claude model to summarize the text.
choices.D: Use Amazon Comprehend and Amazon Translate to convert the data into English text. Use Amazon Bedrock with the Stable Diffusion model to summarize the text.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to use a large language model (LLM) to summarize the gathered data that is in Spanish. Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST amount of time?

explanation:
Key Concept: A managed transcription, translation, and text-summarization pipeline avoids training several custom models. The specific foundation model in this older question must be checked for current availability.

A. Train and deploy a model in Amazon SageMaker to convert the data into English text. Train and deploy an LLM in SageMaker to summarize the text. — Training conversion and summarization models from scratch requires substantial datasets, training, and deployment work before the company can process its content.

B. Use Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Translate to convert the data into English text. Use Amazon Bedrock with the Jurassic model to summarize the text. — Transcribe can convert supported Spanish audio, including extracted video audio, to text; Translate can produce English text for summarization by a supported text LLM. The Jurassic model reference is historical and should not be assumed available for a new deployment.

C. Use Amazon Rekognition and Amazon Translate to convert the data into English text. Use Amazon Bedrock with the Anthropic Claude model to summarize the text. — Rekognition analyzes visual content but does not replace speech transcription of the audio recordings. A capable summarizer does not fix the missing audio-to-text stage.

D. Use Amazon Comprehend and Amazon Translate to convert the data into English text. Use Amazon Bedrock with the Stable Diffusion model to summarize the text. — Comprehend does not transcribe speech, and Stable Diffusion generates images rather than serving as the requested text-summary model.
notes: Source selects B. The architecture can summarize transcribed Spanish speech after translation, but does not extract arbitrary visual video content. The exact Jurassic model and its current availability are unspecified; use a supported text model for a current implementation.

text: A financial company receives a high volume of real-time market data streams from an external provider. The streams consist of thousands of JSON records every second. The company needs to implement a scalable solution on AWS to identify anomalous data points. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Ingest real-time data into Amazon Kinesis data streams. Use the built-in RANDOM_CUT_FOREST function in Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data streams and to detect data anomalies.
choices.B: Ingest real-time data into Amazon Kinesis data streams. Deploy an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time outlier detection. Create an AWS Lambda function to detect anomalies. Use the data streams to invoke the Lambda function.
choices.C: Ingest real-time data into Apache Kafka on Amazon EC2 instances. Deploy an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time outlier detection. Create an AWS Lambda function to detect anomalies. Use the data streams to invoke the Lambda function.
choices.D: Send real-time data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the queue messages. Program the Lambda function to start an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job for batch processing and anomaly detection.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to implement a scalable solution on AWS to identify anomalous data points. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, real-time, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: The named RANDOM_CUT_FOREST SQL function belongs to the older Kinesis SQL engine. Managed Flink can run RCF code, but that requires an explicit implementation or integration.

A. Ingest real-time data into Amazon Kinesis data streams. Use the built-in RANDOM_CUT_FOREST function in Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data streams and to detect data anomalies. — The source incorrectly treats the legacy Kinesis SQL function as a built-in Flink function. A Flink RCF library or custom function can work, but is not the zero-code operation described.

B. Ingest real-time data into Amazon Kinesis data streams. Deploy an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time outlier detection. Create an AWS Lambda function to detect anomalies. Use the data streams to invoke the Lambda function. — Kinesis Data Streams can trigger Lambda, which can invoke a hosted anomaly model. This is a supported managed ingestion and scoring architecture once the endpoint and event-source mapping are configured.

C. Ingest real-time data into Apache Kafka on Amazon EC2 instances. Deploy an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time outlier detection. Create an AWS Lambda function to detect anomalies. Use the data streams to invoke the Lambda function. — Self-managed Kafka brokers on EC2 add cluster operations while providing no required advantage over the managed Kinesis ingestion path.

D. Send real-time data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the queue messages. Program the Lambda function to start an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job for batch processing and anomaly detection. — Starting Glue batch jobs from queue messages introduces startup and batch-processing delay rather than continuous low-latency anomaly scoring.

text: A company has a large collection of chat recordings from customer interactions after a product release. An ML engineer needs to create an ML model to analyze the chat data. Which action should the ML engineer take to complete the evaluation in the LEAST amount of time?

choices.A: Use Amazon Rekognition to analyze sentiments of the chat conversations.
choices.B: Train a Naive Bayes classifier to analyze sentiments of the chat conversations.
choices.C: Use Amazon Comprehend to analyze sentiments of the chat conversations.
choices.D: Use random forests to classify sentiments of the chat conversations.

explanation:
Key Concept: Comprehend provides pretrained sentiment analysis for supported text and languages, avoiding custom classifier training for an initial sentiment assessment.

A. Use Amazon Rekognition to analyze sentiments of the chat conversations. — Rekognition analyzes images and video. It does not classify sentiment in the text of chat conversations.

D. Use random forests to classify sentiments of the chat conversations. — A random-forest text classifier requires feature extraction and labeled training data, adding work compared with the pretrained sentiment service.

explanation:
Key Concept: Lower temperature concentrates token probabilities, and a smaller supported top-k limits the candidate tokens considered during sampling.

A. Increase the temperature parameter and the top_k parameter. — Higher temperature and a larger candidate set both encourage more varied outputs, opposing the request for consistency.

B. Increase the temperature parameter. Decrease the top_k parameter. — A smaller top-k restricts candidates, but increasing temperature makes sampling among them more random.

C. Decrease the temperature parameter. Increase the top_k parameter. — Lower temperature helps consistency, but increasing top-k permits more candidate tokens instead of restricting them.

D. Decrease the temperature parameter and the top_k parameter. — Reducing both supported parameters narrows and concentrates sampling, making responses more consistent. Parameter support is model-version-specific, and these settings do not guarantee identical outputs.

text: A company is using ML to predict the presence of a specific weed in a farmer's field. The company is using the Amazon SageMaker linear learner built-in algorithm with a value of multiclass_dassifier for the predictorjype hyperparameter. What should the company do to MINIMIZE false positives?

choices.A: Set the value of the weight decay hyperparameter to zero.
choices.B: Increase the number of training epochs.
choices.C: Increase the value of the target_precision hyperparameter.
choices.D: Change the value of the predictorjype hyperparameter to regressor.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company is using the Amazon SageMaker linear learner built-in algorithm with a value of multiclass_dassifier for the predictorjype hyperparameter. What should the company do to MINIMIZE false positives?

explanation:
Key Concept: Linear Learner target_precision is part of binary classifier model selection, not the multiclass configuration stated in this question.

A. Set the value of the weight decay hyperparameter to zero. — Removing weight decay reduces regularization and does not directly set a false-positive constraint. It can also worsen generalization.

B. Increase the number of training epochs. — More epochs may change fit but do not impose the desired precision or false-positive behavior.

C. Increase the value of the target_precision hyperparameter. — A higher precision target is meaningful with binary classification and recall_at_target_precision. It does not apply as described to the stated multiclass classifier, so the source key needs a corrected premise.

D. Change the value of the predictorjype hyperparameter to regressor. — Changing to regression changes the task to predicting a continuous value and does not implement a weed-presence decision threshold.

text: A company has implemented a data ingestion pipeline for sales transactions from its ecommerce website. The company uses Amazon Data Firehose to ingest data into Amazon OpenSearch Service. The buffer interval of the Firehose stream is set for 60 seconds. An OpenSearch linear model generates real-time sales forecasts based on the data and presents the data in an OpenSearch dashboard. The company needs to optimize the data ingestion pipeline to support sub-second latency for the real-time dashboard. Which change to the architecture will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use zero buffering in the Firehose stream. Tune the batch size that is used in the PutRecordBatch operation.
choices.B: Replace the Firehose stream with an AWS DataSync task. Configure the task with enhanced fan-out consumers.
choices.C: Increase the buffer interval of the Firehose stream from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
choices.D: Replace the Firehose stream with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to optimize the data ingestion pipeline to support sub-second latency for the real-time dashboard. Which change to the architecture will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Removing a buffering interval reduces delivery delay, but AWS describes Firehose zero-buffer delivery in seconds, not as a sub-second end-to-end dashboard guarantee.

A. Use zero buffering in the Firehose stream. Tune the batch size that is used in the PutRecordBatch operation. — Zero buffering is the intended latency reduction, but does not establish the required sub-second result. Producer batching, delivery, OpenSearch indexing, and dashboard refresh still contribute delay.

B. Replace the Firehose stream with an AWS DataSync task. Configure the task with enhanced fan-out consumers. — DataSync transfers files or objects and does not use Kinesis enhanced fan-out consumers. It is not a replacement for this low-latency record stream.

C. Increase the buffer interval of the Firehose stream from 60 seconds to 120 seconds. — Increasing the buffer interval increases waiting time and moves farther from the latency requirement.

D. Replace the Firehose stream with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. — An SQS queue alone does not deliver records into OpenSearch or set dashboard freshness. A consumer and an end-to-end latency design are missing.
notes: AWS describes zero-buffer delivery as within a few seconds. None of the options establishes the required sub-second end-to-end latency.

text: A company has trained an ML model in Amazon SageMaker. The company needs to host the model to provide inferences in a production environment. The model must be highly available and must respond with minimum latency. The size of each request will be between 1 KB and 3 MB. The model will receive unpredictable bursts of requests during the day. The inferences must adapt proportionally to the changes in demand. How should the company deploy the model into production to meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint. Configure auto scaling. Configure the endpoint to present the existing model.
choices.B: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Use ECS scheduled scaling that is based on the CPU of the ECS cluster.
choices.C: Install SageMaker Operator on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Deploy the model in Amazon EKS. Set horizontal pod auto scaling to scale replicas based on the memory metric.
choices.D: Use Spot Instances with a Spot Fleet behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) for inferences. Use the ALBRequestCountPerTarget metric as the metric for auto scaling.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The inferences must adapt proportionally to the changes in demand. How should the company deploy the model into production to meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker real-time endpoints support low-latency inference with autoscaling, while baseline capacity and multi-instance placement support availability during bursts.

A. Create a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint. Configure auto scaling. Configure the endpoint to present the existing model. — A real-time endpoint accepts the stated request sizes and can scale with invocation load. Configure suitable minimum capacity and scaling behavior because reactive scaling is not instantaneous.

B. Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Use ECS scheduled scaling that is based on the CPU of the ECS cluster. — Scheduled scaling follows a timetable rather than unpredictable CPU or request changes. The wording also mixes scheduled and metric-driven scaling concepts.

C. Install SageMaker Operator on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Deploy the model in Amazon EKS. Set horizontal pod auto scaling to scale replicas based on the memory metric. — An EKS deployment requires cluster operations, and memory-based scaling may not track this inference workload's request demand. It adds work beyond managed endpoint hosting.

D. Use Spot Instances with a Spot Fleet behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) for inferences. Use the ALBRequestCountPerTarget metric as the metric for auto scaling. — Spot fleets can lose capacity unexpectedly and require more serving and availability engineering. They are a weaker fit for the stated highly available, minimum-latency requirement.

text: An ML engineer needs to use an Amazon EMR cluster to process large volumes of data in batches. Any data loss is unacceptable. Which instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

choices.A: Run the primary node, core nodes, and task nodes on On-Demand Instances.
choices.B: Run the primary node, core nodes, and task nodes on Spot Instances.
choices.C: Run the primary node on an On-Demand Instance. Run the core nodes and task nodes on Spot Instances.
choices.D: Run the primary node and core nodes on On-Demand Instances. Run the task nodes on Spot Instances.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Any data loss is unacceptable. Which instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MOST cost-effective, batch, MOST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: EMR primary and core nodes maintain cluster control and HDFS data, while task nodes add processing capacity without holding the durable HDFS replicas.

A. Run the primary node, core nodes, and task nodes on On-Demand Instances. — All On-Demand nodes avoid Spot interruptions but miss the cost savings available on replaceable task-node capacity.

B. Run the primary node, core nodes, and task nodes on Spot Instances. — Spot interruption of primary or core nodes can disrupt the cluster and risk HDFS data, conflicting with the stated data-loss constraint.

C. Run the primary node on an On-Demand Instance. Run the core nodes and task nodes on Spot Instances. — Keeping only the primary On-Demand leaves HDFS-bearing core nodes exposed to Spot reclamation and potential data loss.

D. Run the primary node and core nodes on On-Demand Instances. Run the task nodes on Spot Instances. — On-Demand primary and core nodes protect control and HDFS capacity from Spot reclamation, while Spot task nodes lower processing cost. HDFS replication and durable output storage remain necessary for other failure types.

notes: Keep HDFS-bearing core nodes and the primary node On-Demand; use Spot for task-node processing capacity.

text: A company wants to improve the sustainability of its ML operations. Which actions will reduce the energy usage and computational resources that are associated with the company's training jobs? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to stop training jobs when non-converging conditions are detected.
choices.B: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth for data labeling.
choices.C: Deploy models by using AWS Lambda functions.
choices.D: Use AWS Trainium instances for training.
choices.E: Use PyTorch or TensorFlow with the distributed training option.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which actions will reduce the energy usage and computational resources that are associated with the company's training jobs? (Choose two.)
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: Training sustainability improves by avoiding wasted computation and selecting efficient hardware for supported workloads.

A. Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to stop training jobs when non-converging conditions are detected. — Debugger can detect nonconverging runs and trigger a stop action, preventing further compute and energy use on training that is not making useful progress.

B. Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth for data labeling. — Ground Truth supports labeling. It does not directly reduce the compute or energy consumed by the training jobs described.

C. Deploy models by using AWS Lambda functions. — Hosting inference in Lambda changes deployment, not the energy or resources used by the model's training jobs.

D. Use AWS Trainium instances for training. — Trainium is purpose-built training hardware that can improve training efficiency for compatible models. Measure performance and energy-related efficiency for the actual workload rather than assuming every model benefits equally.

E. Use PyTorch or TensorFlow with the distributed training option. — Distributed training can reduce elapsed time but uses more devices. It does not inherently reduce total computation or energy consumption.

text: A company is planning to create several ML prediction models. The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The entire dataset is more than 5 ТВ in size and consists of CSV, JSON, Apache Parquet, and simple text files. The data must be processed in several consecutive steps. The steps include complex manipulations that can take hours to finish running. Some of the processing involves natural language processing (NLP) transformations. The entire process must be automated. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Process data at each step by using Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Automate the process by using Data Wrangler jobs.
choices.B: Use Amazon SageMaker notebooks for each data processing step. Automate the process by using Amazon EventBridge.
choices.C: Process data at each step by using AWS Lambda functions. Automate the process by using AWS Step Functions and Amazon EventBridge.
choices.D: Use Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to create a pipeline of data processing steps. Automate the pipeline by using Amazon EventBridge.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The entire process must be automated. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker Pipelines orchestrates dependent processing jobs, allowing each stage to use appropriate managed compute and run longer than a short function invocation.

A. Process data at each step by using Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Automate the process by using Data Wrangler jobs. — Data Wrangler can automate many transformations, but a sequence of complex custom and NLP processing stages is more flexibly expressed as managed Processing steps in a pipeline.

B. Use Amazon SageMaker notebooks for each data processing step. Automate the process by using Amazon EventBridge. — Notebooks are interactive development tools and need extra execution, dependency, and failure-management logic for a reliable multi-hour production workflow.

C. Process data at each step by using AWS Lambda functions. Automate the process by using AWS Step Functions and Amazon EventBridge. — A Lambda function cannot run for hours. Splitting orchestration into Step Functions does not remove the need for a suitable long-running processing service.

D. Use Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to create a pipeline of data processing steps. Automate the pipeline by using Amazon EventBridge. — Pipelines can coordinate separate processing steps over the large S3 dataset, while EventBridge starts the workflow on a schedule or event without manual notebook execution.

text: An ML engineer needs to use AWS CloudFormation to create an ML model that an Amazon SageMaker endpoint will host. Which resource should the ML engineer declare in the CloudFormation template to meet this requirement?

choices.A: AWS::SageMaker::Model
choices.B: AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint
choices.C: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
choices.D: AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to use AWS CloudFormation to create an ML model that an Amazon SageMaker endpoint will host. Which resource should the ML engineer declare in the CloudFormation template to meet this requirement?

explanation:
Key Concept: CloudFormation separates the model definition from the endpoint configuration and the endpoint that hosts it.

A. AWS::SageMaker::Model — AWS::SageMaker::Model declares the model's serving container, artifact location, and execution role, which are then referenced by endpoint configuration resources.

B. AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint — AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint creates the hosting endpoint from an endpoint configuration. It does not replace the model definition resource.

C. AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance — AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance creates an interactive development environment, not a registered serving model.

D. AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline — AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline defines an ML workflow. It is not the resource type for the trained model that an endpoint will host.

text: An advertising company uses AWS Lake Formation to manage a data lake. The data lake contains structured data and unstructured data. The company's ML engineers are assigned to specific advertisement campaigns. The ML engineers must interact with the data through Amazon Athena and by browsing the data directly in an Amazon S3 bucket. The ML engineers must have access to only the resources that are specific to their assigned advertisement campaigns. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

choices.A: Configure IAM policies on an AWS Glue Data Catalog to restrict access to Athena based on the ML engineers' campaigns.
choices.B: Store users and campaign information in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function to update S3 bucket policies.
choices.C: Use Lake Formation to authorize AWS Glue to access the S3 bucket. Configure Lake Formation tags to map ML engineers to their campaigns.
choices.D: Configure S3 bucket policies to restrict access to the S3 bucket based on the ML engineers' campaigns.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineers must have access to only the resources that are specific to their assigned advertisement campaigns. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MOST operationally efficient, MOST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Lake Formation tag-based permissions can map campaign categories to data resources. Direct S3 access must also follow the governed credential path or equivalent restrictive S3 permissions.

A. Configure IAM policies on an AWS Glue Data Catalog to restrict access to Athena based on the ML engineers' campaigns. — Catalog IAM policies alone do not consistently enforce campaign-specific access to the underlying S3 objects, especially when users browse them directly.

B. Store users and campaign information in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function to update S3 bucket policies. — A DynamoDB-driven bucket-policy updater requires custom state synchronization and policy code instead of using the existing data-lake governance service.

C. Use Lake Formation to authorize AWS Glue to access the S3 bucket. Configure Lake Formation tags to map ML engineers to their campaigns. — Campaign LF-tags and grants can centralize access to the registered data. For direct file browsing, configure supported Lake Formation credential vending or matching S3 restrictions; ordinary broad IAM S3 access would bypass the intended controls.

D. Configure S3 bucket policies to restrict access to the S3 bucket based on the ML engineers' campaigns. — Bucket policies can restrict object prefixes but do not alone configure the Lake Formation and catalog permissions needed for the complete Athena and lake-governance workflow.
