text: An ML engineer needs to use data with Amazon SageMaker Canvas to train an ML model. The data is stored in Amazon S3 and is complex in structure. The ML engineer must use a file format that minimizes processing time for the data. Which file format will meet these requirements?

choices.A: CSV files compressed with Snappy
choices.B: JSON objects in JSONL format
choices.C: JSON files compressed with gzip
choices.D: Apache Parquet files

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must use a file format that minimizes processing time for the data. Which file format will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: minimizes processing time for the data
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Parquet is a typed columnar format with compression and support for nested structures, making it efficient for supported analytical ingestion paths.

A. CSV files compressed with Snappy — CSV lacks native nested structure and type metadata. Compression does not remove the parsing and schema limitations of that text representation.

B. JSON objects in JSONL format — JSON Lines represents nested records, but repeated field names and text parsing usually make it less efficient than a suitable columnar representation for large tabular processing.

C. JSON files compressed with gzip — Gzip reduces JSON storage size, but parsing remains necessary and whole-file compression can limit parallel reads. File-format support also must match Canvas's import path.

D. Apache Parquet files — Parquet preserves schema and stores columns efficiently, reducing parsing and unnecessary data reads in supported Canvas imports. Complex fields may still need flattening for the chosen model.

analysis.keyConcept: Parquet is a typed columnar format with compression and support for nested structures, making it efficient for supported analytical ingestion paths.

options.A: CSV lacks native nested structure and type metadata. Compression does not remove the parsing and schema limitations of that text representation.
options.B: JSON Lines represents nested records, but repeated field names and text parsing usually make it less efficient than a suitable columnar representation for large tabular processing.
options.C: Gzip reduces JSON storage size, but parsing remains necessary and whole-file compression can limit parallel reads. File-format support also must match Canvas's import path.
options.D: Parquet preserves schema and stores columns efficiently, reducing parsing and unnecessary data reads in supported Canvas imports. Complex fields may still need flattening for the chosen model.

text: An ML engineer is evaluating several ML models and must choose one model to use in production. The cost of false negative predictions by the models is much higher than the cost of false positive predictions. Which metric finding should the ML engineer prioritize the MOST when choosing the model?

choices.A: Low precision
choices.B: High precision
choices.C: Low recall
choices.D: High recall

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The cost of false negative predictions by the models is much higher than the cost of false positive predictions. Which metric finding should the ML engineer prioritize the MOST when choosing the model?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MOST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Recall measures how many actual positives are detected; higher recall means fewer false negatives at the selected decision threshold.

A. Low precision — Low precision means more positive predictions are incorrect. It is not a useful objective in itself and does not guarantee that actual positives are found.

B. High precision — High precision makes positive predictions reliable but can coexist with many missed positives if the decision threshold is too strict.

C. Low recall — Low recall means many actual positive cases are missed, directly worsening the more expensive error type.

D. High recall — High recall minimizes the fraction of actual positives missed, matching the stated priority when false negatives cost much more than false positives.

analysis.keyConcept: Recall measures how many actual positives are detected; higher recall means fewer false negatives at the selected decision threshold.

options.A: Low precision means more positive predictions are incorrect. It is not a useful objective in itself and does not guarantee that actual positives are found.
options.B: High precision makes positive predictions reliable but can coexist with many missed positives if the decision threshold is too strict.
options.C: Low recall means many actual positive cases are missed, directly worsening the more expensive error type.
options.D: High recall minimizes the fraction of actual positives missed, matching the stated priority when false negatives cost much more than false positives.

text: A company has trained and deployed an ML model by using Amazon SageMaker. The company needs to implement a solution to record and monitor all the API call events for the SageMaker endpoint. The solution also must provide a notification when the number of API call events breaches a threshold. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Create a custom rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.
choices.B: Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Use the tensor_variance built-in rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.
choices.C: Log all the endpoint invocation API events by using AWS CloudTrail. Use an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.
choices.D: Add the Invocations metric to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution also must provide a notification when the number of API call events breaches a threshold. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: CloudTrail data events audit individual endpoint invocations, while CloudWatch metrics and alarms monitor counts and notify on a threshold breach.

A. Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Create a custom rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached. — Debugger analyzes training tensors and execution behavior. It does not provide an audit record of every hosted endpoint API invocation.

B. Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Use the tensor_variance built-in rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached. — The tensor-variance rule detects a training-tensor issue, not an invocation-count threshold or endpoint API audit event.

C. Log all the endpoint invocation API events by using AWS CloudTrail. Use an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached. — Enable CloudTrail data events for the endpoint to record supported invocation calls, then use an invocation metric or log-derived count in a CloudWatch alarm with a notification action. Data-event logging must be explicitly configured.

D. Add the Invocations metric to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached. — The Invocations metric and alarm provide aggregate monitoring, but do not satisfy the separate requirement to record every API call event.

analysis.keyConcept: CloudTrail data events audit individual endpoint invocations, while CloudWatch metrics and alarms monitor counts and notify on a threshold breach.

options.A: Debugger analyzes training tensors and execution behavior. It does not provide an audit record of every hosted endpoint API invocation.
options.B: The tensor-variance rule detects a training-tensor issue, not an invocation-count threshold or endpoint API audit event.
options.C: Enable CloudTrail data events for the endpoint to record supported invocation calls, then use an invocation metric or log-derived count in a CloudWatch alarm with a notification action. Data-event logging must be explicitly configured.
options.D: The Invocations metric and alarm provide aggregate monitoring, but do not satisfy the separate requirement to record every API call event.

text: A company has AWS Glue data processing jobs that are orchestrated by an AWS Glue workflow. The AWS Glue jobs can run on a schedule or can be launched manually. The company is developing pipelines in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines for ML model development. The pipelines will use the output of the AWS Glue jobs during the data processing phase of model development. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution that integrates the AWS Glue jobs with the pipelines. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Use AWS Step Functions for orchestration of the pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs.
choices.B: Use processing steps in SageMaker Pipelines. Configure inputs that point to the Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the AWS Glue jobs.
choices.C: Use Callback steps in SageMaker Pipelines to start the AWS Glue workflow and to stop the pipelines until the AWS Glue jobs finish running.
choices.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs in the desired order.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution that integrates the AWS Glue jobs with the pipelines. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A Pipelines callback step pauses workflow progress until an external process reports success or failure using its callback token.

A. Use AWS Step Functions for orchestration of the pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs. — Step Functions can coordinate the services but introduces another orchestration layer when the model workflow already uses SageMaker Pipelines.

B. Use processing steps in SageMaker Pipelines. Configure inputs that point to the Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the AWS Glue jobs. — A Processing step does not execute a Glue job merely because its input contains the Glue job ARN. It launches a SageMaker Processing workload.

C. Use Callback steps in SageMaker Pipelines to start the AWS Glue workflow and to stop the pipelines until the AWS Glue jobs finish running. — The callback can send an SQS message to a worker that starts the Glue workflow. The worker reports completion with the callback token, allowing Pipelines to continue only after the Glue output is ready.

D. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs in the desired order. — Independent EventBridge triggers do not by themselves enforce successful completion of all Glue jobs before the dependent pipeline stages proceed.

analysis.keyConcept: A Pipelines callback step pauses workflow progress until an external process reports success or failure using its callback token.

options.A: Step Functions can coordinate the services but introduces another orchestration layer when the model workflow already uses SageMaker Pipelines.
options.B: A Processing step does not execute a Glue job merely because its input contains the Glue job ARN. It launches a SageMaker Processing workload.
options.C: The callback can send an SQS message to a worker that starts the Glue workflow. The worker reports completion with the callback token, allowing Pipelines to continue only after the Glue output is ready.
options.D: Independent EventBridge triggers do not by themselves enforce successful completion of all Glue jobs before the dependent pipeline stages proceed.

text: A company is using an Amazon Redshift database as its single data source. Some of the data is sensitive. A data scientist needs to use some of the sensitive data from the database. An ML engineer must give the data scientist access to the data without transforming the source data and without storing anonymized data in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

choices.A: Configure dynamic data masking policies to control how sensitive data is shared with the data scientist at query time.
choices.B: Create a materialized view with masking logic on top of the database. Grant the necessary read permissions to the data scientist.
choices.C: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create schema-on-read with masking logic. Share the view with the data scientist.
choices.D: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue job to anonymize the data. Share the dataset with the data scientist.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must give the data scientist access to the data without transforming the source data and without storing anonymized data in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Redshift dynamic data masking changes the values visible to a querying user or role without rewriting the underlying stored data.

A. Configure dynamic data masking policies to control how sensitive data is shared with the data scientist at query time. — A masking policy applied to the data scientist's access can hide or transform sensitive fields at query time, preserving the original data and avoiding a separate anonymized copy.

B. Create a materialized view with masking logic on top of the database. Grant the necessary read permissions to the data scientist. — A materialized view stores query results and requires refresh management, conflicting with the requirement to avoid storing anonymized data in the database.

C. Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create schema-on-read with masking logic. Share the view with the data scientist. — Exporting to S3 and building Athena views adds a copied dataset and a separate query-access workflow that native masking avoids.

D. Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue job to anonymize the data. Share the dataset with the data scientist. — A Glue anonymization job creates and maintains a transformed copy. It adds processing and storage rather than applying a policy to existing queries.

analysis.keyConcept: Redshift dynamic data masking changes the values visible to a querying user or role without rewriting the underlying stored data.

options.A: A masking policy applied to the data scientist's access can hide or transform sensitive fields at query time, preserving the original data and avoiding a separate anonymized copy.
options.B: A materialized view stores query results and requires refresh management, conflicting with the requirement to avoid storing anonymized data in the database.
options.C: Exporting to S3 and building Athena views adds a copied dataset and a separate query-access workflow that native masking avoids.
options.D: A Glue anonymization job creates and maintains a transformed copy. It adds processing and storage rather than applying a policy to existing queries.

text: An ML engineer is using a training job to fine-tune a deep learning model in Amazon SageMaker Studio. The ML engineer previously used the same pre-trained model with a similar dataset. The ML engineer expects vanishing gradient, underutilized GPU, and overfitting problems. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution to detect these issues and to react in predefined ways when the issues occur. The solution also must provide comprehensive real-time metrics during the training. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Use TensorBoard to monitor the training job. Publish the findings to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the findings and to initiate the predefined actions.
choices.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch default metrics to gain insights about the training job. Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.
choices.C: Expand the metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to include the gradients in each training step. Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Debugger built-in rules to monitor the training job. Configure the rules to initiate the predefined actions.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution also must provide comprehensive real-time metrics during the training. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, real-time, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Debugger combines captured tensors and profiling data with rules that identify training problems and trigger configured actions.

A. Use TensorBoard to monitor the training job. Publish the findings to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the findings and to initiate the predefined actions. — TensorBoard helps inspect training, but the proposed notification and response path requires custom publishing, analysis, and Lambda logic.

B. Use Amazon CloudWatch default metrics to gain insights about the training job. Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions. — Default CloudWatch resource metrics can show utilization but do not provide the gradient and generalization diagnostics needed for all three issues.

C. Expand the metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to include the gradients in each training step. Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions. — Publishing every gradient through custom metrics and writing reaction code duplicates capabilities available through Debugger's supported instrumentation and rules.

D. Use SageMaker Debugger built-in rules to monitor the training job. Configure the rules to initiate the predefined actions. — Built-in rules can detect issues such as vanishing gradients, low GPU utilization, and overfitting, then trigger configured actions with less custom monitoring code.

analysis.keyConcept: Debugger combines captured tensors and profiling data with rules that identify training problems and trigger configured actions.

options.A: TensorBoard helps inspect training, but the proposed notification and response path requires custom publishing, analysis, and Lambda logic.
options.B: Default CloudWatch resource metrics can show utilization but do not provide the gradient and generalization diagnostics needed for all three issues.
options.C: Publishing every gradient through custom metrics and writing reaction code duplicates capabilities available through Debugger's supported instrumentation and rules.
options.D: Built-in rules can detect issues such as vanishing gradients, low GPU utilization, and overfitting, then trigger configured actions with less custom monitoring code.

text: A credit card company has a fraud detection model in production on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. The company develops a new version of the model. The company needs to assess the new model's performance by using live data and without affecting production end users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Set up SageMaker Debugger and create a custom rule.
choices.B: Set up blue/green deployments with all-at-once traffic shifting.
choices.C: Set up blue/green deployments with canary traffic shifting.
choices.D: Set up shadow testing with a shadow variant of the new model.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to assess the new model's performance by using live data and without affecting production end users. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Shadow testing sends copied live requests to a candidate model while keeping its responses out of the user-facing production response path.

A. Set up SageMaker Debugger and create a custom rule. — Debugger diagnoses training behavior. It does not mirror production inference requests to a candidate endpoint variant.

B. Set up blue/green deployments with all-at-once traffic shifting. — All-at-once traffic shifting immediately exposes production users to the new model, violating the no-user-impact evaluation requirement.

C. Set up blue/green deployments with canary traffic shifting. — Canary shifting exposes a small production fraction to the candidate. Those users still receive the new model's predictions.

D. Set up shadow testing with a shadow variant of the new model. — A shadow variant receives copies of live requests for measurement, while the production variant's output remains the only response returned to the banking application.

analysis.keyConcept: Shadow testing sends copied live requests to a candidate model while keeping its responses out of the user-facing production response path.

options.A: Debugger diagnoses training behavior. It does not mirror production inference requests to a candidate endpoint variant.
options.B: All-at-once traffic shifting immediately exposes production users to the new model, violating the no-user-impact evaluation requirement.
options.C: Canary shifting exposes a small production fraction to the candidate. Those users still receive the new model's predictions.
options.D: A shadow variant receives copies of live requests for measurement, while the production variant's output remains the only response returned to the banking application.

text: A company stores time-series data about user clicks in an Amazon S3 bucket. The raw data consists of millions of rows of user activity every day. ML engineers access the data to develop their ML models. The ML engineers need to generate daily reports and analyze click trends over the past 3 days by using Amazon Athena. The company must retain the data for 30 days before archiving the data. Which solution will provide the HIGHEST performance for data retrieval?

choices.A: Keep all the time-series data without partitioning in the S3 bucket. Manually move data that is older than 30 days to separate S3 buckets.
choices.B: Create AWS Lambda functions to copy the time-series data into separate S3 buckets. Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
choices.C: Organize the time-series data into partitions by date prefix in the S3 bucket. Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive partitions that are older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
choices.D: Put each day's time-series data into its own S3 bucket. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to archive S3 buckets that hold data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must retain the data for 30 days before archiving the data. Which solution will provide the HIGHEST performance for data retrieval?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Date partitioning lets Athena prune older data when a query specifies recent dates; lifecycle rules manage the storage class of aging objects.

A. Keep all the time-series data without partitioning in the S3 bucket. Manually move data that is older than 30 days to separate S3 buckets. — Without partitioning, recent-date queries may scan much more data. Manual movement also increases operational effort and risks inconsistent retention.

B. Create AWS Lambda functions to copy the time-series data into separate S3 buckets. Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. — Copying data among buckets adds processing without inherently supplying partition pruning for the three-day analytical window.

C. Organize the time-series data into partitions by date prefix in the S3 bucket. Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive partitions that are older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. — Cataloged date-prefix partitions let Athena read only the relevant days when queries filter on the partition keys. Lifecycle rules can transition the underlying objects after 30 days.

D. Put each day's time-series data into its own S3 bucket. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to archive S3 buckets that hold data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. — A separate bucket for every day complicates cataloging and access without improving on ordinary partition pruning. Lifecycle transitions apply to objects, not to a bucket as a stored object.

analysis.keyConcept: Date partitioning lets Athena prune older data when a query specifies recent dates; lifecycle rules manage the storage class of aging objects.

options.A: Without partitioning, recent-date queries may scan much more data. Manual movement also increases operational effort and risks inconsistent retention.
options.B: Copying data among buckets adds processing without inherently supplying partition pruning for the three-day analytical window.
options.C: Cataloged date-prefix partitions let Athena read only the relevant days when queries filter on the partition keys. Lifecycle rules can transition the underlying objects after 30 days.
options.D: A separate bucket for every day complicates cataloging and access without improving on ordinary partition pruning. Lifecycle transitions apply to objects, not to a bucket as a stored object.

text: A company has deployed an ML model that detects fraudulent credit card transactions in real time in a banking application. The model uses Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference. Consumers are reporting delays in receiving the inference results. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to improve the inference performance. The solution also must provide a notification when a deviation in model quality occurs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use SageMaker real-time inference for inference. Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.
choices.B: Use SageMaker batch transform for inference. Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Serverless Inference for inference. Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.
choices.D: Keep using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for inference. Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution also must provide a notification when a deviation in model quality occurs. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real time, Asynchronous
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Real-time inference provides synchronous low-latency responses, while model-quality monitoring compares predictions with later ground truth and emits alarmable metrics.

A. Use SageMaker real-time inference for inference. Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality. — A real-time endpoint avoids the asynchronous request queue and result-retrieval workflow. Model Monitor with captured predictions, labels, and CloudWatch alarms can report quality deviations.

B. Use SageMaker batch transform for inference. Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality. — Batch Transform is designed for offline datasets and would not provide an immediate fraud decision for each live transaction.

C. Use SageMaker Serverless Inference for inference. Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality. — Serverless can have cold-start latency, and Inference Recommender benchmarks serving configurations rather than monitoring ongoing predictive quality.

D. Keep using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for inference. Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality. — Keeping the asynchronous serving pattern does not directly address the reported response delay, and Inference Recommender is not a quality-drift notification service.

sources.title: AWS — Model Monitor capabilities and availability

notes: Service availability: SageMaker Model Monitor is closed to new customers; existing customers can continue using it. This answer describes its documented capabilities.

analysis.keyConcept: Real-time inference provides synchronous low-latency responses, while model-quality monitoring compares predictions with later ground truth and emits alarmable metrics.

options.A: A real-time endpoint avoids the asynchronous request queue and result-retrieval workflow. Model Monitor with captured predictions, labels, and CloudWatch alarms can report quality deviations.
options.B: Batch Transform is designed for offline datasets and would not provide an immediate fraud decision for each live transaction.
options.C: Serverless can have cold-start latency, and Inference Recommender benchmarks serving configurations rather than monitoring ongoing predictive quality.
options.D: Keeping the asynchronous serving pattern does not directly address the reported response delay, and Inference Recommender is not a quality-drift notification service.

text: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to host a trained ML model. The rate of requests to the model will be inconsistent throughout the day. The ML engineer needs a scalable solution that minimizes costs when the model is not in use. The solution also must maintain the model's capacity to respond to requests during times of peak usage. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create AWS Lambda functions that have fixed concurrency to host the model. Configure the Lambda functions to automatically scale based on the number of requests to the model.
choices.B: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate. Set a static number of tasks to handle requests during times of peak usage.
choices.C: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Deploy multiple copies of the model to the endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer to route traffic between the different copies of the model at the endpoint.
choices.D: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Create SageMaker endpoint auto scaling policies that are based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics to adjust the number of instances dynamically.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution also must maintain the model's capacity to respond to requests during times of peak usage. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: minimizes costs when the model is not in use
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Metric-based endpoint autoscaling adjusts serving capacity with demand, reducing overprovisioning while retaining configured capacity for responsiveness.

A. Create AWS Lambda functions that have fixed concurrency to host the model. Configure the Lambda functions to automatically scale based on the number of requests to the model. — A fixed concurrency limit does not by itself define a model-serving environment or guarantee peak capacity. Lambda also has model-size and runtime constraints that must be designed around.

B. Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate. Set a static number of tasks to handle requests during times of peak usage. — A static peak-sized Fargate service keeps paying for peak capacity during quiet periods and does not meet the dynamic cost requirement.

C. Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Deploy multiple copies of the model to the endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer to route traffic between the different copies of the model at the endpoint. — SageMaker already routes requests among endpoint instances. Adding an ALB in front of supposed individual copies is unnecessary and is not the native scaling mechanism.

D. Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Create SageMaker endpoint auto scaling policies that are based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics to adjust the number of instances dynamically. — Endpoint autoscaling can increase or decrease instances based on suitable CloudWatch metrics. A conventional real-time endpoint still has a minimum capacity floor, so this option reduces idle cost rather than guaranteeing zero idle cost.

analysis.keyConcept: Metric-based endpoint autoscaling adjusts serving capacity with demand, reducing overprovisioning while retaining configured capacity for responsiveness.

options.A: A fixed concurrency limit does not by itself define a model-serving environment or guarantee peak capacity. Lambda also has model-size and runtime constraints that must be designed around.
options.B: A static peak-sized Fargate service keeps paying for peak capacity during quiet periods and does not meet the dynamic cost requirement.
options.C: SageMaker already routes requests among endpoint instances. Adding an ALB in front of supposed individual copies is unnecessary and is not the native scaling mechanism.
options.D: Endpoint autoscaling can increase or decrease instances based on suitable CloudWatch metrics. A conventional real-time endpoint still has a minimum capacity floor, so this option reduces idle cost rather than guaranteeing zero idle cost.

text: A company uses Amazon SageMaker Studio to develop an ML model. The company has a single SageMaker Studio domain. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution that provides an automated alert when SageMaker compute costs reach a specific threshold. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Add resource tagging by editing the SageMaker user profile in the SageMaker domain. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
choices.B: Add resource tagging by editing the SageMaker user profile in the SageMaker domain. Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
choices.C: Add resource tagging by editing each user's IAM profile. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
choices.D: Add resource tagging by editing each user's IAM profile. Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution that provides an automated alert when SageMaker compute costs reach a specific threshold. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Cost-allocation tags identify the intended SageMaker resources, and AWS Budgets sends notifications when actual or forecasted spend crosses a configured threshold.

A. Add resource tagging by editing the SageMaker user profile in the SageMaker domain. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached. — User-profile resource tags can help allocate costs, but Cost Explorer primarily analyzes spend; the threshold notification belongs in AWS Budgets.

B. Add resource tagging by editing the SageMaker user profile in the SageMaker domain. Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached. — Propagate the relevant SageMaker resource tags, activate them for cost allocation, and create a tag-filtered budget with notifications. Billing alerts are not an instantaneous compute shutdown mechanism.

C. Add resource tagging by editing each user's IAM profile. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached. — Tagging an IAM identity does not automatically tag the SageMaker compute it uses, and Cost Explorer alone is not the specified budget-alert service.

D. Add resource tagging by editing each user's IAM profile. Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached. — Budgets is appropriate, but IAM profile tags alone do not establish the resource cost-allocation tags needed to isolate this Studio usage.

analysis.keyConcept: Cost-allocation tags identify the intended SageMaker resources, and AWS Budgets sends notifications when actual or forecasted spend crosses a configured threshold.

options.A: User-profile resource tags can help allocate costs, but Cost Explorer primarily analyzes spend; the threshold notification belongs in AWS Budgets.
options.B: Propagate the relevant SageMaker resource tags, activate them for cost allocation, and create a tag-filtered budget with notifications. Billing alerts are not an instantaneous compute shutdown mechanism.
options.C: Tagging an IAM identity does not automatically tag the SageMaker compute it uses, and Cost Explorer alone is not the specified budget-alert service.
options.D: Budgets is appropriate, but IAM profile tags alone do not establish the resource cost-allocation tags needed to isolate this Studio usage.

text: A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML workloads. The company's ML engineer receives a 50 MB Apache Parquet data file to build a fraud detection model. The file includes several correlated columns that are not required. What should the ML engineer do to drop the unnecessary columns in the file with the LEAST effort?

choices.A: Download the file to a local workstation. Perform one-hot encoding by using a custom Python script.
choices.B: Create an Apache Spark job that uses a custom processing script on Amazon EMR.
choices.C: Create a SageMaker processing job by calling the SageMaker Python SDK.
choices.D: Create a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler. Configure a transform step.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The file includes several correlated columns that are not required. What should the ML engineer do to drop the unnecessary columns in the file with the LEAST effort?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A visual column-management transform is sufficient for removing known unnecessary fields from a small supported tabular file.

A. Download the file to a local workstation. Perform one-hot encoding by using a custom Python script. — One-hot encoding expands categorical values into indicators; it does not perform the requested removal of correlated columns.

B. Create an Apache Spark job that uses a custom processing script on Amazon EMR. — An EMR Spark job requires cluster and script configuration for a simple 50 MB column-selection operation.

C. Create a SageMaker processing job by calling the SageMaker Python SDK. — A custom Processing job can drop columns, but requires code and job setup that the built-in visual transform avoids.

D. Create a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler. Configure a transform step. — Data Wrangler can import Parquet and apply a drop-column transform in a flow, meeting the task without a custom processing script.

analysis.keyConcept: A visual column-management transform is sufficient for removing known unnecessary fields from a small supported tabular file.

options.A: One-hot encoding expands categorical values into indicators; it does not perform the requested removal of correlated columns.
options.B: An EMR Spark job requires cluster and script configuration for a simple 50 MB column-selection operation.
options.C: A custom Processing job can drop columns, but requires code and job setup that the built-in visual transform avoids.
options.D: Data Wrangler can import Parquet and apply a drop-column transform in a flow, meeting the task without a custom processing script.

text: A company is creating an application that will recommend products for customers to purchase. The application will make API calls to Amazon Q Business. The company must ensure that responses from Amazon Q Business do not include the name of the company's main competitor. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Configure the competitor's name as a blocked phrase in Amazon Q Business.
choices.B: Configure an Amazon Q Business retriever to exclude the competitor’s name.
choices.C: Configure an Amazon Kendra retriever for Amazon Q Business to build indexes that exclude the competitor's name.
choices.D: Configure document attribute boosting in Amazon Q Business to deprioritize the competitor's name.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must ensure that responses from Amazon Q Business do not include the name of the company's main competitor. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Amazon Q Business global blocked-phrase controls restrict specified terms in chat responses at the application level.

A. Configure the competitor's name as a blocked phrase in Amazon Q Business. — Adding the competitor name to blocked phrases applies a response-level control and can provide a configured replacement message when the blocked phrase is encountered.

B. Configure an Amazon Q Business retriever to exclude the competitor’s name. — Retriever filtering affects retrieved content, but does not reliably prevent a term from appearing through another source or the model's generated response.

C. Configure an Amazon Kendra retriever for Amazon Q Business to build indexes that exclude the competitor's name. — Removing a name from one Kendra index does not establish a global response restriction across the application's other content and generation paths.

D. Configure document attribute boosting in Amazon Q Business to deprioritize the competitor's name. — Attribute boosting changes ranking preference, not a prohibition. A deprioritized document or term can still appear in a response.

analysis.keyConcept: Amazon Q Business global blocked-phrase controls restrict specified terms in chat responses at the application level.

options.A: Adding the competitor name to blocked phrases applies a response-level control and can provide a configured replacement message when the blocked phrase is encountered.
options.B: Retriever filtering affects retrieved content, but does not reliably prevent a term from appearing through another source or the model's generated response.
options.C: Removing a name from one Kendra index does not establish a global response restriction across the application's other content and generation paths.
options.D: Attribute boosting changes ranking preference, not a prohibition. A deprioritized document or term can still appear in a response.

text: An ML engineer needs to use Amazon SageMaker to fine-tune a large language model (LLM) for text summarization. The ML engineer must follow a low-code no-code (LCNC) approach. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Studio to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances.
choices.B: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by a custom API endpoint.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by SageMaker JumpStart.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must follow a low-code no-code (LCNC) approach. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Autopilot supports instruction-based fine-tuning for selected JumpStart text-generation models, with a managed workflow and Canvas as a visual entry point.

A. Use SageMaker Studio to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. — Operating an LLM directly on EC2 through Studio still requires custom training and instance-management work; using Studio alone does not make that workflow low-code.

B. Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by a custom API endpoint. — Autopilot does not fine-tune an arbitrary remote model just by receiving a custom inference API endpoint. It needs a supported base model and training data.

C. Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. — An arbitrary EC2-hosted LLM is not the supported Autopilot fine-tuning integration described by the service.

D. Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by SageMaker JumpStart. — Using a supported JumpStart base model with Autopilot delegates the fine-tuning workflow to managed services. Prepare instruction-response examples and check the supported model and Region; a preexisting endpoint is not itself the training input.

analysis.keyConcept: Autopilot supports instruction-based fine-tuning for selected JumpStart text-generation models, with a managed workflow and Canvas as a visual entry point.

options.A: Operating an LLM directly on EC2 through Studio still requires custom training and instance-management work; using Studio alone does not make that workflow low-code.
options.B: Autopilot does not fine-tune an arbitrary remote model just by receiving a custom inference API endpoint. It needs a supported base model and training data.
options.C: An arbitrary EC2-hosted LLM is not the supported Autopilot fine-tuning integration described by the service.
options.D: Using a supported JumpStart base model with Autopilot delegates the fine-tuning workflow to managed services. Prepare instruction-response examples and check the supported model and Region; a preexisting endpoint is not itself the training input.

text: A company has an ML model that needs to run one time each night to predict stock values. The model input is 3 MB of data that is collected during the current day. The model produces the predictions for the next day. The prediction process takes less than 1 minute to finish running. How should the company deploy the model on Amazon SageMaker to meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use a multi-model serverless endpoint. Enable caching.
choices.B: Use an asynchronous inference endpoint. Set the InitialInstanceCount parameter to 0.
choices.C: Use a real-time endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy to scale the model to 0 when the model is not in use.
choices.D: Use a serverless inference endpoint. Set the MaxConcurrency parameter to 1.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The prediction process takes less than 1 minute to finish running. How should the company deploy the model on Amazon SageMaker to meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: On-demand Serverless Inference suits infrequent short requests within its payload and execution limits, with no provisioned instance to keep running between invocations.

A. Use a multi-model serverless endpoint. Enable caching. — SageMaker Serverless Inference does not support the proposed multi-model endpoint arrangement. A single nightly model also does not require that architecture.

B. Use an asynchronous inference endpoint. Set the InitialInstanceCount parameter to 0. — An asynchronous endpoint can later scale to zero, but its provisioned variant is not created with InitialInstanceCount equal to zero as described.

C. Use a real-time endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy to scale the model to 0 when the model is not in use. — A conventional real-time endpoint does not scale its ordinary instance-based variant to zero through this simple configuration. Specialized scale-to-zero features require a different setup.

D. Use a serverless inference endpoint. Set the MaxConcurrency parameter to 1. — The 3 MB input and sub-minute processing fit serverless invocation limits, and one concurrent request is enough for a single nightly run. Cold-start time is acceptable unless a stricter latency requirement is added.

analysis.keyConcept: On-demand Serverless Inference suits infrequent short requests within its payload and execution limits, with no provisioned instance to keep running between invocations.

options.A: SageMaker Serverless Inference does not support the proposed multi-model endpoint arrangement. A single nightly model also does not require that architecture.
options.B: An asynchronous endpoint can later scale to zero, but its provisioned variant is not created with InitialInstanceCount equal to zero as described.
options.C: A conventional real-time endpoint does not scale its ordinary instance-based variant to zero through this simple configuration. Specialized scale-to-zero features require a different setup.
options.D: The 3 MB input and sub-minute processing fit serverless invocation limits, and one concurrent request is enough for a single nightly run. Cold-start time is acceptable unless a stricter latency requirement is added.

text: An ML engineer trained an ML model on Amazon SageMaker to detect automobile accidents from dosed-circuit TV footage. The ML engineer used SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a training dataset of images of accidents and non-accidents. The model performed well during training and validation. However, the model is underperforming in production because of variations in the quality of the images from various cameras. Which solution will improve the model's accuracy in the LEAST amount of time?

choices.A: Collect more images from all the cameras. Use Data Wrangler to prepare a new training dataset.
choices.B: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler corrupt image transform. Specify the impulse noise option.
choices.C: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler enhance image contrast transform. Specify the Gamma contrast option.
choices.D: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler resize image transform. Crop all images to the same size.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: However, the model is underperforming in production because of variations in the quality of the images from various cameras. Which solution will improve the model's accuracy in the LEAST amount of time?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Training augmentation can simulate camera degradation so a vision model learns to tolerate quality variation absent from its original dataset.

A. Collect more images from all the cameras. Use Data Wrangler to prepare a new training dataset. — Collecting and labeling representative production-camera images is valuable, but usually takes longer than applying a relevant augmentation to the existing dataset.

B. Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler corrupt image transform. Specify the impulse noise option. — Impulse-noise corruption quickly adds degraded training examples and can improve robustness to similar camera noise. Validate that this corruption reflects the real problem; it does not solve every kind of image-quality variation.

C. Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler enhance image contrast transform. Specify the Gamma contrast option. — Gamma contrast targets brightness and contrast variation, not general sensor noise. It would be appropriate only if that specific mismatch explains the failures.

D. Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler resize image transform. Crop all images to the same size. — Cropping to a uniform size standardizes geometry but does not simulate the quality degradation causing the training-to-production mismatch.

analysis.keyConcept: Training augmentation can simulate camera degradation so a vision model learns to tolerate quality variation absent from its original dataset.

options.A: Collecting and labeling representative production-camera images is valuable, but usually takes longer than applying a relevant augmentation to the existing dataset.
options.B: Impulse-noise corruption quickly adds degraded training examples and can improve robustness to similar camera noise. Validate that this corruption reflects the real problem; it does not solve every kind of image-quality variation.
options.C: Gamma contrast targets brightness and contrast variation, not general sensor noise. It would be appropriate only if that specific mismatch explains the failures.
options.D: Cropping to a uniform size standardizes geometry but does not simulate the quality degradation causing the training-to-production mismatch.

text: A company has an application that uses different APIs to generate embeddings for input text. The company needs to implement a solution to automatically rotate the API tokens every 3 months. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Store the tokens in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation.
choices.B: Store the tokens in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation.
choices.C: Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use an AWS managed key to perform the rotation.
choices.D: Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use an AWS owned key to perform the rotation.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to implement a solution to automatically rotate the API tokens every 3 months. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Secrets Manager coordinates secret versions and scheduled rotation through a rotation function that updates both the stored value and the external credential issuer.

A. Store the tokens in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation. — Store the API tokens as secrets and configure a scheduled Lambda rotation workflow that creates, tests, and promotes replacement tokens using each provider's supported API.

B. Store the tokens in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation. — Parameter Store can hold encrypted values, but a Lambda-based rotation system requires custom scheduling and lifecycle handling rather than the dedicated Secrets Manager rotation workflow.

C. Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use an AWS managed key to perform the rotation. — KMS manages encryption keys, not arbitrary third-party API-token rotation. Rotating a KMS key does not change the external API credential.

D. Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use an AWS owned key to perform the rotation. — An AWS owned KMS key is not a store for user-managed API tokens, and its rotation cannot issue a replacement token at an external provider.

analysis.keyConcept: Secrets Manager coordinates secret versions and scheduled rotation through a rotation function that updates both the stored value and the external credential issuer.

options.A: Store the API tokens as secrets and configure a scheduled Lambda rotation workflow that creates, tests, and promotes replacement tokens using each provider's supported API.
options.B: Parameter Store can hold encrypted values, but a Lambda-based rotation system requires custom scheduling and lifecycle handling rather than the dedicated Secrets Manager rotation workflow.
options.C: KMS manages encryption keys, not arbitrary third-party API-token rotation. Rotating a KMS key does not change the external API credential.
options.D: An AWS owned KMS key is not a store for user-managed API tokens, and its rotation cannot issue a replacement token at an external provider.

text: An ML engineer receives datasets that contain missing values, duplicates, and extreme outliers. The ML engineer must consolidate these datasets into a single data frame and must prepare the data for ML. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame. Use the cleansing and enrichment functionalities to prepare the data.
choices.B: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame. Use the human-in-the-loop capability to prepare the data.
choices.C: Manually import and merge the datasets. Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame. Use Amazon Q Developer to generate code snippets that will prepare the data.
choices.D: Manually import and merge the datasets. Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame. Use Amazon SageMaker data labeling to prepare the data.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must consolidate these datasets into a single data frame and must prepare the data for ML. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Data Wrangler combines datasets and applies reusable cleaning operations for missing values, duplicates, and outliers in one preparation flow.

A. Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame. Use the cleansing and enrichment functionalities to prepare the data. — Import, join or concatenate the datasets, then apply the appropriate missing-value, deduplication, and outlier transforms in a repeatable flow.

B. Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame. Use the human-in-the-loop capability to prepare the data. — Ground Truth manages human or automated labeling tasks. It is not the general dataframe-join and data-cleansing tool required here.

C. Manually import and merge the datasets. Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame. Use Amazon Q Developer to generate code snippets that will prepare the data. — Generated code can help implement cleaning, but manual ingestion and integration still require code review and execution management that the integrated visual workflow avoids.

D. Manually import and merge the datasets. Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame. Use Amazon SageMaker data labeling to prepare the data. — Labeling supplies target annotations. It does not replace the missing-value handling, duplicate removal, and outlier preparation needed for the combined table.

options.B: Ground Truth manages human or automated labeling tasks. It is not the general dataframe-join and data-cleansing tool required here.

text: A company has historical data that shows whether customers needed long-term support from company staff. The company needs to develop an ML model to predict whether new customers will require long-term support. Which modeling approach should the company use to meet this requirement?

choices.A: Anomaly detection
choices.B: Linear regression
choices.C: Logistic regression
choices.D: Semantic segmentation

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to develop an ML model to predict whether new customers will require long-term support. Which modeling approach should the company use to meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Predicting whether long-term support is needed from labeled historical records is supervised binary classification.

A. Anomaly detection — Anomaly detection finds unusual customers but does not directly learn the supplied support-needed versus not-needed outcome.

B. Linear regression — Ordinary linear regression produces unconstrained numeric predictions rather than a directly modeled binary-outcome probability.

C. Logistic regression — Logistic regression learns a probability for the binary support outcome from customer features, matching the available labels and desired prediction.

D. Semantic segmentation — Semantic segmentation labels image pixels and is unrelated to a tabular customer-support classification task.

text: An ML engineer has developed a binary classification model outside of Amazon SageMaker. The ML engineer needs to make the model accessible to a SageMaker Canvas user for additional tuning. The model artifacts are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The ML engineer and the Canvas user are part of the same SageMaker domain. Which combination of requirements must be met so that the ML engineer can share the model with the Canvas user? (Choose two.)

choices.A: The ML engineer and the Canvas user must be in separate SageMaker domains.
choices.B: The Canvas user must have permissions to access the S3 bucket where the model artifacts are stored.
choices.C: The model must be registered in the SageMaker Model Registry.
choices.D: The ML engineer must host the model on AWS Marketplace.
choices.E: The ML engineer must deploy the model to a SageMaker endpoint.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which combination of requirements must be met so that the ML engineer can share the model with the Canvas user? (Choose two.)
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Sharing an externally built model into Canvas requires an accessible registered model package and permissions to its artifacts. Import for prediction does not automatically enable retraining an arbitrary external model.

A. The ML engineer and the Canvas user must be in separate SageMaker domains. — The collaboration workflow requires compatible users within the same SageMaker domain, not separate domains as proposed.

B. The Canvas user must have permissions to access the S3 bucket where the model artifacts are stored. — The Canvas execution identity must be able to read the S3 model artifacts and use any required encryption key; otherwise the shared package cannot be loaded.

C. The model must be registered in the SageMaker Model Registry. — Registering the externally built model in Model Registry provides the model package that can be shared with Canvas. The phrase additional tuning overstates what import alone provides; training changes may need to remain with the data scientist.

D. The ML engineer must host the model on AWS Marketplace. — Publishing to AWS Marketplace is not required for private collaboration within the same domain.

E. The ML engineer must deploy the model to a SageMaker endpoint. — A preexisting SageMaker endpoint is not a prerequisite for sharing a registered model package and its artifacts into Canvas.

notes: B and C are the sharing prerequisites. Importing a model for Canvas predictions does not by itself enable additional tuning of an arbitrary external classifier.

text: A company is building a deep learning model on Amazon SageMaker. The company uses a large amount of data as the training dataset. The company needs to optimize the model's hyperparameters to minimize the loss function on the validation dataset. Which hyperparameter tuning strategy will accomplish this goal with the LEAST computation time?

choices.A: Hyperband
choices.B: Grid search
choices.C: Bayesian optimization
choices.D: Random search

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to optimize the model's hyperparameters to minimize the loss function on the validation dataset. Which hyperparameter tuning strategy will accomplish this goal with the LEAST computation time?

explanation:
Key Concept: Hyperband reduces search computation by stopping poorly performing configurations early and allocating more training resources to promising candidates.

A. Hyperband — Hyperband uses intermediate validation performance to avoid fully training every candidate, which is a strong fit for expensive deep-learning trials with comparable learning progress.

B. Grid search — Grid search can require evaluating many combinations to completion and grows rapidly as the number of tunable parameters increases.

C. Bayesian optimization — Bayesian optimization can be sample-efficient, but does not by itself provide Hyperband's successive resource-allocation strategy for large parallel deep-learning searches.

D. Random search — Random search explores configurations without modeling previous outcomes and does not inherently stop weak trials or promote stronger ones.

text: A company is planning to use Amazon Redshift ML in its primary AWS account. The source data is in an Amazon S3 bucket in a secondary account. An ML engineer needs to set up an ML pipeline in the primary account to access the S3 bucket in the secondary account. The solution must not require public IPv4 addresses. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public access enabled in the primary account. Create a VPC peering connection between the accounts. Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0.
choices.B: Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public access enabled in the primary account. Create an AWS Direct Connect connection and a transit gateway. Associate the VPCs from both accounts with the transit gateway. Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0.
choices.C: Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection with two encrypted IPsec tunnels between the accounts. Set up interface VPC endpoints for Amazon S3.
choices.D: Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an S3 gateway endpoint. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow IAM principals from the primary account. Set up interface VPC endpoints for SageMaker and Amazon Redshift.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution must not require public IPv4 addresses. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Private service connectivity and cross-account authorization are separate requirements: VPC endpoints supply the network path, while IAM and bucket policies grant data access.

A. Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public access enabled in the primary account. Create a VPC peering connection between the accounts. Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0. — VPC peering does not by itself create a private route to S3 or grant permission to the other account's bucket. Removing the default route does not add the missing endpoint.

B. Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public access enabled in the primary account. Create an AWS Direct Connect connection and a transit gateway. Associate the VPCs from both accounts with the transit gateway. Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0. — Direct Connect and Transit Gateway add unnecessary networking and still do not alone authorize access to the S3 objects.

C. Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection with two encrypted IPsec tunnels between the accounts. Set up interface VPC endpoints for Amazon S3. — A VPN between AWS accounts is unnecessary for reaching S3 privately, and the option omits the cross-account bucket authorization and complete private service-access setup.

D. Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an S3 gateway endpoint. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow IAM principals from the primary account. Set up interface VPC endpoints for SageMaker and Amazon Redshift. — An S3 gateway endpoint provides private S3 access, and the bucket and identity policies can authorize the primary-account roles. Appropriate SageMaker and Redshift interface endpoints avoid needing public IPv4 addresses for those service APIs.

text: A company is using an AWS Lambda function to monitor the metrics from an ML model. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to send an email message when the metrics breach a threshold. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Log the metrics from the Lambda function to AWS CloudTrail. Configure a CloudTrail trail to send the email message.
choices.B: Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudFront. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to send the email message.
choices.C: Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudWatch. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to send the email message.
choices.D: Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudWatch. Configure an Amazon CloudFront rule to send the email message.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to send an email message when the metrics breach a threshold. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: CloudWatch evaluates metric thresholds, and an alarm notification action such as an SNS email subscription delivers the alert.

A. Log the metrics from the Lambda function to AWS CloudTrail. Configure a CloudTrail trail to send the email message. — CloudTrail audits API activity. It is not the service for publishing and alarming on arbitrary model-quality metric values.

B. Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudFront. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to send the email message. — CloudFront distributes cached content and does not receive Lambda metrics as a monitoring backend.

C. Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudWatch. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to send the email message. — Publish custom metrics to CloudWatch, or derive them from logs with metric filters, then create an alarm with an SNS email action and a confirmed subscription.

D. Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudWatch. Configure an Amazon CloudFront rule to send the email message. — CloudWatch is the correct metric destination, but CloudFront does not supply the proposed metric-threshold notification rule.

text: A company has used Amazon SageMaker to deploy a predictive ML model in production. The company is using SageMaker Model Monitor on the model. After a model update, an ML engineer notices data quality issues in the Model Monitor checks. What should the ML engineer do to mitigate the data quality issues that Model Monitor has identified?

choices.A: Adjust the model's parameters and hyperparameters.
choices.B: Initiate a manual Model Monitor job that uses the most recent production data.
choices.C: Create a new baseline from the latest dataset. Update Model Monitor to use the new baseline for evaluations.
choices.D: Include additional data in the existing training set for the model. Retrain and redeploy the model.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: After a model update, an ML engineer notices data quality issues in the Model Monitor checks. What should the ML engineer do to mitigate the data quality issues that Model Monitor has identified?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A monitoring baseline must represent valid expected input data for the deployed model. A violation after an update may indicate either a stale baseline or a real data-quality defect.

A. Adjust the model's parameters and hyperparameters. — Changing model parameters does not directly repair missing values, schema problems, or other defects in the incoming data.

B. Initiate a manual Model Monitor job that uses the most recent production data. — A manual monitoring job can help investigate the issue but does not itself correct the data or decide whether the baseline is outdated.

C. Create a new baseline from the latest dataset. Update Model Monitor to use the new baseline for evaluations. — Creating a new baseline is appropriate only after confirming that the updated dataset is valid and intentionally different. Automatically rebasing on faulty production data can conceal the problem, so the source's unconditional answer is not established.

D. Include additional data in the existing training set for the model. Retrain and redeploy the model. — Adding training data and retraining may address a modeling problem, but does not necessarily correct the specific input-quality violation or an outdated monitoring baseline.

notes: A new baseline is justified only if the changed input is valid and the previous baseline is stale. The prompt does not distinguish this from a real data-quality defect; automatically rebasing may hide bad data.
