text: A company has an ML model that generates text descriptions based on images that customers upload to the company's website. The images can be up to 50 MB in total size. An ML engineer decides to store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket. The ML engineer must implement a processing solution that can scale to accommodate changes in demand. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Create an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job to process all the images in the S3 bucket.
choices.B: Create an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint and a scaling policy. Run a script to make an inference request for each image.
choices.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster that uses Karpenter for auto scaling. Host the model on the EKS cluster. Run a script to make an inference request for each image.
choices.D: Create an AWS Batch job that uses an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Specify a list of images to process for each AWS Batch job.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must implement a processing solution that can scale to accommodate changes in demand. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Asynchronous Inference accepts S3-backed large requests, queues work, and supports endpoint scaling for workloads that do not require an immediate synchronous response.

A. Create an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job to process all the images in the S3 bucket. — Batch Transform is suitable for a collected offline dataset, but repeatedly starting jobs for newly uploaded customer images adds orchestration and startup delay.

B. Create an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint and a scaling policy. Run a script to make an inference request for each image. — The asynchronous endpoint can process the large image payloads from S3 and scale with queued demand, using managed hosting instead of a custom cluster.

C. Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster that uses Karpenter for auto scaling. Host the model on the EKS cluster. Run a script to make an inference request for each image. — EKS with Karpenter can scale model serving, but requires Kubernetes, container-serving, and queue or request-management operations.

D. Create an AWS Batch job that uses an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Specify a list of images to process for each AWS Batch job. — Batch can run inference containers, but requires custom batch construction, job submission, and result handling that asynchronous model hosting provides more directly.

analysis.keyConcept: Asynchronous Inference accepts S3-backed large requests, queues work, and supports endpoint scaling for workloads that do not require an immediate synchronous response.

options.B: The asynchronous endpoint can process the large image payloads from S3 and scale with queued demand, using managed hosting instead of a custom cluster.

text: An ML engineer needs to use AWS services to identify and extract meaningful unique keywords from documents. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.B: Use Amazon SageMaker and the BlazingText algorithm. Apply custom pre-processing steps for stemming and removal of stop words. Calculate term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) scores to identify and extract relevant keywords.
choices.C: Store the documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create AWS Lambda functions to process the documents and to run Python scripts for stemming and removal of stop words. Use bigram and trigram techniques to identify and extract relevant keywords.
choices.D: Use Amazon Comprehend custom entity recognition and key phrase extraction to identify and extract relevant keywords.

explanation:
Key Concept: Comprehend key-phrase extraction identifies meaningful phrases, and custom entity recognition can add domain-specific entity types when generic phrases are insufficient.

A. Use the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) library on Amazon EC2 instances for text pre-processing. Use the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to identify and extract relevant keywords. — NLTK on EC2 and LDA require preprocessing, infrastructure, and model configuration. LDA topics are not the same as a managed key-phrase extraction API.

B. Use Amazon SageMaker and the BlazingText algorithm. Apply custom pre-processing steps for stemming and removal of stop words. Calculate term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) scores to identify and extract relevant keywords. — BlazingText and custom TF-IDF processing introduce training or feature-code work that is unnecessary for the basic extraction capability.

C. Store the documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create AWS Lambda functions to process the documents and to run Python scripts for stemming and removal of stop words. Use bigram and trigram techniques to identify and extract relevant keywords. — Custom n-gram scripts produce candidate phrases but need additional filtering and scoring to identify meaningful keywords, increasing development work.

D. Use Amazon Comprehend custom entity recognition and key phrase extraction to identify and extract relevant keywords. — Comprehend provides the managed phrase-extraction capability directly. Add a custom entity recognizer only when the task needs domain-specific entities, since custom recognition still requires labeled examples.

text: A company needs to give its ML engineers appropriate access to training data. The ML engineers must access training data from only their own business group. The ML engineers must not be allowed to access training data from other business groups. The company uses a single AWS account and stores all the training data in Amazon S3 buckets. All ML model training occurs in Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will provide the ML engineers with the appropriate access?

choices.A: Enable S3 bucket versioning.
choices.B: Configure S3 Object Lock settings for each user.
choices.C: Add cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policies to the S3 buckets.
choices.D: Create IAM policies. Attach the policies to IAM users or IAM roles.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: All ML model training occurs in Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will provide the ML engineers with the appropriate access?

explanation:
Key Concept: IAM policies can scope each engineer's identity and SageMaker execution role to the S3 buckets or prefixes belonging to the correct business group.

A. Enable S3 bucket versioning. — Versioning preserves object versions. It does not determine which business group may read the objects.

B. Configure S3 Object Lock settings for each user. — Object Lock controls retention and deletion protection, not per-business-group authorization to read training data.

C. Add cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policies to the S3 buckets. — CORS controls browser cross-origin behavior. It is not an authorization boundary for S3 SDK access or SageMaker training jobs.

D. Create IAM policies. Attach the policies to IAM users or IAM roles. — Attach least-privilege S3 policies to the relevant users and execution roles, and ensure other policies do not grant broader access. This enforces the required group-specific resource access.

text: A company needs to host a custom ML model to perform forecast analysis. The forecast analysis will occur with predictable and sustained load during the same 2-hour period every day. Multiple invocations during the analysis period will require quick responses. The company needs AWS to manage the underlying infrastructure and any auto scaling activities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Schedule an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job by using AWS Lambda.
choices.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to use scheduled scaling.
choices.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference with provisioned concurrency.
choices.D: Run the model on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on Amazon EC2 with pod auto scaling.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs AWS to manage the underlying infrastructure and any auto scaling activities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: Serverless Inference manages serving infrastructure, while provisioned concurrency keeps a configured amount of capacity ready to avoid cold starts during known busy periods.

A. Schedule an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job by using AWS Lambda. — Batch Transform does not provide the quick interactive response path required for repeated requests during the two-hour window.

B. Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to use scheduled scaling. — EC2 scheduled scaling can match the timetable, but the company would still operate the serving instances and application rather than using managed model hosting.

C. Use Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference with provisioned concurrency. — Provisioned concurrency supplies ready serverless capacity for the predictable window, and supported scheduled or target-tracking scaling can adjust it without managing instances.

D. Run the model on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on Amazon EC2 with pod auto scaling. — EKS on EC2 adds cluster, node, and model-serving operations. Pod autoscaling does not remove those infrastructure responsibilities.

text: A company's ML engineer has deployed an ML model for sentiment analysis to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. The ML engineer needs to explain to company stakeholders how the model makes predictions. Which solution will provide an explanation for the model's predictions?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Model Monitor on the deployed model.
choices.B: Use SageMaker Clarify on the deployed model.
choices.C: Show the distribution of inferences from A/В testing in Amazon CloudWatch.
choices.D: Add a shadow endpoint. Analyze prediction differences on samples.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer needs to explain to company stakeholders how the model makes predictions. Which solution will provide an explanation for the model's predictions?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: Feature attribution explains how model inputs contribute to an individual output or to overall model behavior.

A. Use SageMaker Model Monitor on the deployed model. — Model Monitor detects drift and quality changes. A direct explainability analysis is needed to answer why the model made its predictions.

B. Use SageMaker Clarify on the deployed model. — Clarify can compute SHAP-based attributions for the deployed model using suitable input handling and a reference baseline. Check current customer eligibility before choosing it for a new deployment.

C. Show the distribution of inferences from A/В testing in Amazon CloudWatch. — A/B traffic or prediction distributions compare model behavior in aggregate; they do not explain the contribution of input features to a prediction.

D. Add a shadow endpoint. Analyze prediction differences on samples. — Shadow testing compares candidate outputs with the production model, but a difference between outputs is not itself a feature-level explanation.
notes: Service availability: SageMaker Clarify is closed to new customers; existing customers can continue using it. This answer describes its documented capabilities.

analysis.keyConcept: Feature attribution explains how model inputs contribute to an individual output or to overall model behavior.

text: An ML engineer is using Amazon SageMaker to train a deep learning model that requires distributed training. After some training attempts, the ML engineer observes that the instances are not performing as expected. The ML engineer identifies communication overhead between the training instances. What should the ML engineer do to MINIMIZE the communication overhead between the instances?

choices.A: Place the instances in the same VPC subnet. Store the data in a different AWS Region from where the instances are deployed.
choices.B: Place the instances in the same VPC subnet but in different Availability Zones. Store the data in a different AWS Region from where the instances are deployed.
choices.C: Place the instances in the same VPC subnet. Store the data in the same AWS Region and Availability Zone where the instances are deployed.
choices.D: Place the instances in the same VPC subnet. Store the data in the same AWS Region but in a different Availability Zone from where the instances are deployed.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer identifies communication overhead between the training instances. What should the ML engineer do to MINIMIZE the communication overhead between the instances?

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Colocating distributed workers reduces cross-AZ communication, and colocating data avoids avoidable transfer latency. A VPC subnet belongs to exactly one Availability Zone.

A. Place the instances in the same VPC subnet. Store the data in a different AWS Region from where the instances are deployed. — Keeping workers together helps, but storing their input in another Region adds network distance and transfer overhead.

B. Place the instances in the same VPC subnet but in different Availability Zones. Store the data in a different AWS Region from where the instances are deployed. — Instances in the same subnet cannot be in different Availability Zones. The proposed different-Region storage also adds avoidable transfer latency.

C. Place the instances in the same VPC subnet. Store the data in the same AWS Region and Availability Zone where the instances are deployed. — Workers in the same subnet share an AZ, reducing cross-AZ communication. Use same-Region data and same-AZ storage when the storage service is AZ-scoped; a standard S3 bucket is regional rather than located in one chosen AZ.

D. Place the instances in the same VPC subnet. Store the data in the same AWS Region but in a different Availability Zone from where the instances are deployed. — Same-Region storage is preferable to cross-Region access, but placing AZ-scoped storage in another AZ adds an avoidable network boundary.

text: A company is running ML models on premises by using custom Python scripts and proprietary datasets. The company is using PyTorch. The model building requires unique domain knowledge. The company needs to move the models to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

choices.A: Use SageMaker built-in algorithms to train the proprietary datasets.
choices.B: Use SageMaker script mode and premade images for ML frameworks.
choices.C: Build a container on AWS that includes custom packages and a choice of ML frameworks.

explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker script mode runs existing framework training code in a maintained framework container, preserving custom model logic with limited adaptation.

A. Use SageMaker built-in algorithms to train the proprietary datasets. — Switching to a built-in algorithm can require replacing the domain-specific architecture and training logic that the company already developed.

B. Use SageMaker script mode and premade images for ML frameworks. — A prebuilt PyTorch container plus script mode lets the company reuse its custom training script, adapting data paths, arguments, and artifact output to the managed training contract.

text: A company is using Amazon SageMaker and millions of files to train an ML model. Each file is several megabytes in size. The files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to improve training performance. Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST amount of time?

choices.A: Transfer the data to a new S3 bucket that provides S3 Express One Zone storage. Adjust the training job to use the new S3 bucket.
choices.B: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Link the file system to the existing S3 bucket. Adjust the training job to read from the file system.
choices.C: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Transfer the existing data to the file system. Adjust the training job to read from the file system.
choices.D: Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster. Link the Redis OSS cluster to the existing S3 bucket. Stream the data from the Redis OSS cluster directly to the training job.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to improve training performance. Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST amount of time?

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: FSx for Lustre provides a parallel file system with S3 data-repository integration, helping training workloads that repeatedly access many individual files.

A. Transfer the data to a new S3 bucket that provides S3 Express One Zone storage. Adjust the training job to use the new S3 bucket. — S3 Express One Zone can improve access performance, but this option requires moving the entire collection first. The S3-linked file system can expose the existing repository directly.

B. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Link the file system to the existing S3 bucket. Adjust the training job to read from the file system. — Linking FSx for Lustre to the existing bucket supplies a high-throughput file interface without first manually copying every object into a separate storage system.

C. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Transfer the existing data to the file system. Adjust the training job to read from the file system. — EFS provides shared files, but this approach requires transferring the existing collection and lacks the same purpose-built S3-linked parallel file-system path.

D. Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster. Link the Redis OSS cluster to the existing S3 bucket. Stream the data from the Redis OSS cluster directly to the training job. — Redis is an in-memory key-value store, not a file-system layer that automatically links millions of S3 training files as proposed. Building that cache would require substantial custom work.

text: A company wants to develop an ML model by using tabular data from its customers. The data contains meaningful ordered features with sensitive information that should not be discarded. An ML engineer must ensure that the sensitive data is masked before another team starts to build the model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon Made to categorize the sensitive data.
choices.B: Prepare the data by using AWS Glue DataBrew.
choices.C: Run an AWS Batch job to change the sensitive data to random values.
choices.D: Run an Amazon EMR job to change the sensitive data to random values.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must ensure that the sensitive data is masked before another team starts to build the model. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: Sensitive-data preparation should hide identifying content while preserving the feature properties needed by the model; the chosen masking method matters.

A. Use Amazon Made to categorize the sensitive data. — Macie can identify sensitive data but does not itself transform or mask the feature values for the next team.

B. Prepare the data by using AWS Glue DataBrew. — DataBrew offers configurable masking and protection transforms in a preparation recipe. Select a transformation that preserves the required meaning; arbitrary hashing or substitution does not automatically preserve numeric order.

C. Run an AWS Batch job to change the sensitive data to random values. — Replacing values with random data destroys the meaningful ordering and predictive relationships that the prompt requires retaining.

D. Run an Amazon EMR job to change the sensitive data to random values. — An EMR job that randomizes the fields has the same information-loss problem and adds cluster and processing-code overhead.

text: An ML engineer needs to deploy ML models to get inferences from large datasets in an asynchronous manner. The ML engineer also needs to implement scheduled monitoring of the data quality of the models. The ML engineer must receive alerts when changes in data quality occur. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Deploy the models by using scheduled AWS Glue jobs. Use Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor the data quality and to send alerts.
choices.B: Deploy the models by using scheduled AWS Batch jobs. Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor the data quality and to send alerts.
choices.C: Deploy the models by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. Use Amazon EventBridge to monitor the data quality and to send alerts.
choices.D: Deploy the models by using Amazon SageMaker batch transform. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to monitor the data quality and to send alerts.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must receive alerts when changes in data quality occur. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: asynchronous
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Batch Transform scores large offline datasets without a persistent endpoint, and Model Monitor can evaluate captured batch data on a schedule.

A. Deploy the models by using scheduled AWS Glue jobs. Use Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor the data quality and to send alerts. — Glue can run ETL code, but it is not the direct managed model-inference and data-quality monitoring combination described here. CloudWatch needs actual quality metrics to alarm on.

B. Deploy the models by using scheduled AWS Batch jobs. Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor the data quality and to send alerts. — Batch can run custom scoring, but CloudTrail records API events rather than computing dataset quality statistics or drift.

C. Deploy the models by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. Use Amazon EventBridge to monitor the data quality and to send alerts. — ECS can host custom inference containers, but EventBridge routes events; it does not compute data-quality changes by itself.

D. Deploy the models by using Amazon SageMaker batch transform. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to monitor the data quality and to send alerts. — Configure Batch Transform data capture, a Model Monitor baseline and schedule, and CloudWatch alarm actions. This provides managed offline scoring and notifications when quality constraints are violated.

text: An ML engineer normalized training data by using min-max normalization in AWS Glue DataBrew. The ML engineer must normalize the production inference data in the same way as the training data before passing the production inference data to the model for predictions. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Apply statistics from a well-known dataset to normalize the production samples.
choices.B: Keep the min-max normalization statistics from the training set. Use these values to normalize the production samples.
choices.C: Calculate a new set of min-max normalization statistics from a batch of production samples. Use these values to normalize all the production samples.
choices.D: Calculate a new set of min-max normalization statistics from each production sample. Use these values to normalize all the production samples.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must normalize the production inference data in the same way as the training data before passing the production inference data to the model for predictions. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Inference preprocessing must reuse the transformation fitted on training data so the model sees features in the same coordinate system.

A. Apply statistics from a well-known dataset to normalize the production samples. — Statistics from an unrelated dataset define a different scale and can shift inference features away from the representation the model learned.

B. Keep the min-max normalization statistics from the training set. Use these values to normalize the production samples. — Reuse each feature's training minimum and maximum in the inference formula. New values may legitimately fall outside the original zero-to-one range; do not silently refit the scale for them.

C. Calculate a new set of min-max normalization statistics from a batch of production samples. Use these values to normalize all the production samples. — Refitting normalization on a production batch changes the meaning of a scaled value and can make predictions depend on which other records share the batch.

D. Calculate a new set of min-max normalization statistics from each production sample. Use these values to normalize all the production samples. — A single sample cannot define a useful per-feature population range, and per-request refitting would be inconsistent with training normalization.

text: A company is planning to use Amazon SageMaker to make classification ratings that are based on images. The company has 6 ТВ of training data that is stored on an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP system virtual machine (SVM). The SVM is in the same VPC as SageMaker. An ML engineer must make the training data accessible for ML models that are in the SageMaker environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Mount the FSx for ONTAP file system as a volume to the SageMaker Instance.
choices.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to link the S3 bucket to the FSx for ONTAP file system.
choices.C: Create a catalog connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system.
choices.D: Create a direct connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must make the training data accessible for ML models that are in the SageMaker environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: FSx for ONTAP exposes network file protocols such as NFS, allowing an appropriately networked SageMaker notebook or supported compute environment to mount the existing volume.

A. Mount the FSx for ONTAP file system as a volume to the SageMaker Instance. — Mount the SVM's exported volume using the supported client protocol and appropriate routes, security groups, and export policy. This exposes the existing data without copying 6 TB; it is distinct from claiming native ONTAP support in every SageMaker training input mode.

B. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to link the S3 bucket to the FSx for ONTAP file system. — Mountpoint for S3 presents S3 objects as files to a client. It does not link an S3 bucket to an ONTAP volume or ingest its contents as described.

C. Create a catalog connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system. — A Data Wrangler catalog connection is not a filesystem mount for the ONTAP SVM and does not supply the proposed native ONTAP data source.

D. Create a direct connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system. — The proposed direct Data Wrangler-to-ONTAP connection is not the general mechanism for accessing an NFS volume from SageMaker compute.

text: A company regularly receives new training data from the vendor of an ML model. The vendor delivers cleaned and prepared data to the company's Amazon S3 bucket every 3-4 days. The company has an Amazon SageMaker pipeline to retrain the model. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to run the pipeline when new data is uploaded to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transfer the data to the SageMaker training instance and to initiate training.
choices.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the S3 bucket. Program the Lambda function to initiate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.
choices.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event pattern that matches the S3 upload. Configure the pipeline as the target of the rule.
choices.D: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to run the pipeline when new data is uploaded to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: EventBridge can match S3 object-created events and start an existing SageMaker pipeline through a native target integration.

A. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transfer the data to the SageMaker training instance and to initiate training. — S3 Lifecycle manages object transitions and expiration. It does not copy training data into a SageMaker instance or invoke a training pipeline.

B. Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the S3 bucket. Program the Lambda function to initiate the pipeline when new data is uploaded. — Polling S3 from Lambda adds scanning, state tracking, and scheduling code when an upload event can trigger the pipeline directly.

C. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event pattern that matches the S3 upload. Configure the pipeline as the target of the rule. — Enable the relevant S3 events and configure an EventBridge rule with the pipeline target and execution permissions, so each qualifying arrival starts retraining without a custom polling service.

D. Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the pipeline when new data is uploaded. — MWAA can orchestrate retraining but adds an Airflow environment and DAG management for a straightforward native event-triggered workflow.

analysis.keyConcept: EventBridge can match S3 object-created events and start an existing SageMaker pipeline through a native target integration.

options.B: Polling S3 from Lambda adds scanning, state tracking, and scheduling code when an upload event can trigger the pipeline directly.

text: An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model by using the Amazon SageMaker XGBoost algorithm. The model classifies transactions as either fraudulent or legitimate. During testing, the model excels at identifying fraud in the training dataset. However, the model is inefficient at identifying fraud in new and unseen transactions. What should the ML engineer do to improve the fraud detection for new transactions?

choices.A: Increase the learning rate.
choices.B: Remove some irrelevant features from the training dataset.
choices.C: Increase the value of the max_depth hyperparameter.
choices.D: Decrease the value of the max_depth hyperparameter.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: However, the model is inefficient at identifying fraud in new and unseen transactions. What should the ML engineer do to improve the fraud detection for new transactions?

explanation:
Key Concept: Strong training results with poor unseen-data performance indicate overfitting; limiting tree depth reduces the complexity of an XGBoost model.

A. Increase the learning rate. — A higher learning rate makes boosting updates more aggressive and does not directly constrain the overfitting trees.

B. Remove some irrelevant features from the training dataset. — Removing genuinely irrelevant features may help, but the prompt does not establish which features are irrelevant. Tree-depth control directly addresses model capacity.

C. Increase the value of the max_depth hyperparameter. — Deeper trees can fit more training-specific interactions and may worsen the observed generalization gap.

D. Decrease the value of the max_depth hyperparameter. — Reducing max_depth limits the interactions and partitions each tree can memorize, which can improve detection on unseen transactions when tuned on validation data.

text: A company wants to reduce the cost of its containerized ML applications. The applications use ML models that run on Amazon EC2 instances, AWS Lambda functions, and an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The EC2 workloads and ECS workloads use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to save predictions and artifacts. An ML engineer must identify resources that are being used inefficiently. The ML engineer also must generate recommendations to reduce the cost of these resources. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

choices.A: Create code to evaluate each instance's memory and compute usage.
choices.B: Add cost allocation tags to the resources. Activate the tags in AWS Billing and Cost Management.
choices.C: Check AWS CloudTrail event history for the creation of the resources.
choices.D: Run AWS Compute Optimizer.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer also must generate recommendations to reduce the cost of these resources. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization and generates resource-sizing recommendations for supported compute and storage resources.

A. Create code to evaluate each instance's memory and compute usage. — Custom utilization analysis requires collecting metrics, defining sizing rules, and maintaining recommendation code already provided by Compute Optimizer.

B. Add cost allocation tags to the resources. Activate the tags in AWS Billing and Cost Management. — Cost tags attribute spend to resources or teams but do not identify an appropriate smaller instance, memory size, or volume configuration by themselves.

C. Check AWS CloudTrail event history for the creation of the resources. — CloudTrail creation events establish when and by whom resources were created, not whether their current capacity is efficiently used.

D. Run AWS Compute Optimizer. — Compute Optimizer provides managed recommendations for supported EC2, EBS, Lambda, and ECS on Fargate resources. For ECS on EC2, assess the underlying EC2 capacity rather than assuming every ECS task has a direct recommendation.

analysis.keyConcept: Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization and generates resource-sizing recommendations for supported compute and storage resources.

options.B: Cost tags attribute spend to resources or teams but do not identify an appropriate smaller instance, memory size, or volume configuration by themselves.
options.C: CloudTrail creation events establish when and by whom resources were created, not whether their current capacity is efficiently used.

text: A company needs to create a central catalog for all the company's ML models. The models are in AWS accounts where the company developed the models initially. The models are hosted in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repositories. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Configure ECR cross-account replication for each existing ECR repository. Ensure that each model is visible in each AWS account.
choices.B: Create a new AWS account with a new ECR repository as the central catalog. Configure ECR cross-account replication between the initial ECR repositories and the central catalog.
choices.C: Use the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry to create a model group for models hosted in Amazon ECR. Create a new AWS account. In the new account, use the SageMaker Model Registry as the central catalog. Attach a cross-account resource policy to each model group in the initial AWS accounts.
choices.D: Use an AWS Glue Data Catalog to store the models. Run an AWS Glue crawler to migrate the models from the ECR repositories to the Data Catalog. Configure cross-account access to the Data Catalog.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The models are hosted in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repositories. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Model Registry catalogs model versions and supports cross-account discovery and access through resource policies, separately from storing the actual container images.

A. Configure ECR cross-account replication for each existing ECR repository. Ensure that each model is visible in each AWS account. — Replicating ECR images into every account creates many copies without supplying model-specific version metadata, approval state, or a central registry view.

B. Create a new AWS account with a new ECR repository as the central catalog. Configure ECR cross-account replication between the initial ECR repositories and the central catalog. — A central ECR repository centralizes container images but does not implement the full ML model catalog and lifecycle metadata.

C. Use the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry to create a model group for models hosted in Amazon ECR. Create a new AWS account. In the new account, use the SageMaker Model Registry as the central catalog. Attach a cross-account resource policy to each model group in the initial AWS accounts. — Register the models and configure model-group resource sharing so the central account can discover and access them. ECR, S3, and KMS permissions for the underlying artifacts remain separate from registry visibility.

D. Use an AWS Glue Data Catalog to store the models. Run an AWS Glue crawler to migrate the models from the ECR repositories to the Data Catalog. Configure cross-account access to the Data Catalog. — Glue Data Catalog stores dataset metadata. A crawler does not migrate ECR model containers into a model registry.

analysis.keyConcept: Model Registry catalogs model versions and supports cross-account discovery and access through resource policies, separately from storing the actual container images.

options.A: Replicating ECR images into every account creates many copies without supplying model-specific version metadata, approval state, or a central registry view.
options.B: A central ECR repository centralizes container images but does not implement the full ML model catalog and lifecycle metadata.
options.C: Register the models and configure model-group resource sharing so the central account can discover and access them. ECR, S3, and KMS permissions for the underlying artifacts remain separate from registry visibility.
options.D: Glue Data Catalog stores dataset metadata. A crawler does not migrate ECR model containers into a model registry.

text: A company has developed a new ML model. The company requires online model validation on 10% of the traffic before the company fully releases the model in production. The company uses an Amazon SageMaker endpoint behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to serve the model. Which solution will set up the required online validation with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Use production variants to add the new model to the existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 0.1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.
choices.B: Use production variants to add the new model to the existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.
choices.C: Create a new SageMaker endpoint. Use production variants to add the new model to the new endpoint. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.
choices.D: Configure the ALB to route 10% of the traffic to the new model at the existing SageMaker endpoint. Monitor the number of invocations by using AWS CloudTrail.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company uses an Amazon SageMaker endpoint behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to serve the model. Which solution will set up the required online validation with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker routes default inference requests according to each production variant's weight divided by the sum of all variant weights.

A. Use production variants to add the new model to the existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 0.1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch. — Add the candidate as a production variant and set weights in a 1:9 ratio, such as 0.1 for new and 0.9 for old. Setting only the new weight to 0.1 while leaving the old weight at 1 would yield about 9.09%, not exactly 10%.

B. Use production variants to add the new model to the existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch. — A new weight of 1 does not by itself imply a 10% share; it depends on the sum of the other weights and would give 50% against an old weight of 1.

C. Create a new SageMaker endpoint. Use production variants to add the new model to the new endpoint. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch. — A separate endpoint does not define how existing traffic reaches it, so an additional routing mechanism would be required.

D. Configure the ALB to route 10% of the traffic to the new model at the existing SageMaker endpoint. Monitor the number of invocations by using AWS CloudTrail. — An ALB cannot directly choose an internal SageMaker model variant by a target-group rule. Native production-variant weights provide the simpler routing control.
notes: Variant weights are relative. For exactly 10% traffic, use new:old weights of 0.1:0.9 or 1:9; new=0.1 with old=1 is approximately 9.09%.

analysis.keyConcept: SageMaker routes default inference requests according to each production variant's weight divided by the sum of all variant weights.

options.A: Add the candidate as a production variant and set weights in a 1:9 ratio, such as 0.1 for new and 0.9 for old. Setting only the new weight to 0.1 while leaving the old weight at 1 would yield about 9.09%, not exactly 10%.
options.B: A new weight of 1 does not by itself imply a 10% share; it depends on the sum of the other weights and would give 50% against an old weight of 1.
options.C: A separate endpoint does not define how existing traffic reaches it, so an additional routing mechanism would be required.
options.D: An ALB cannot directly choose an internal SageMaker model variant by a target-group rule. Native production-variant weights provide the simpler routing control.

text: A company needs to develop an ML model. The model must identify an item in an image and must provide the location of the item. Which Amazon SageMaker algorithm will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Image classification
choices.B: XGBoost
choices.C: Object detection
choices.D: K-nearest neighbors (k-NN)

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The model must identify an item in an image and must provide the location of the item. Which Amazon SageMaker algorithm will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Object detection predicts both an object's class and its location, typically as a bounding box.

A. Image classification — Image classification labels the whole image without necessarily locating the item within it.

B. XGBoost — XGBoost predicts from tabular features and does not directly produce image object locations without a separate vision pipeline.

C. Object detection — Object detection supplies the item label and bounding-box coordinates, directly meeting both identification and localization requirements.

D. K-nearest neighbors (k-NN) — k-NN classifies or regresses from feature vectors; it is not a built-in image localization model.

analysis.keyConcept: Object detection predicts both an object's class and its location, typically as a bounding box.

options.A: Image classification labels the whole image without necessarily locating the item within it.
options.B: XGBoost predicts from tabular features and does not directly produce image object locations without a separate vision pipeline.
options.C: Object detection supplies the item label and bounding-box coordinates, directly meeting both identification and localization requirements.
options.D: k-NN classifies or regresses from feature vectors; it is not a built-in image localization model.

An ML engineer must implement a solution that uses AWS Glue DataBrew to process the data. The ML engineer also must store the final output in Amazon S3 so that AWS Glue can consume the output in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use DataBrew to process the existing S3 folder. Store the output in Apache Parquet format.
choices.B: Use DataBrew to process the existing S3 folder. Store the output in AWS Glue Parquet format.
choices.C: Separate the data into a different folder for each file type. Use DataBrew to process each folder individually. Store the output in Apache Parquet format.
choices.D: Separate the data into a different folder for each file type. Use DataBrew to process each folder individually. Store the output in AWS Glue Parquet format.

explanation:
Key Concept: A DataBrew multi-file dataset expects a consistent file format and extension within its selected folder; Parquet is a supported interoperable analytical output.

A. Use DataBrew to process the existing S3 folder. Store the output in Apache Parquet format. — The output format is appropriate, but the mixed-format input folder does not meet the stated multi-file dataset requirements.

B. Use DataBrew to process the existing S3 folder. Store the output in AWS Glue Parquet format. — The mixed-format folder remains invalid for this input configuration, and AWS Glue Parquet is not a distinct required DataBrew output format.

Store the output in Apache Parquet format. — Separate the inputs by format, process each compatible dataset, and write standard Apache Parquet for later Glue consumption. Compatible schemas must also be handled explicitly.

D. Separate the data into a different folder for each file type. Use DataBrew to process each folder individually. Store the output in AWS Glue Parquet format. — Separating inputs is appropriate, but a Glue-specific Parquet file format is not required. Standard Apache Parquet is the interoperable output choice.

text: A manufacturing company uses an ML model to determine whether products meet a standard for quality. The model produces an output of "Passed" or "Failed." Robots separate the products into the two categories by using the model to analyze photos on the assembly line. Which metrics should the company use to evaluate the model's performance? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Precision and recall
choices.B: Root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE)
choices.C: Accuracy and F1 score
choices.D: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which metrics should the company use to evaluate the model's performance? (Choose two.)
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Passed versus failed is binary classification, so evaluation should measure class decisions rather than numeric forecast error or language quality.

A. Precision and recall — Precision and recall quantify the reliability and coverage of the chosen positive class, helping evaluate false accepts or missed defects depending on the label definition.

B. Root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) — RMSE and MAPE evaluate numeric regression errors. They are not the direct metrics for passed/failed class decisions.

C. Accuracy and F1 score — Accuracy measures overall correctness, and F1 balances precision and recall. Inspect class balance and error costs when interpreting them together.

D. Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score — BLEU evaluates overlap in generated or translated text, not manufacturing image classifications.

E. Perplexity — Perplexity evaluates probabilistic sequence prediction, usually for language models, rather than this binary quality-control task.

analysis.keyConcept: Passed versus failed is binary classification, so evaluation should measure class decisions rather than numeric forecast error or language quality.

options.A: Precision and recall quantify the reliability and coverage of the chosen positive class, helping evaluate false accepts or missed defects depending on the label definition.
options.B: RMSE and MAPE evaluate numeric regression errors. They are not the direct metrics for passed/failed class decisions.
options.C: Accuracy measures overall correctness, and F1 balances precision and recall. Inspect class balance and error costs when interpreting them together.
options.D: BLEU evaluates overlap in generated or translated text, not manufacturing image classifications.

text: An ML engineer needs to encrypt all data in transit when an ML training job runs. The ML engineer must ensure that encryption in transit is applied to processes that Amazon SageMaker uses during the training job. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Encrypt communication between nodes for batch processing.
choices.B: Encrypt communication between nodes in a training cluster.
choices.C: Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the training job request.
choices.D: Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the SageMaker domain.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must ensure that encryption in transit is applied to processes that Amazon SageMaker uses during the training job. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Distributed training exchanges tensors and other data between workers. Inter-container traffic encryption protects this communication separately from storage encryption.

A. Encrypt communication between nodes for batch processing. — A setting for a batch processing job does not enable encryption for workers in the training job.

B. Encrypt communication between nodes in a training cluster. — Enable inter-container traffic encryption on the training job to encrypt communication between training instances. SageMaker's service and S3 connections already use secure transport.

C. Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the training job request. — A KMS key on the training request controls supported storage encryption at rest. It does not enable inter-worker encryption in transit.

D. Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the SageMaker domain. — The domain's KMS key protects domain storage. It is not the training cluster's network encryption setting.

analysis.keyConcept: Distributed training exchanges tensors and other data between workers. Inter-container traffic encryption protects this communication separately from storage encryption.

options.A: A setting for a batch processing job does not enable encryption for workers in the training job.
options.B: Enable inter-container traffic encryption on the training job to encrypt communication between training instances. SageMaker's service and S3 connections already use secure transport.
options.C: A KMS key on the training request controls supported storage encryption at rest. It does not enable inter-worker encryption in transit.
options.D: The domain's KMS key protects domain storage. It is not the training cluster's network encryption setting.

text: An ML engineer needs to use metrics to assess the quality of a time-series forecasting model. Which metrics apply to this model? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Recall
choices.B: LogLoss
choices.C: Root mean square error (RMSE)
choices.D: InferenceLatency

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which metrics apply to this model? (Choose two.)
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Forecast quality is evaluated by prediction error and, for probabilistic forecasts, quantile loss. Operational latency is a separate concern.

A. Recall — Recall measures how many actual positives a classifier identifies. It does not measure numerical forecast error.

B. LogLoss — Log loss evaluates predicted class probabilities. It is not one of the numerical forecasting metrics requested here.

C. Root mean square error (RMSE) — RMSE summarizes squared prediction errors in the target's units and penalizes large forecasting errors strongly.

D. InferenceLatency — InferenceLatency measures serving speed. A fast forecast can still be inaccurate.

E. Average weighted quantile loss (wQL) — Weighted quantile loss evaluates forecast quantiles and their asymmetric penalties for underprediction and overprediction. Averaging across quantiles assesses probabilistic forecast quality.

analysis.keyConcept: Forecast quality is evaluated by prediction error and, for probabilistic forecasts, quantile loss. Operational latency is a separate concern.

options.A: Recall measures how many actual positives a classifier identifies. It does not measure numerical forecast error.
options.B: Log loss evaluates predicted class probabilities. It is not one of the numerical forecasting metrics requested here.
options.C: RMSE summarizes squared prediction errors in the target's units and penalizes large forecasting errors strongly.
options.D: InferenceLatency measures serving speed. A fast forecast can still be inaccurate.
options.E: Weighted quantile loss evaluates forecast quantiles and their asymmetric penalties for underprediction and overprediction. Averaging across quantiles assesses probabilistic forecast quality.

text: A company runs Amazon SageMaker ML models that use accelerated instances. The models require real-time responses. Each model has different scaling requirements. The company must not allow a cold start for the models. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint for each model. Use provisioned concurrency for the endpoints.
choices.B: Create a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint for each model. Create an auto scaling policy for each endpoint.
choices.C: Create a SageMaker endpoint. Create an inference component for each model. In the inference component settings, specify the newly created endpoint. Create an auto scaling policy for each inference component. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1.
choices.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Store all the model artifacts in the S3 bucket. Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint. Point the endpoint to the S3 bucket. Create an auto scaling policy for the endpoint. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must not allow a cold start for the models. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Inference components let models share a real-time endpoint while scaling their copies independently. Keeping a copy running avoids scale-from-zero startup for that model.

A. Create a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint for each model. Use provisioned concurrency for the endpoints. — Provisioned concurrency reduces serverless cold starts, but SageMaker Serverless Inference does not support the accelerated GPU instances required here.

B. Create a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint for each model. Create an auto scaling policy for each endpoint. — Asynchronous inference queues requests and returns results later. It does not provide the required synchronous real-time response.

C. Create a SageMaker endpoint. Create an inference component for each model. In the inference component settings, specify the newly created endpoint. Create an auto scaling policy for each inference component. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1. — Give each model an inference component and its own scaling policy. A minimum of one copy keeps each model resident, with sufficient endpoint capacity to support those copies.

D. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Store all the model artifacts in the S3 bucket. Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint. Point the endpoint to the S3 bucket. Create an auto scaling policy for the endpoint. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1. — A multi-model endpoint scales its shared fleet and can load or evict models on demand. An endpoint minimum does not guarantee a resident copy or independent scaling for every model.

analysis.keyConcept: Inference components let models share a real-time endpoint while scaling their copies independently. Keeping a copy running avoids scale-from-zero startup for that model.

options.A: Provisioned concurrency reduces serverless cold starts, but SageMaker Serverless Inference does not support the accelerated GPU instances required here.
options.B: Asynchronous inference queues requests and returns results later. It does not provide the required synchronous real-time response.
options.C: Give each model an inference component and its own scaling policy. A minimum of one copy keeps each model resident, with sufficient endpoint capacity to support those copies.
options.D: A multi-model endpoint scales its shared fleet and can load or evict models on demand. An endpoint minimum does not guarantee a resident copy or independent scaling for every model.

text: A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML process. A compliance audit discovers that an Amazon S3 bucket for training data uses server-side encryption with S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). The company requires customer managed keys. An ML engineer changes the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). The ML engineer makes no other configuration changes. After the change to the encryption settings, SageMaker training jobs start to fail with AccessDenied errors. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this problem?

choices.A: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject permissions.
choices.B: Update the S3 bucket policy that is attached to the S3 bucket. Set the value of the aws:SecureTransport condition key to True.
choices.C: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt permissions.
choices.D: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the user that created the training jobs. Include the kms:CreateGrant permission.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: After the change to the encryption settings, SageMaker training jobs start to fail with AccessDenied errors. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this problem?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Reading an SSE-KMS object requires authorization to use its KMS key as well as permission to read the S3 object.

A. Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject permissions. — The role already read the data before the encryption change. Adding S3 permissions alone cannot authorize decryption with the new KMS key.

B. Update the S3 bucket policy that is attached to the S3 bucket. Set the value of the aws:SecureTransport condition key to True. — SecureTransport governs HTTPS access to S3. It does not grant access to the encryption key.

C. Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt permissions. — Grant the training execution role KMS permissions on the customer managed key, especially kms:Decrypt for input reads, and ensure the key policy permits that role. Writing SSE-KMS outputs also requires the appropriate data-key permissions.

D. Update the IAM policy that is attached to the user that created the training jobs. Include the kms:CreateGrant permission. — The training job accesses data through its execution role, not the creating user's credentials. Giving that user CreateGrant does not fix the job's missing decryption permission.

analysis.keyConcept: Reading an SSE-KMS object requires authorization to use its KMS key as well as permission to read the S3 object.

options.A: The role already read the data before the encryption change. Adding S3 permissions alone cannot authorize decryption with the new KMS key.
options.B: SecureTransport governs HTTPS access to S3. It does not grant access to the encryption key.
options.C: Grant the training execution role KMS permissions on the customer managed key, especially kms:Decrypt for input reads, and ensure the key policy permits that role. Writing SSE-KMS outputs also requires the appropriate data-key permissions.
options.D: The training job accesses data through its execution role, not the creating user's credentials. Giving that user CreateGrant does not fix the job's missing decryption permission.

text: A company runs training jobs on Amazon SageMaker by using a compute optimized instance. Demand for training runs will remain constant for the next 55 weeks. The instance needs to run for 35 hours each week. The company needs to reduce its model training costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use a serverless endpoint with a provisioned concurrency of 35 hours for each week. Run the training on the endpoint.
choices.B: Use SageMaker Edge Manager for the training. Specify the instance requirement in the edge device configuration. Run the training.
choices.C: Use the heterogeneous cluster feature of SageMaker Training. Configure the instance_type, instance_count, and instance_groups arguments to run training jobs.
choices.D: Opt in to a SageMaker Savings Plan with a 1-year term and an All Upfront payment. Run a SageMaker Training job on the instance.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to reduce its model training costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Savings Plans commit spending for every hour of the term. A weekly workload total does not establish whether an hourly commitment will save money.

A. Use a serverless endpoint with a provisioned concurrency of 35 hours for each week. Run the training on the endpoint. — A serverless inference endpoint serves predictions; it does not run SageMaker training jobs or reserve training hours.

B. Use SageMaker Edge Manager for the training. Specify the instance requirement in the edge device configuration. Run the training. — Edge Manager is not a replacement for training on the specified compute instance. Configuring an edge device does not purchase discounted training capacity.

C. Use the heterogeneous cluster feature of SageMaker Training. Configure the instance_type, instance_count, and instance_groups arguments to run training jobs. — A heterogeneous training cluster can improve utilization when different tasks need different hardware. The question supplies no workload decomposition that demonstrates savings from this change.

D. Opt in to a SageMaker Savings Plan with a 1-year term and an All Upfront payment. Run a SageMaker Training job on the instance. — This is the source's intended answer, but 35 hours per week leaves most weekly hours idle. Unused hourly commitments do not carry over, so a one-year purchase is not justified without other eligible usage or a cost calculation. The key remains under review.
notes: Source selects D. A workload of 35 hours per week does not establish sufficient hourly utilization for a one-year Savings Plan to reduce total cost. Unused hourly commitment does not carry over.

text: A company deployed an ML model that uses the XGBoost algorithm to predict product failures. The model is hosted on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint and is trained on normal operating data. An AWS Lambda function provides the predictions to the company's application. An ML engineer must implement a solution that uses incoming live data to detect decreased model accuracy over time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to create a dashboard that monitors real-time inference data and model predictions. Use the dashboard to detect drift.
choices.B: Modify the Lambda function to calculate model drift by using real-time inference data and model predictions. Program the Lambda function to send alerts.
choices.C: Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Model Monitor. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints.
choices.D: Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Debugger. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must implement a solution that uses incoming live data to detect decreased model accuracy over time. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Data drift compares input distributions. Measuring decreased prediction accuracy requires ground-truth labels and model quality metrics, not just an input baseline.

A. Use Amazon CloudWatch to create a dashboard that monitors real-time inference data and model predictions. Use the dashboard to detect drift. — A dashboard can display predictions and operational metrics, but those values alone cannot establish whether predictions are correct.

B. Modify the Lambda function to calculate model drift by using real-time inference data and model predictions. Program the Lambda function to send alerts. — Custom drift calculations can detect distribution changes, but predictions and inputs without ground truth cannot measure actual accuracy loss.

C. Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Model Monitor. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints. — This is the intended data-drift solution. It detects violations of training-data statistics and constraints, not necessarily decreased accuracy. Model quality monitoring with ground truth is needed for the requirement as written.

D. Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Debugger. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints. — Debugger inspects training behavior and tensors. It is not the service for scheduled production data-drift monitoring, and it does not supply missing ground truth.
notes: Source selects C. Comparing input distributions detects data drift, not an observed decline in accuracy. Ground-truth labels and model quality monitoring are missing.

analysis.keyConcept: Data drift compares input distributions. Measuring decreased prediction accuracy requires ground-truth labels and model quality metrics, not just an input baseline.

options.B: Custom drift calculations can detect distribution changes, but predictions and inputs without ground truth cannot measure actual accuracy loss.
options.C: This is the intended data-drift solution. It detects violations of training-data statistics and constraints, not necessarily decreased accuracy. Model quality monitoring with ground truth is needed for the requirement as written.

text: A company has an ML model that uses historical transaction data to predict customer behavior. An ML engineer is optimizing the model in Amazon SageMaker to enhance the model's predictive accuracy. The ML engineer must examine the input data and the resulting predictions to identify trends that could skew the model's performance across different demographics. Which solution will provide this level of analysis?

choices.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor network metrics and CPU metrics for resource optimization during model training.
choices.B: Create AWS Glue DataBrew recipes to correct the data based on statistics from the model output.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Clarify to evaluate the model and training data for underlying patterns that might affect accuracy.
choices.D: Create AWS Lambda functions to automate data pre-processing and to ensure consistent quality of input data for the model.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must examine the input data and the resulting predictions to identify trends that could skew the model's performance across different demographics. Which solution will provide this level of analysis?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: Bias analysis compares data and predictions across demographic facets. It differs from general model accuracy and infrastructure monitoring.

A. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor network metrics and CPU metrics for resource optimization during model training. — CPU and network metrics describe resource use, not demographic representation or differences in model outcomes.

B. Create AWS Glue DataBrew recipes to correct the data based on statistics from the model output. — DataBrew can transform data, but a cleaning recipe does not provide the requested pre-training and post-training bias assessment.

C. Use SageMaker Clarify to evaluate the model and training data for underlying patterns that might affect accuracy. — Clarify provides bias metrics for training data and model predictions across specified facets. These metrics help investigate demographic disparities; service availability must be checked because Clarify is closed to new customers.

D. Create AWS Lambda functions to automate data pre-processing and to ensure consistent quality of input data for the model. — Preprocessing consistency is useful, but a Lambda function is not a built-in demographic bias analysis and would need a custom implementation.
notes: Service availability: SageMaker Clarify is closed to new customers; existing customers can continue using it. This answer describes its documented capabilities.

text: A company uses 10 Reserved Instances of accelerated instance types to serve the current version of an ML model. An ML engineer needs to deploy a new version of the model to an Amazon SageMaker real-time inference endpoint. The solution must use the original 10 instances to serve both versions of the model. The solution also must include one additional Reserved Instance that is available to use in the deployment process. The transition between versions must occur with no downtime or service interruptions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Configure a blue/green deployment with all-at-once traffic shifting.
choices.B: Configure a blue/green deployment with canary traffic shifting and a size of 10%.
choices.C: Configure a shadow test with a traffic sampling percentage of 10%.
choices.D: Configure a rolling deployment with a rolling batch size of 1.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The transition between versions must occur with no downtime or service interruptions. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A rolling deployment replaces an endpoint fleet in small batches, limiting temporary extra capacity compared with a full blue/green fleet.

A. Configure a blue/green deployment with all-at-once traffic shifting. — Blue/green deployment provisions a replacement fleet before switching traffic. It needs more than one additional instance for this ten-instance endpoint.

B. Configure a blue/green deployment with canary traffic shifting and a size of 10%. — A 10% canary controls traffic shifting; it does not reduce the green fleet to one temporary instance.

C. Configure a shadow test with a traffic sampling percentage of 10%. — A shadow test sends copies of requests to a separate variant for evaluation. It does not perform the required fleet replacement with one spare instance.

D. Configure a rolling deployment with a rolling batch size of 1. — A batch size of one replaces the ten-instance fleet incrementally and uses one additional instance during each step. Configure rollback capacity consistently as well. Rolling deployment replaces hosts; it does not guarantee reuse of the same physical instances.
notes: D matches the one-instance temporary capacity limit. Rolling deployments replace hosts; they do not promise reuse of the original physical instances. Configure rollback batch capacity consistently.

text: An IoT company uses Amazon SageMaker to train and test an XGBoost model for object detection. ML engineers need to monitor performance metrics when they train the model with variants in hyperparameters. The ML engineers also need to send Short Message Service (SMS) text messages after training is complete. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for message delivery.
choices.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery.
choices.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for message delivery.
choices.D: Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery.

hint:

explanation:
Key Concept: CloudWatch collects training metrics, while SNS can deliver SMS notifications. A training completion event can trigger the notification workflow.

A. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for message delivery. — CloudWatch is appropriate for metrics, but SQS provides a queue for consumers rather than direct SMS delivery.

B. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery. — Use CloudWatch for emitted training metrics and SNS for SMS. A completion event, such as an EventBridge training-state event, can publish the notification.

C. Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for message delivery. — CloudTrail records API activity rather than training performance, and SQS does not directly send SMS messages.

D. Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery. — SNS supplies SMS delivery, but CloudTrail is an audit trail and does not replace CloudWatch training metrics.
