text: A company is working on an ML project that will include Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. An ML engineer must ensure that the SageMaker notebook instances do not allow root access. Which solution will prevent the deployment of notebook instances that allow root access?

choices.A: Use IAM condition keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
choices.B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
choices.C: Monitor resource creation by using Amazon EventBridge events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
choices.D: Monitor resource creation by using AWS CloudFormation events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must ensure that the SageMaker notebook instances do not allow root access. Which solution will prevent the deployment of notebook instances that allow root access?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: IAM conditions can enforce notebook configuration before a create or update request succeeds.

A. Use IAM condition keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access. — Enforce sagemaker:RootAccess = Disabled for notebook creation and updates. The policy must cover all applicable permission paths so another grant cannot bypass the restriction.

B. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access. — KMS controls cryptographic keys. It does not evaluate the RootAccess parameter of notebook creation requests.

C. Monitor resource creation by using Amazon EventBridge events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access. — Deleting a notebook after an event is reactive remediation. The noncompliant resource has already been deployed.

D. Monitor resource creation by using AWS CloudFormation events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access. — A deletion function reacting to CloudFormation activity also runs after creation and does not prevent notebooks created through other permitted paths.

text: A company is using Amazon SageMaker to develop ML models. The company stores sensitive training data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The model training must have network isolation from the internet. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create a NAT gateway. Route traffic for training through the NAT gateway.
choices.B: Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create an S3 gateway VPC endpoint. Route traffic for training through the S3 gateway VPC endpoint.
choices.C: Run the SageMaker training jobs in public subnets that have an attached security group. In the security group, use inbound rules to limit traffic from the internet. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
choices.D: Encrypt traffic to Amazon S3 by using a bucket policy that includes a value of True for the aws:SecureTransport condition key. Use default at-rest encryption for Amazon S3. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The model training must have network isolation from the internet. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Private subnets without an internet egress route can access S3 through a gateway VPC endpoint. This is distinct from the stricter SageMaker container network-isolation setting.

A. Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create a NAT gateway. Route traffic for training through the NAT gateway. — A NAT gateway provides outbound internet access, which conflicts with the required isolation.

B. Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create an S3 gateway VPC endpoint. Route traffic for training through the S3 gateway VPC endpoint. — Use private training subnets with an S3 gateway endpoint and no internet egress route. The endpoint provides private access to training data without a NAT gateway.

C. Run the SageMaker training jobs in public subnets that have an attached security group. In the security group, use inbound rules to limit traffic from the internet. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). — Inbound security-group rules and disk encryption do not remove outbound internet access. A public-subnet design does not establish the requested isolation.

D. Encrypt traffic to Amazon S3 by using a bucket policy that includes a value of True for the aws:SecureTransport condition key. Use default at-rest encryption for Amazon S3. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). — Encryption protects data in transit and at rest, but encrypted traffic can still traverse the internet. Routing and network controls are missing.

analysis.keyConcept: Private subnets without an internet egress route can access S3 through a gateway VPC endpoint. This is distinct from the stricter SageMaker container network-isolation setting.

options.A: A NAT gateway provides outbound internet access, which conflicts with the required isolation.
options.B: Use private training subnets with an S3 gateway endpoint and no internet egress route. The endpoint provides private access to training data without a NAT gateway.
options.C: Inbound security-group rules and disk encryption do not remove outbound internet access. A public-subnet design does not establish the requested isolation.
options.D: Encryption protects data in transit and at rest, but encrypted traffic can still traverse the internet. Routing and network controls are missing.

text: A company needs an AWS solution that will automatically create versions of ML models as the models are created. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)
choices.B: Model packages from Amazon SageMaker Marketplace

explanation:

text: A company needs to use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to supplement an open source large language model (LLM) that runs on Amazon Bedrock. The company's data for RAG is a set of documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. The documents consist of .csv files and .docx files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Create a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to generate a new model. Call the new model from Amazon Bedrock to perform RAG queries.
choices.B: Convert the data into vectors. Store the data in an Amazon Neptune database. Connect the database to Amazon Bedrock. Call the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries.
choices.C: Fine-tune an existing LLM by using an AutoML job in Amazon SageMaker. Configure the S3 bucket as a data source for the AutoML job. Deploy the LLM to a SageMaker endpoint. Use the endpoint to perform RAG queries.
choices.D: Create a knowledge base for Amazon Bedrock. Configure a data source that references the S3 bucket. Use the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The documents consist of .csv files and .docx files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

explanation:
Key Concept: Retrieval Augmented Generation supplies retrieved document passages to a model at inference time. Bedrock Knowledge Bases manages ingestion and retrieval for supported sources.

A. Create a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to generate a new model. Call the new model from Amazon Bedrock to perform RAG queries. — Training a new model does not establish document retrieval. Building a separate training pipeline adds work without providing the requested RAG workflow.

B. Convert the data into vectors. Store the data in an Amazon Neptune database. Connect the database to Amazon Bedrock. Call the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries. — A custom vector conversion and database integration requires more implementation than a managed knowledge base. Merely connecting Neptune does not define a complete RAG workflow.

C. Fine-tune an existing LLM by using an AutoML job in Amazon SageMaker. Configure the S3 bucket as a data source for the AutoML job. Deploy the LLM to a SageMaker endpoint. Use the endpoint to perform RAG queries. — Fine-tuning changes model parameters and is not a substitute for retrieving current documents. This option also moves inference to a different service.

D. Create a knowledge base for Amazon Bedrock. Configure a data source that references the S3 bucket. Use the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries. — A Bedrock knowledge base can ingest supported CSV and DOCX files from S3 and expose retrieval or retrieval-plus-generation APIs. This minimizes the custom ingestion and retrieval code.

text: A company plans to deploy an ML model for production inference on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. The average inference payload size will vary from 100 MB to 300 MB. Inference requests must be processed in 60 minutes or less. Which SageMaker inference option will meet these requirements?

text: An ML engineer notices class imbalance in an image classification training job. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this issue?

choices.A: Reduce the size of the dataset.
choices.B: Transform some of the images in the dataset.
choices.C: Apply random oversampling on the dataset.
choices.D: Apply random data splitting on the dataset.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer notices class imbalance in an image classification training job. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this issue?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: class imbalance
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Oversampling increases the representation of minority classes in the training set. Evaluation data should retain its natural distribution.

A. Reduce the size of the dataset. — Reducing the whole dataset does not necessarily change class proportions. Targeted majority undersampling could help, but this option does not specify it.

B. Transform some of the images in the dataset. — Image transformations alone do not correct class counts. Targeted augmentation of minority classes could help, but arbitrary transformations are insufficient.

C. Apply random oversampling on the dataset. — Randomly oversample minority-class training examples to reduce imbalance. Apply resampling only after the train/test split to avoid duplicate leakage into evaluation.

D. Apply random data splitting on the dataset. — Random splitting partitions existing data. It does not create additional minority-class training examples or rebalance the classes.

text: A company receives daily .csv files about customer interactions with its ML model. The company stores the files in Amazon S3 and uses the files to retrain the model. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to mask credit card numbers in the files before the model is retrained. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

choices.A: Create a discovery job in Amazon Macie. Configure the job to find and mask sensitive data.
choices.B: Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Use the Sensitive Data Detection functionality in AWS Glue to find and mask sensitive data.
choices.C: Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Program the code to perform a regex operation to find and mask sensitive data.
choices.D: Create Apache Spark code to run on an Amazon EC2 instance. Program the code to perform an operation to find and mask sensitive data.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to mask credit card numbers in the files before the model is retrained. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Glue Sensitive Data Detection combines managed entity recognition with masking actions in a distributed ETL job.

A. Create a discovery job in Amazon Macie. Configure the job to find and mask sensitive data. — Macie discovers and reports sensitive data in S3. It does not automatically rewrite the CSV files with masked card numbers.

B. Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Use the Sensitive Data Detection functionality in AWS Glue to find and mask sensitive data. — Use Glue's credit-card detection and redaction actions in the Spark job, then train on the sanitized output. Built-in detection avoids writing and maintaining the matching logic.

C. Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Program the code to perform a regex operation to find and mask sensitive data. — Custom regular expressions can work, but the engineer must implement detection, masking, and edge-case handling that Glue already provides.

D. Create Apache Spark code to run on an Amazon EC2 instance. Program the code to perform an operation to find and mask sensitive data. — This adds both custom detection code and EC2/Spark infrastructure management, increasing development and operational effort.

choices.C: Use Amazon Textract to extract the entities. Use Amazon Comprehend to convert the entities to text. Store the output in Amazon S3.
choices.D: Use Amazon Textract integrated with Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.

explanation:
Key Concept: Custom entity recognition in Comprehend can analyze supported PDF documents. Pretrained entity detection and custom document input have different input requirements.

A. Use Amazon Comprehend to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3. — Use an appropriately configured Comprehend custom entity recognizer for PDF input and save its structured output to S3. This avoids building a separate OCR and entity-recognition stack.

D. Use Amazon Textract integrated with Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3. — Textract with human review can validate extracted document content, but it does not replace the requested semantic entity-recognition model.

text: A company shares Amazon SageMaker Studio notebooks that are accessible through a VPN. The company must enforce access controls to prevent malicious actors from exploiting presigned URLs to access the notebooks. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Set up Studio client IP validation by using the aws:sourceIp IAM policy condition.
choices.B: Set up Studio client VPC validation by using the aws:sourceVpc IAM policy condition.
choices.C: Set up Studio client role endpoint validation by using the aws:PrimaryTag IAM policy condition.
choices.D: Set up Studio client user endpoint validation by using the aws:PrincipalTag IAM policy condition.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must enforce access controls to prevent malicious actors from exploiting presigned URLs to access the notebooks. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: A Studio presigned URL must be constrained by an appropriate client network condition. VPN use alone does not imply that requests traverse a Studio VPC endpoint.

A. Set up Studio client IP validation by using the aws:sourceIp IAM policy condition. — Restrict access with aws:SourceIp using the allowed VPN egress addresses. This is the intended control for a known client IP range; verify that URL creation and access use the expected network path.

B. Set up Studio client VPC validation by using the aws:sourceVpc IAM policy condition. — aws:SourceVpc is suitable when the request uses the required VPC endpoint context. Simply stating that users connect through a VPN does not establish that context.

C. Set up Studio client role endpoint validation by using the aws:PrimaryTag IAM policy condition. — aws:PrimaryTag is not the IAM global condition key for this purpose. It cannot validate a client's network location.

D. Set up Studio client user endpoint validation by using the aws:PrincipalTag IAM policy condition. — Principal tags describe the caller's identity attributes. They do not bind use of a presigned URL to the approved client IP range.

text: An ML engineer needs to merge and transform data from two sources to retrain an existing ML model. One data source consists of .csv files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each .csv file consists of millions of records. The other data source is an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. The result of the merge process must be written to a second S3 bucket. The ML engineer needs to perform this merge-and-transform task every week. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Create a transient Amazon EMR cluster every week. Use the cluster to run an Apache Spark job to merge and transform the data.
choices.B: Create a weekly AWS Glue job that uses the Apache Spark engine. Use DynamicFrame native operations to merge and transform the data.
choices.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs Apache Spark code every week to merge and transform the data. Configure the Lambda function to connect to the initial S3 bucket and the DB cluster.
choices.D: Create an AWS Batch job that runs Apache Spark code on Amazon EC2 instances every week. Configure the Spark code to save the data from the EC2 instances to the second S3 bucket.

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: AWS Glue provides managed Spark ETL with S3 and JDBC inputs, distributed joins, and scheduled execution.

A. Create a transient Amazon EMR cluster every week. Use the cluster to run an Apache Spark job to merge and transform the data. — An EMR Spark job can perform the transformation, but creating and configuring a cluster each week requires more management than Glue.

B. Create a weekly AWS Glue job that uses the Apache Spark engine. Use DynamicFrame native operations to merge and transform the data. — A scheduled Glue Spark job can read the S3 files and Aurora through JDBC, join and transform the records, and write to the destination bucket. Configure connectivity and database credentials for the job.

C. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs Apache Spark code every week to merge and transform the data. Configure the Lambda function to connect to the initial S3 bucket and the DB cluster. — Lambda has a short maximum invocation duration and is not a managed distributed Spark runtime. It is a poor fit for joining millions of records this way.

D. Create an AWS Batch job that runs Apache Spark code on Amazon EC2 instances every week. Configure the Spark code to save the data from the EC2 instances to the second S3 bucket. — Batch can orchestrate custom compute, but the engineer must package and manage the Spark execution environment rather than use a managed ETL job.

text: An ML engineer has deployed an Amazon SageMaker model to a serverless endpoint in production. The model is invoked by the InvokeEndpoint API operation. The model's latency in production is higher than the baseline latency in the test environment. The ML engineer thinks that the increase in latency is because of model startup time. What should the ML engineer do to confirm or deny this hypothesis?

choices.A: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job. Observe metrics about model quality.
choices.B: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job with Amazon CloudWatch metrics enabled.
choices.C: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelSetupTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.
choices.D: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelLoadingWaitTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer thinks that the increase in latency is because of model startup time. What should the ML engineer do to confirm or deny this hypothesis?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: serverless
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Serverless startup latency is exposed through ModelSetupTime. Multi-model loading metrics describe a different hosting mechanism.

A. Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job. Observe metrics about model quality. — Model quality metrics concern prediction correctness. They do not isolate serverless container startup time.

B. Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job with Amazon CloudWatch metrics enabled. — Enabling CloudWatch output for a Model Monitor job does not turn that job into a serverless startup-latency monitor.

C. Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelSetupTime metric in the SageMaker namespace. — Inspect the serverless endpoint's ModelSetupTime metric and compare it with observed latency. It reports the time needed to prepare compute resources for invocation.

text: An ML engineer needs to ensure that a dataset complies with regulations for personally identifiable information (PII). choices.B: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.
choices.C: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to cleanse the dataset of PII. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.

explanation:

Access the S3 bucket from the SageMaker instances for model training. — This is the source's intended architecture, but the named API does not redact text. Mount the S3 bucket to the SageMaker instances for model training. — Macie reports sensitive-data findings rather than rewriting every affected object. text: A company must install a custom script on any newly created Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Create a lifecycle configuration script to install the custom script when a new SageMaker notebook is created. Attach the lifecycle configuration to every new SageMaker notebook as part of the creation steps.
choices.B: Create a custom Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) image that contains the custom script. Push the ECR image to a Docker registry. Attach the Docker image to a SageMaker Studio domain. Select the kernel to run as part of the SageMaker notebook.
choices.C: Create a custom package index repository. Use AWS CodeArtifact to manage the installation of the custom script. Set up AWS PrivateLink endpoints to connect CodeArtifact to the SageMaker instance. Install the script.
choices.D: Store the custom script in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the custom script on new SageMaker notebooks. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function when a new SageMaker notebook is initialized.

- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: A company must install a custom script on any newly created Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

explanation:
Key Concept: Notebook instance lifecycle configurations run scripts when an instance is created or started. They automate instance-specific setup.

A. Create a lifecycle configuration script to install the custom script when a new SageMaker notebook is created. Attach the lifecycle configuration to every new SageMaker notebook as part of the creation steps. — Attach a lifecycle configuration with an OnCreate script to each new notebook instance. The script can install the required custom component during provisioning.

B. Create a custom Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) image that contains the custom script. Push the ECR image to a Docker registry. Attach the Docker image to a SageMaker Studio domain. Select the kernel to run as part of the SageMaker notebook. — Custom Studio images configure Studio applications, whereas the question concerns SageMaker notebook instances. These are different resource types.

C. Create a custom package index repository. Use AWS CodeArtifact to manage the installation of the custom script. Set up AWS PrivateLink endpoints to connect CodeArtifact to the SageMaker instance. Install the script. — CodeArtifact can distribute packages, but it does not by itself run installation on every newly created notebook instance.

D. Store the custom script in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the custom script on new SageMaker notebooks. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function when a new SageMaker notebook is initialized. — An event-driven installer would require additional orchestration and a way to execute commands on the instance. Lifecycle configuration already provides the required hook.

text: A medical company needs to store clinical data. The data includes personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI). An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to ensure that the PII and PHI are not used to train ML models. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Store the clinical data in Amazon S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.
choices.B: Upload the clinical data to an Amazon Redshift database. Use built-in SQL stored procedures to automatically classify and mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.
choices.C: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect and mask the PII before the data is used for model training. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and mask the PHI before the data is used for model training.
choices.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the PII and PHI. Program the Lambda function to save the encrypted data to an Amazon S3 bucket for model training.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to ensure that the PII and PHI are not used to train ML models. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: De-identification requires detecting relevant sensitive fields or text spans and actually removing or masking them before training. The appropriate tool depends on the data format.

A. Store the clinical data in Amazon S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training. — DataBrew can mask sensitive fields in structured data. Without specifying whether the clinical data is structured or free text, this cannot be ruled out categorically.

B. Upload the clinical data to an Amazon Redshift database. Use built-in SQL stored procedures to automatically classify and mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training. — Redshift can execute SQL transformations, but it does not automatically classify all PII and PHI through unspecified built-in stored procedures.

C. Use Amazon Comprehend to detect and mask the PII before the data is used for model training. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and mask the PHI before the data is used for model training. — Comprehend and Comprehend Medical are appropriate detectors for general and clinical text. Comprehend Medical returns PHI locations rather than masked text, so an explicit redaction step is needed. The missing format and masking details prevent a unique confirmed answer.

D. Create an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the PII and PHI. Program the Lambda function to save the encrypted data to an Amazon S3 bucket for model training. — Encryption protects confidentiality but is not the same as removing sensitive features from training data. A job that decrypts the data would still receive the original PII and PHI.

choices.B: Build a custom Docker container that includes the required libraries. Host the container in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use the ECR image in the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.
choices.C: Create a SageMaker notebook instance to host the jobs. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the libraries on the notebook instance when the notebook instance starts. Configure the SageMaker jobs and pipelines to run on the notebook instance.
choices.D: Run code for the libraries externally on Amazon EC2 instances. Store the results in Amazon S3. Import the results into the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.

hint:

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A versioned container image makes custom dependencies reproducible across managed processing and training jobs. Pipelines references the images used by its job steps.

Use the ECR image in the SageMaker jobs and pipelines. — Package the required libraries in a SageMaker-compatible image, push it to ECR, and reference it in the relevant job steps. Respect the processing and training container entry-point contracts.

Configure the SageMaker jobs and pipelines to run on the notebook instance. — Managed processing and training jobs do not run inside the notebook instance. Installing libraries on that notebook does not install them in separate job containers.

D. Run code for the libraries externally on Amazon EC2 instances. Store the results in Amazon S3. Import the results into the SageMaker jobs and pipelines. — External EC2 execution adds a second execution environment and data-transfer workflow instead of making the libraries available inside the requested SageMaker jobs.

choices.B: Integrate the SageMaker endpoint with a SageMaker Clarify processing job. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to provide alerts.

explanation:

A. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm and a corresponding action to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification. — A CloudWatch alarm and SNS action can deliver alerts, but this option does not create the data-quality detector or the metric it must evaluate.

text: A company needs to use Amazon SageMaker to train a model on more than 300 GB of data. The training data is composed of files that are 200 MB in size. The data is stored in Amazon S3 Standard storage and feeds a dashboard tool. Which SageMaker training ingestion mechanism is the MOST cost-effective solution for this scenario?

choices.A: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system
choices.B: Amazon FSx for Lustre file system
choices.C: Amazon S3 in fast file mode while using S3 Express One Zone
choices.D: Amazon S3 in fast file mode without using S3 Express One Zone

hint:

explanation:
Key Concept: FastFile mode lets training code access S3 data through a file-system interface while streaming content on demand, avoiding a separate shared file system.

A. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system — EFS would add file-system storage and a data-copy path despite the data already being available in S3.

B. Amazon FSx for Lustre file system — FSx for Lustre can improve throughput for demanding workloads, but adds file-system cost and provisioning without a stated performance requirement that justifies it.

C. Amazon S3 in fast file mode while using S3 Express One Zone — S3 Express One Zone can improve access performance, but moving this existing Standard dataset to a new storage tier is not required by the scenario.

D. Amazon S3 in fast file mode without using S3 Express One Zone — Use FastFile with the existing S3 Standard objects. The relatively large files are suitable for efficient streaming, and this avoids extra file-system infrastructure or a storage-tier migration. Actual cost still depends on the access pattern.

text: A company has an ML model that is deployed to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference. The company needs to deploy a new model. The company must compare the new model’s performance to the currently deployed model’s performance before shifting all traffic to the new model. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.A: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Manually split traffic between the two endpoints.
choices.B: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute traffic between the two endpoints.
choices.C: Deploy the new model as a shadow variant on the same endpoint as the current model. Route a portion of live traffic to the shadow model for evaluation.
choices.D: Use AWS Lambda functions with custom logic to route traffic between the current model and the new model.

hint:

explanation:
Key Concept: A shadow variant evaluates a candidate model on copies of production requests while the production variant continues to return responses to users.

A. Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Manually split traffic between the two endpoints. — A second endpoint and manual traffic distribution require custom routing and expose users to the candidate when traffic is split.

B. Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute traffic between the two endpoints. — CloudFront is not a model-comparison mechanism. Configuring distribution and routing adds work without the managed shadow-evaluation behavior.

C. Deploy the new model as a shadow variant on the same endpoint as the current model. Route a portion of live traffic to the shadow model for evaluation. — Deploy the candidate as a shadow variant, capture its results, and compare them with production results before promotion. Shadow responses are not returned to clients.

D. Use AWS Lambda functions with custom logic to route traffic between the current model and the new model. — Custom Lambda routing requires implementation and maintenance that SageMaker shadow testing already handles.

The company has new compliance rules that prohibit the collection of aggregated metadata from training jobs. Which solution will prevent SageMaker from collecting metadata from the training jobs?

choices.A: Opt out of metadata tracking for any training job that is submitted.
choices.B: Ensure that training jobs are running in a private subnet in a custom VPC.
choices.C: Encrypt the training data with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
choices.D: Reconfigure the training jobs to use only AWS Nitro instances.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company has new compliance rules that prohibit the collection of aggregated metadata from training jobs. Which solution will prevent SageMaker from collecting metadata from the training jobs?

explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker training metadata collection has an explicit per-job opt-out in the job creation request.

A. Opt out of metadata tracking for any training job that is submitted. — Set the documented opt-out for every submitted training job, such as Environment.OPT_OUT_TRACKING = '1' in CreateTrainingJob. Setting it only inside the training script is insufficient.

B. Ensure that training jobs are running in a private subnet in a custom VPC. — Private subnet placement controls network connectivity. It does not express the service-level metadata collection preference.

C. Encrypt the training data with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. — A customer managed KMS key protects data encryption, not the collection of usage and error metadata.

D. Reconfigure the training jobs to use only AWS Nitro instances. — Nitro provides compute isolation and hardware capabilities. Instance hardware does not replace the metadata opt-out setting.

analysis.keyConcept: SageMaker training metadata collection has an explicit per-job opt-out in the job creation request.

text: A company is exploring generative AI and wants to add a new product feature. An ML engineer is making API calls from existing Amazon EC2 instances to Amazon Bedrock. The EC2 instances are in a private subnet and must remain private during the implementation. The EC2 instances have an assigned security group that allows access to all IP addresses in the private subnet. What should the ML engineer do to establish a connection between the EC2 instances and Amazon Bedrock?

choices.A: Modify the security group to allow inbound and outbound traffic to and from Amazon Bedrock.
choices.B: Use AWS PrivateLink to access Amazon Bedrock through an interface VPC endpoint.
choices.C: Configure Amazon Bedrock to use the private subnet where the EC2 instances are deployed.
choices.D: Link the existing VPC to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Direct Connect connection.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The EC2 instances have an assigned security group that allows access to all IP addresses in the private subnet. What should the ML engineer do to establish a connection between the EC2 instances and Amazon Bedrock?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: private subnet
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: An interface VPC endpoint provides private connectivity from a VPC to a supported AWS service through AWS PrivateLink.

A. Modify the security group to allow inbound and outbound traffic to and from Amazon Bedrock. — Security-group rules authorize traffic but do not create a private route or endpoint to Bedrock.

B. Use AWS PrivateLink to access Amazon Bedrock through an interface VPC endpoint. — Create the appropriate Bedrock interface endpoint, including bedrock-runtime for model invocations, and allow HTTPS from the instance security group. Configure private DNS so requests resolve to the endpoint.

C. Configure Amazon Bedrock to use the private subnet where the EC2 instances are deployed. — Bedrock is a managed service, not a model server that can simply be placed in the application's private subnet.

D. Link the existing VPC to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Direct Connect connection. — Direct Connect links external networks to AWS. It is not the required VPC-to-Bedrock service endpoint.

analysis.keyConcept: An interface VPC endpoint provides private connectivity from a VPC to a supported AWS service through AWS PrivateLink.

options.A: Security-group rules authorize traffic but do not create a private route or endpoint to Bedrock.

options.C: Bedrock is a managed service, not a model server that can simply be placed in the application's private subnet.
options.D: Direct Connect links external networks to AWS. It is not the required VPC-to-Bedrock service endpoint.

text: A company wants to launch a new internal generative AI interface to answer user questions. The interface will be based on a popular open source large language model (LLM). Which combination of steps will deploy the interface with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to deploy the LLM.
choices.B: Download the LLM as a .zip file. Deploy the LLM on a GPU-based Amazon EC2 instance.
choices.C: Create a frontend HTML interface that uses an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with AWS Lambda functions to handle the user interaction.
choices.D: Use Amazon QuickSight to create a UI to handle the user interaction.
choices.E: Use Amazon Lex to create a UI to handle the user interaction.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which combination of steps will deploy the interface with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: JumpStart simplifies supported foundation-model deployment, while Lex supplies a managed conversational interface that can call a model through fulfillment logic.

A. Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to deploy the LLM. — JumpStart provides supported model packages and managed deployment workflows, avoiding manual GPU server setup for the selected open model.

B. Download the LLM as a .zip file. Deploy the LLM on a GPU-based Amazon EC2 instance. — Manual EC2 hosting requires configuring the serving stack, GPU dependencies, scaling, and maintenance.

C. Create a frontend HTML interface that uses an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with AWS Lambda functions to handle the user interaction. — A custom HTML, WebSocket, and Lambda application can work, but requires more interface and conversation-management code than a managed bot integration.

D. Use Amazon QuickSight to create a UI to handle the user interaction. — QuickSight builds analytics dashboards. It is not a general-purpose chatbot interface for invoking the selected LLM.

E. Use Amazon Lex to create a UI to handle the user interaction. — Lex manages conversational interactions. Connect fulfillment to the deployed LLM and embed or expose the bot through an appropriate client; Lex does not automatically generate a complete standalone website.

text: A company wants to build a real-time analytics application that uses streaming data from social media. An ML engineer must implement a solution that ingests and transforms 5 GB of data each minute. The solution also must load the data into a data store that supports fast queries for the real-time analytics. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon EventBridge to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached).
choices.B: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Lambda to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon S3.
choices.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon EMR to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon RDS.
choices.D: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon DynamoDB.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution also must load the data into a data store that supports fast queries for the real-time analytics. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Kinesis Data Streams and Flink support high-throughput stream ingestion and stateful transformation. DynamoDB supports low-latency access when queries match its key design.

A. Use Amazon EventBridge to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached). — EventBridge is an event-routing service, and Glue plus a Memcached cache is not the most direct persistent stream-analytics architecture for this volume.

B. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Lambda to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon S3. — SQS and Lambda can process messages, but S3 alone does not provide the fast indexed query layer requested by the application.

C. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon EMR to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon RDS. — SNS supplies message fan-out rather than a replayable stream-processing backbone. EMR and RDS also add capacity and pipeline design work for this workload.

D. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon DynamoDB. — Kinesis ingests the stream, Flink transforms or aggregates it continuously, and DynamoDB serves keyed low-latency queries. Provision throughput, partitions, and item sizes for the stated volume; DynamoDB is not an arbitrary SQL analytics engine.

analysis.keyConcept: Kinesis Data Streams and Flink support high-throughput stream ingestion and stateful transformation. DynamoDB supports low-latency access when queries match its key design.

options.A: EventBridge is an event-routing service, and Glue plus a Memcached cache is not the most direct persistent stream-analytics architecture for this volume.
options.B: SQS and Lambda can process messages, but S3 alone does not provide the fast indexed query layer requested by the application.
options.C: SNS supplies message fan-out rather than a replayable stream-processing backbone. EMR and RDS also add capacity and pipeline design work for this workload.
options.D: Kinesis ingests the stream, Flink transforms or aggregates it continuously, and DynamoDB serves keyed low-latency queries. Provision throughput, partitions, and item sizes for the stated volume; DynamoDB is not an arbitrary SQL analytics engine.

text: A company stores training data as a .csv file in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must encrypt the data and must control which applications have access to the encryption key. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a new SSH access key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new access key to encrypt the file.
choices.B: Create a new API key by using the Amazon API Gateway CreateApiKey API operation. Use the AWS CLI with a reference to the new API key to encrypt the file.
choices.C: Create a new IAM role. Attach a policy that allows the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) GenerateDataKey action. Use the role to encrypt the file.
choices.D: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new KMS key to encrypt the file.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must encrypt the data and must control which applications have access to the encryption key. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Envelope encryption uses a data key to encrypt content and a KMS key to protect that data key. KMS key policies and IAM permissions control authorized applications.

A. Create a new SSH access key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new access key to encrypt the file. — An SSH key authenticates SSH access. It is not the KMS wrapping key required by the AWS Encryption CLI workflow.

B. Create a new API key by using the Amazon API Gateway CreateApiKey API operation. Use the AWS CLI with a reference to the new API key to encrypt the file. — An API Gateway API key identifies or meters API clients. It is not a cryptographic key for encrypting the CSV file.

C. Create a new IAM role. Attach a policy that allows the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) GenerateDataKey action. Use the role to encrypt the file. — An IAM role supplies permissions, not an encryption key or a complete file-encryption operation. A specific authorized KMS key and encryption tool are still needed.

D. Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new KMS key to encrypt the file. — Create a KMS key, restrict its use to the intended application roles, and reference it in the AWS Encryption CLI. The CLI encrypts the file with a data key protected by that KMS key.

analysis.keyConcept: Envelope encryption uses a data key to encrypt content and a KMS key to protect that data key. KMS key policies and IAM permissions control authorized applications.

options.A: An SSH key authenticates SSH access. It is not the KMS wrapping key required by the AWS Encryption CLI workflow.
options.B: An API Gateway API key identifies or meters API clients. It is not a cryptographic key for encrypting the CSV file.
options.C: An IAM role supplies permissions, not an encryption key or a complete file-encryption operation. A specific authorized KMS key and encryption tool are still needed.
options.D: Create a KMS key, restrict its use to the intended application roles, and reference it in the AWS Encryption CLI. The CLI encrypts the file with a data key protected by that KMS key.

text: A company needs to perform feature engineering, aggregation, and data preparation. After the features are produced, the company must implement a solution on AWS to process and store the features. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon SageMaker Feature Processing to process and ingest the data. Use SageMaker Feature Store to manage and store the features.
choices.B: Use Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to automatically ingest and transform the data. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the features in JSON format.
choices.C: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data and to ingest the data directly into Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. Use Feature Store to manage and store the features.
choices.D: Use an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job to analyze, transform, and ingest the data. Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store the features.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: After the features are produced, the company must implement a solution on AWS to process and store the features. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Feature Processing defines managed transformations and ingestion into Feature Store. A custom streaming pipeline can also write features through Feature Store APIs.

A. Use Amazon SageMaker Feature Processing to process and ingest the data. Use SageMaker Feature Store to manage and store the features. — This is the intended integrated solution: define transformations and aggregation in Feature Processing and persist the results in Feature Store.

B. Use Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to automatically ingest and transform the data. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the features in JSON format. — Model Monitor evaluates production data and model behavior. It does not automatically become a feature engineering and ingestion pipeline.

C. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data and to ingest the data directly into Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. Use Feature Store to manage and store the features. — Flink can also transform streaming data and write features through an implemented Feature Store sink or API calls. Because the question does not specify batch input or least overhead, this is a feasible alternative and the single-answer key needs clarification.

D. Use an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job to analyze, transform, and ingest the data. Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store the features. — Batch transform runs model inference over batches. It does not automatically provide feature engineering, feature ingestion, or Feature Store management in DynamoDB.
notes: Source selects A, the integrated managed solution. C can also implement feature transformations and ingestion using Flink and Feature Store APIs. The question lacks a batch-input or least-overhead constraint that uniquely excludes C.

analysis.keyConcept: Feature Processing defines managed transformations and ingestion into Feature Store. A custom streaming pipeline can also write features through Feature Store APIs.

options.A: This is the intended integrated solution: define transformations and aggregation in Feature Processing and persist the results in Feature Store.
options.B: Model Monitor evaluates production data and model behavior. It does not automatically become a feature engineering and ingestion pipeline.
options.C: Flink can also transform streaming data and write features through an implemented Feature Store sink or API calls. Because the question does not specify batch input or least overhead, this is a feasible alternative and the single-answer key needs clarification.
options.D: Batch transform runs model inference over batches. It does not automatically provide feature engineering, feature ingestion, or Feature Store management in DynamoDB.

text: A company is developing a new online application to gather information from customers. An ML engineer has developed a new ML model that will determine a score for each customer. The model will use the score to determine which product to display to the customer. The ML engineer needs to minimize response-time latency for the model. How should the ML engineer deploy the application in Amazon SageMaker to meet these requirements?

choices.A: Configure batch transform.
choices.B: Configure a real-time inference endpoint.
choices.C: Configure a serverless inference endpoint.
choices.D: Configure an asynchronous inference endpoint.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer needs to minimize response-time latency for the model. How should the ML engineer deploy the application in Amazon SageMaker to meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: minimize response-time latency for the model
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: An always-ready real-time endpoint is suited to synchronous, low-latency decisions in an interactive application.

A. Configure batch transform. — Batch transform produces results for offline batches rather than returning each customer's score immediately.

B. Configure a real-time inference endpoint. — A real-time endpoint keeps serving capacity available and returns synchronous predictions, matching the application's immediate product-selection flow.

C. Configure a serverless inference endpoint. — Serverless inference can serve synchronous requests, but on-demand cold starts add latency. No provisioned concurrency configuration is specified here.

D. Configure an asynchronous inference endpoint. — Asynchronous inference queues work and returns results later, which does not minimize latency for an interactive customer decision.

analysis.keyConcept: An always-ready real-time endpoint is suited to synchronous, low-latency decisions in an interactive application.

options.A: Batch transform produces results for offline batches rather than returning each customer's score immediately.
options.B: A real-time endpoint keeps serving capacity available and returns synchronous predictions, matching the application's immediate product-selection flow.
options.C: Serverless inference can serve synchronous requests, but on-demand cold starts add latency. No provisioned concurrency configuration is specified here.
options.D: Asynchronous inference queues work and returns results later, which does not minimize latency for an interactive customer decision.

text: A company is using Amazon EMR. The company has a large dataset in Amazon S3 that needs to be ingested into Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. The dataset contains historical data and real-time streaming data. The company must ensure that the Feature Store online store is updated with the most recent data as soon as the data becomes available. The company also must maintain a complete Feature Store offline store for batch processing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the online store.
choices.B: Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the offline store.
choices.C: Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with the online store and offline store enabled.
choices.D: Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with only the online store enabled.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company also must maintain a complete Feature Store offline store for batch processing. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time, batch
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A feature group can keep the latest record online while retaining historical records offline. Event time determines which record remains current online.

A. Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the online store. — If this means targeting only OnlineStore, historical offline persistence is missing. PutRecord can actually update both stores when both are enabled and no exclusive target is specified; the option's online-only wording is the limitation.

B. Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the offline store. — Writing only to OfflineStore preserves history but does not update the low-latency online record.

C. Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with the online store and offline store enabled. — Use the Spark connector with both stores enabled and ingest to both. It fits the existing EMR DataFrame workflow, keeps the latest event online, and writes history offline with the documented propagation delay.

D. Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with only the online store enabled. — An online-only feature group cannot maintain the complete offline history required for batch processing.

analysis.keyConcept: A feature group can keep the latest record online while retaining historical records offline. Event time determines which record remains current online.

options.A: If this means targeting only OnlineStore, historical offline persistence is missing. PutRecord can actually update both stores when both are enabled and no exclusive target is specified; the option's online-only wording is the limitation.
options.B: Writing only to OfflineStore preserves history but does not update the low-latency online record.
options.C: Use the Spark connector with both stores enabled and ingest to both. It fits the existing EMR DataFrame workflow, keeps the latest event online, and writes history offline with the documented propagation delay.

text: An ML engineer needs to deploy four ML models in an Amazon SageMaker inference pipeline. The models were built with different frameworks. The ML engineer also needs to give clients the ability to use the invoke_endpoint call to perform inference for each model. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

choices.A: Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint.
choices.B: Create a SageMaker multi-container endpoint.
choices.C: Create multiple SageMaker single-model endpoints.
choices.D: Run a SparkML job to generate multiple endpoints.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer also needs to give clients the ability to use the invoke_endpoint call to perform inference for each model. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MOST cost-effective, MOST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A multi-container endpoint can host different framework containers on shared instances. Direct invocation targets a particular container; Serial mode instead chains them.

A. Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint. — A conventional multi-model endpoint loads models through a shared serving container and is not the direct fit for four separate framework containers.

B. Create a SageMaker multi-container endpoint. — Use a multi-container endpoint in Direct mode and specify TargetContainerHostname in invoke_endpoint. This shares hosting resources while allowing each model to be invoked independently; it does not simultaneously execute a Serial pipeline for that request.

C. Create multiple SageMaker single-model endpoints. — Separate endpoints can support all frameworks, but each endpoint has its own serving capacity and management overhead.

D. Run a SparkML job to generate multiple endpoints. — A SparkML job does not provide the required multi-framework endpoint routing. Generating separate endpoints also loses the shared-hosting cost advantage.

analysis.keyConcept: A multi-container endpoint can host different framework containers on shared instances. Direct invocation targets a particular container; Serial mode instead chains them.

options.A: A conventional multi-model endpoint loads models through a shared serving container and is not the direct fit for four separate framework containers.
options.B: Use a multi-container endpoint in Direct mode and specify TargetContainerHostname in invoke_endpoint. This shares hosting resources while allowing each model to be invoked independently; it does not simultaneously execute a Serial pipeline for that request.
options.C: Separate endpoints can support all frameworks, but each endpoint has its own serving capacity and management overhead.
options.D: A SparkML job does not provide the required multi-framework endpoint routing. Generating separate endpoints also loses the shared-hosting cost advantage.

choices.C: Track the notebook's CPU metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if CPU utilization becomes zero.
choices.D: Track the notebook's memory metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if memory utilization becomes zero.

Copy the auto-stop-idle script from GitHub to the Start Notebook section. — Install the auto-stop idle script through the OnStart lifecycle configuration and set the idle threshold to one hour. B. Create a lifecycle configuration in SageMaker. Copy the auto-stop-idle script from GitHub to the Create Notebook section. — OnCreate runs only at initial creation. Startup-dependent scheduling, such as a cron entry, must be restored on subsequent starts.

C. Track the notebook's CPU metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if CPU utilization becomes zero. — CPU usage is not a reliable definition of notebook idleness, and CloudWatch Logs is not the CPU metric store. Active users may have low CPU usage.

D. Track the notebook's memory metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if memory utilization becomes zero. — A running notebook normally uses memory even when idle. Zero memory usage is not a suitable idle detection criterion, and logs are not the memory metric mechanism.

text: A company wants to provide services to help other businesses label images. The company wants its labeling specialists to complete human labeling tasks on AWS. How should the company register the labeling specialists to receive tasks on AWS?

choices.A: Use AWS Data Exchange.
choices.B: Create and use an internal workforce in Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.
choices.C: Create and use Amazon Mechanical Turk entities in an Amazon SageMaker human loop.
choices.D: Use the Amazon Mechanical Turk website.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company wants its labeling specialists to complete human labeling tasks on AWS. How should the company register the labeling specialists to receive tasks on AWS?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A Ground Truth private workforce assigns labeling tasks to known workers, such as the company's employees or contracted specialists.

A. Use AWS Data Exchange. — Data Exchange distributes datasets and data subscriptions. It does not register workers for image annotation jobs.

B. Create and use an internal workforce in Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth. — Register the specialists in a private workforce and place them in work teams for the company's Ground Truth labeling jobs. This controls which named specialists receive tasks.

C. Create and use Amazon Mechanical Turk entities in an Amazon SageMaker human loop. — A Mechanical Turk public workforce does not specifically register the company's own internal specialists. A human review loop also differs from creating the requested labeling workforce.

D. Use the Amazon Mechanical Turk website. — Mechanical Turk supports public crowdsourcing tasks. It is not the managed private workforce setup for these selected specialists.

options.B: Register the specialists in a private workforce and place them in work teams for the company's Ground Truth labeling jobs. This controls which named specialists receive tasks.

text: A company wants to use Amazon SageMaker to host an ML model that runs on CPU for real-time predictions. The model will have intermittent traffic during business hours and will have periods of no traffic after business hours. The company needs a solution that will serve inference requests in the most cost-effective manner. Which hosting option will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Add a schedule-based auto scaling policy to handle traffic surges during business hours.
choices.B: Deploy the model to a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint. Configure increased provisioned concurrency during business hours.
choices.C: Deploy the model to a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy that scales in to zero outside business hours.
choices.D: Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Create a scheduled AWS Lambda function that activates the endpoint during business hours only.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs a solution that will serve inference requests in the most cost-effective manner. Which hosting option will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: most cost-effective, real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Serverless CPU inference fits intermittent synchronous traffic. Provisioned concurrency can be scheduled for periods when startup latency matters, but it adds a standing cost.

A. Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Add a schedule-based auto scaling policy to handle traffic surges during business hours. — A conventional real-time endpoint retains provisioned instances even during idle periods unless additional lifecycle management is implemented.

B. Deploy the model to a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint. Configure increased provisioned concurrency during business hours. — Serverless inference fits intermittent CPU requests and can avoid off-hours compute charges when provisioned concurrency is reduced to zero. Use provisioned concurrency during business hours only to the extent needed for latency; cost optimality depends on actual traffic.

C. Deploy the model to a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy that scales in to zero outside business hours. — Asynchronous inference can scale to zero, but it does not provide the required synchronous real-time response.

D. Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Create a scheduled AWS Lambda function that activates the endpoint during business hours only. — A normal endpoint has no simple pause/resume activation operation. Deleting and recreating it requires orchestration and startup time, and still pays for idle capacity during business hours.

analysis.keyConcept: Serverless CPU inference fits intermittent synchronous traffic. Provisioned concurrency can be scheduled for periods when startup latency matters, but it adds a standing cost.

options.A: A conventional real-time endpoint retains provisioned instances even during idle periods unless additional lifecycle management is implemented.
options.B: Serverless inference fits intermittent CPU requests and can avoid off-hours compute charges when provisioned concurrency is reduced to zero. Use provisioned concurrency during business hours only to the extent needed for latency; cost optimality depends on actual traffic.
options.C: Asynchronous inference can scale to zero, but it does not provide the required synchronous real-time response.
options.D: A normal endpoint has no simple pause/resume activation operation. Deleting and recreating it requires orchestration and startup time, and still pays for idle capacity during business hours.

text: An ML engineer needs to train a supervised deep learning model. The available dataset is a large number of unlabeled images that only employees should access. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution that labels the dataset with the highest possible accuracy. Which combination of steps should the ML engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Use Amazon Rekognition to automatically label the dataset.
choices.B: Train the deep learning model directly on the raw data. Let the model infer the labels by itself.
choices.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to create an annotation job that specifies the labeling task and requirements.
choices.D: Set up workforce teams to access a private workforce to run and review the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.
choices.E: Use Amazon Mechanical Turk to complete the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which combination of steps should the ML engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Supervised learning requires labels. A private Ground Truth workforce can label and review data while limiting access to authorized employees.

A. Use Amazon Rekognition to automatically label the dataset. — Pretrained Rekognition labels may not match the project's target classes or accuracy requirements. Automatic labels do not replace the specified employee annotation and review process.

B. Train the deep learning model directly on the raw data. Let the model infer the labels by itself. — A supervised classifier cannot learn the intended target labels from unlabeled examples without an additional labeling or learning strategy.

C. Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to create an annotation job that specifies the labeling task and requirements. — Define a Ground Truth labeling job with clear instructions, label categories, and quality controls for the task.

D. Set up workforce teams to access a private workforce to run and review the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth. — Use a private workforce restricted to employees and assign work teams to annotate and review the images. This satisfies the access restriction and supports quality assurance.

E. Use Amazon Mechanical Turk to complete the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth. — Mechanical Turk uses external public workers, violating the requirement that only employees access the dataset.

analysis.keyConcept: Supervised learning requires labels. A private Ground Truth workforce can label and review data while limiting access to authorized employees.

options.A: Pretrained Rekognition labels may not match the project's target classes or accuracy requirements. Automatic labels do not replace the specified employee annotation and review process.
options.B: A supervised classifier cannot learn the intended target labels from unlabeled examples without an additional labeling or learning strategy.
options.C: Define a Ground Truth labeling job with clear instructions, label categories, and quality controls for the task.
options.D: Use a private workforce restricted to employees and assign work teams to annotate and review the images. This satisfies the access restriction and supports quality assurance.
options.E: Mechanical Turk uses external public workers, violating the requirement that only employees access the dataset.

text: A company is using an Amazon S3 bucket to collect data that will be used for ML workflows. The company needs to use AWS Glue DataBrew to clean and normalize the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job.
choices.B: Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job.
choices.C: Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job.
choices.D: Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to use AWS Glue DataBrew to clean and normalize the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A DataBrew profile job measures data quality and statistics. A recipe job applies transformations and writes prepared data.

A. Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job. — The S3 dataset connection is appropriate, but profiling describes the data instead of cleaning and normalizing it.

B. Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job. — Create the dataset from its S3 location and execute a recipe containing the required cleaning and normalization steps.

C. Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job. — S3 uses a native object-storage connection rather than a JDBC database connection, and a profile job does not apply the transformations.

D. Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job. — The recipe job is the right job type, but the proposed JDBC connection is not the appropriate way to define an S3 dataset.

options.B: Create the dataset from its S3 location and execute a recipe containing the required cleaning and normalization steps.
