text: A company is developing a new ML model that uses the XGBoost algorithm. The company will train the model on data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is in a nested JSON format. An ML engineer needs to convert the JSON files into a tabular format. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Create an AWS Glue PySpark job that uses the Relationalize transform to convert the files.
choices.B: Write custom Scala code to convert the files. Use Amazon EMR Serverless to run the Scala code.
choices.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses a Python runtime and invokes the reduce() function to convert the files. Invoke the Lambda function.
choices.D: Create an Amazon Athena database that is based on the JSON files. Use the Athena flatten function to convert the data.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to convert the JSON files into a tabular format. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Glue Relationalize converts nested structures into a collection of relational DynamicFrames, including separate tables for arrays when necessary.

A. Create an AWS Glue PySpark job that uses the Relationalize transform to convert the files. — Use the built-in Relationalize transform in a managed Glue PySpark job. Select or join the resulting tables into the feature table required by XGBoost.

B. Write custom Scala code to convert the files. Use Amazon EMR Serverless to run the Scala code. — Custom Scala on EMR Serverless can work, but requires implementing the nested-data conversion instead of using Glue's built-in transform.

C. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses a Python runtime and invokes the reduce() function to convert the files. Invoke the Lambda function. — Python reduce is a general accumulation function, not a complete nested-JSON relationalization solution. The transformation logic and scaling would still be custom.

D. Create an Amazon Athena database that is based on the JSON files. Use the Athena flatten function to convert the data. — Athena has array and row operations, but flatten is not a general nested-document-to-relational-tables transformation. This option does not specify the necessary schema and SQL conversion.

analysis.keyConcept: Glue Relationalize converts nested structures into a collection of relational DynamicFrames, including separate tables for arrays when necessary.

options.A: Use the built-in Relationalize transform in a managed Glue PySpark job. Select or join the resulting tables into the feature table required by XGBoost.
options.B: Custom Scala on EMR Serverless can work, but requires implementing the nested-data conversion instead of using Glue's built-in transform.
options.C: Python reduce is a general accumulation function, not a complete nested-JSON relationalization solution. The transformation logic and scaling would still be custom.
options.D: Athena has array and row operations, but flatten is not a general nested-document-to-relational-tables transformation. This option does not specify the necessary schema and SQL conversion.

text: A medical company ingests streams of data from devices that monitor patients’ vital signs. The company uses Amazon SageMaker and plans to prepare ML models to predict adverse events for patients. The dataset is large with thousands of features. An ML engineer needs to run several hundred training iterations with different sets of features, different algorithms, and many potential parameters. The ML engineer must implement a solution to log the characteristics and results of each training iteration. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

choices.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to create custom metrics for the characteristics of each iteration.
choices.B: Write the characteristics of each iteration to logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to search the logs.
choices.C: Use the SageMaker Model Registry to track the characteristics and results of each iteration.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Experiments to track the characteristics and results of each iteration.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must implement a solution to log the characteristics and results of each training iteration. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Experiment tracking records parameters, input configurations, metrics, and artifacts for comparable training runs.

A. Use Amazon CloudWatch to create custom metrics for the characteristics of each iteration. — Custom CloudWatch metrics can record numerical values, but the engineer would need to build the run organization and parameter/artifact relationships.

B. Write the characteristics of each iteration to logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to search the logs. — S3 logs with Glue and Athena can support analysis, but require a custom logging schema and query pipeline.

C. Use the SageMaker Model Registry to track the characteristics and results of each iteration. — Model Registry governs model versions and approval for deployment. It is not the primary tool for comparing every training iteration's parameters and results.

D. Use SageMaker Experiments to track the characteristics and results of each iteration. — SageMaker Experiments organizes training runs and their parameters, metrics, and artifacts, reducing custom experiment-tracking code. Use the tracking interface supported by the selected SageMaker environment.

analysis.keyConcept: Experiment tracking records parameters, input configurations, metrics, and artifacts for comparable training runs.

options.A: Custom CloudWatch metrics can record numerical values, but the engineer would need to build the run organization and parameter/artifact relationships.
options.B: S3 logs with Glue and Athena can support analysis, but require a custom logging schema and query pipeline.
options.C: Model Registry governs model versions and approval for deployment. It is not the primary tool for comparing every training iteration's parameters and results.
options.D: SageMaker Experiments organizes training runs and their parameters, metrics, and artifacts, reducing custom experiment-tracking code. Use the tracking interface supported by the selected SageMaker environment.

text: A company is planning to create an internal-only chat interface to help employees handle customer queries. Currently, the employees need to refer to a massive knowledge base of internal documents to address customer issues. The new solution must be serverless. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Set up Amazon Bedrock with the Anthropic Claude foundation model.
choices.B: Set up Amazon SageMaker JumpStart with the Llama foundation model.
choices.C: Use Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API.
choices.D: Use AWS Lambda functions with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API.
choices.E: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store vector database dumps and embeddings.
choices.F: Use Amazon RDS for MySQL to store vector database dumps and embeddings.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The new solution must be serverless. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: serverless
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A serverless document chatbot needs managed model inference, serverless request handling, and a retrieval layer over internal content. Storing embeddings alone is not retrieval.

A. Set up Amazon Bedrock with the Anthropic Claude foundation model. — Bedrock provides managed Claude inference without operating model-hosting servers, making it a suitable model layer.

B. Set up Amazon SageMaker JumpStart with the Llama foundation model. — A standard JumpStart deployment provisions SageMaker hosting instances. It does not satisfy the serverless model-hosting requirement as stated.

C. Use Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API. — EC2 requires managing server capacity, contrary to the serverless constraint.

D. Use AWS Lambda functions with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API. — API Gateway and Lambda provide a serverless request layer that can authenticate employees, retrieve context, and invoke Bedrock.

E. Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store vector database dumps and embeddings. — S3 is serverless storage for embeddings or index dumps, but a dump alone cannot answer similarity queries. A queryable index, such as an explicitly configured S3 Vectors index or another retrieval service, is missing from the proposed A/D/E combination.

F. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL to store vector database dumps and embeddings. — An ordinary RDS for MySQL deployment is not the stated serverless vector retrieval layer. Merely storing dumps also does not define semantic search.

notes: Source selects A, D, E. Bedrock and Lambda provide serverless compute, but storing vector index dumps in S3 does not itself provide the retrieval required for a document chatbot. An explicit queryable index is missing.

options.B: A standard JumpStart deployment provisions SageMaker hosting instances. It does not satisfy the serverless model-hosting requirement as stated.

options.E: S3 is serverless storage for embeddings or index dumps, but a dump alone cannot answer similarity queries. A queryable index, such as an explicitly configured S3 Vectors index or another retrieval service, is missing from the proposed A/D/E combination.

text: An ML engineer needs to deploy a trained model that is based on a genetic algorithm. The algorithm solves a complex problem and can take several minutes to generate predictions. When the model is deployed, the model needs to access large amounts of data to process requests. The requests can involve as much as 100 MB of data. Which deployment solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Deploy the model to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
choices.B: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint.
choices.C: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint.
choices.D: Package the model as a container. Deploy the model to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 instances.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The requests can involve as much as 100 MB of data. Which deployment solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Asynchronous inference supports large payloads and long-running requests through a managed queue and S3 result storage.

A. Deploy the model to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. — EC2 with an Auto Scaling group can host custom inference, but requires operating the serving stack, queueing, scaling, and request lifecycle.

B. Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint. — A real-time endpoint's ordinary payload and execution-time limits do not accommodate 100 MB requests that take several minutes.

C. Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint. — Asynchronous inference supports payloads up to 1 GB and processing up to one hour, fitting this workload with managed hosting and request handling.

D. Package the model as a container. Deploy the model to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 instances. — ECS on EC2 adds container orchestration and host management, plus custom handling for long-running requests.

analysis.keyConcept: Asynchronous inference supports large payloads and long-running requests through a managed queue and S3 result storage.

options.B: A real-time endpoint's ordinary payload and execution-time limits do not accommodate 100 MB requests that take several minutes.
options.C: Asynchronous inference supports payloads up to 1 GB and processing up to one hour, fitting this workload with managed hosting and request handling.
options.D: ECS on EC2 adds container orchestration and host management, plus custom handling for long-running requests.

text: An ML engineer wants to use a set of survey responses as training data for an ML classifier. All the survey responses are either “yes” or “no.”The ML engineer needs to convert the responses into a feature that will produce better model training results. The ML engineer must not increase the dimensionality of the dataset. Which methods will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Binary encoding
choices.B: Label encoding
choices.C: One-hot encoding
choices.D: Statistical imputation

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: Which methods will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A binary categorical feature can be represented in one numeric column. Encoding the two responses as 0 and 1 preserves dimensionality.

A. Binary encoding — For a genuinely binary yes/no feature, map the two states directly to a single binary value. Check the encoder configuration because some general categorical encoders reserve extra codes.

B. Label encoding — Label encoding can map no to 0 and yes to 1 in one column. With only two categories, this represents the binary distinction without introducing a multi-level ordering problem.

C. One-hot encoding — Default one-hot encoding creates a column per category and increases dimensionality. A configured drop-one binary encoding could avoid that, but the option does not specify it.

D. Statistical imputation — Imputation fills missing values. It does not encode the existing yes/no responses as the required numeric feature.

E. Tokenization — Tokenization splits or maps text tokens. It is unnecessary for a two-valued structured feature and does not ensure a one-column numeric representation.

text: A company is planning to use an Amazon SageMaker prebuilt algorithm to create a recommendation model. The algorithm must be able to make predictions on high-dimensional sparse data. Which SageMaker algorithm should the company choose for the recommendation model?

choices.A: K-nearest neighbors (k-NN)
choices.B: Factorization Machines
choices.C: Principal component analysis (PCA)
choices.D: Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq)

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The algorithm must be able to make predictions on high-dimensional sparse data. Which SageMaker algorithm should the company choose for the recommendation model?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Factorization Machines learn pairwise feature interactions using low-dimensional factors, which is useful for sparse, high-dimensional recommendation data.

A. K-nearest neighbors (k-NN) — k-NN finds nearby examples but is not designed to learn compact latent interactions among sparse user/item features.

B. Factorization Machines — Factorization Machines model interactions even when many feature pairs are rarely observed, making them suitable for recommendation with sparse input vectors.

C. Principal component analysis (PCA) — PCA reduces dimensionality. It does not directly train the requested supervised recommendation predictor.

D. Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq) — Sequence-to-sequence models map one sequence to another. They are not the designated built-in algorithm for sparse tabular recommendation interactions.

text: A company has several teams that have developed separate prediction models on their own laptops. The teams developed the models by using Python with scikit-learn and TensorFlow frameworks. The company must rebuild the models and must integrate the models into an ML infrastructure that the company manages by using Amazon SageMaker. The company also must incorporate the models into a model registry. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Export the models from the laptops to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions with SageMaker endpoints to access the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.
choices.B: Import the models into the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker to run the imported models.
choices.C: Use code from the laptops to create containers for the models. Use the bring your own container (BYOC) functionality of SageMaker to import and use the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.
choices.D: Import the Python-based models into SageMaker. Rebuild the scikit-learn and TensorFlow models in SageMaker. Register all the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company also must incorporate the models into a model registry. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker provides framework containers for supported scikit-learn and TensorFlow workloads. Training code can be adapted to those containers and the outputs registered.

A. Export the models from the laptops to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions with SageMaker endpoints to access the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry. — Uploading artifacts and adding an API does not rebuild the models in the managed training infrastructure required by the question.

B. Import the models into the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker to run the imported models. — Model Registry records deployable model packages; registering a model does not itself retrain or execute it.

C. Use code from the laptops to create containers for the models. Use the bring your own container (BYOC) functionality of SageMaker to import and use the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry. — Custom containers can work, but maintaining them adds effort when the existing frameworks are supported by managed framework images.

D. Import the Python-based models into SageMaker. Rebuild the scikit-learn and TensorFlow models in SageMaker. Register all the models in the SageMaker Model Registry. — Move the Python training code and dependencies to supported SageMaker framework jobs, retrain the models, and register their artifacts as model versions. 'Import' requires the appropriate code and artifact packaging, not a single automatic conversion command.

analysis.keyConcept: SageMaker provides framework containers for supported scikit-learn and TensorFlow workloads. Training code can be adapted to those containers and the outputs registered.

options.B: Model Registry records deployable model packages; registering a model does not itself retrain or execute it.
options.C: Custom containers can work, but maintaining them adds effort when the existing frameworks are supported by managed framework images.

text: A company is training a large language model (LLM) by using on-premises infrastructure. A live conversational engine uses the LLM to help customers find real-time insights in credit card data. An ML engineer must implement a solution to train and deploy the LLM on Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Training Compiler to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference.
choices.B: Use SageMaker with deep learning containers for large model inference to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Notebook Jobs to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Studio to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker batch transform.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must implement a solution to train and deploy the LLM on Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Training containers run optimization and update model weights. Large Model Inference containers are optimized for serving trained models, so the two roles must not be confused.

A. Use SageMaker Training Compiler to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference. — Training Compiler can optimize supported training workloads and real-time inference fits a conversational application. Its suitability depends on the model and supported framework versions, which the question does not identify.

B. Use SageMaker with deep learning containers for large model inference to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference. — This is the source answer, but it incorrectly assigns LMI serving containers to training. Use a compatible training container first, then an LMI container for real-time deployment. The source key is not confirmed as written.

C. Use SageMaker Notebook Jobs to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference. — A notebook job can orchestrate training, but asynchronous inference does not provide the synchronous conversational response required here.

D. Use SageMaker Studio to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker batch transform. — Studio can be used to develop and submit training jobs, but batch transform produces offline predictions rather than live conversational responses.

text: A company has an existing Amazon SageMaker model (v1) on a production endpoint. The company develops a new model version (v2) and needs to test v2 in production before substituting v2 for v1. The company needs to implement a solution to minimize the risk of v2 generating incorrect output in production. The solution must prevent any disruption of production traffic during the change to v2. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 1% of the traffic to v2 and 99% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.
choices.B: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 10% of the traffic to v2 and 90% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.
choices.C: Deploy v2 to a new endpoint. Turn on data capturing for the production endpoint. Write a script to pass 100% of input data to v2. If v2 performs as expected, deactivate the v1 endpoint and direct the traffic to v2.
choices.D: Deploy v2 into a shadow variant that samples 100% of the inference requests. Collect all the output in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, promote v2 to production.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution must prevent any disruption of production traffic during the change to v2. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: minimize the risk of v2 generating incorrect output in production
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Shadow testing runs a candidate on copies of live requests without returning candidate predictions to users.

A. Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 1% of the traffic to v2 and 99% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2. — Sending 1% of production traffic to v2 exposes that subset of users to potentially incorrect candidate responses before validation.

B. Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 10% of the traffic to v2 and 90% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2. — Sending 10% to v2 exposes an even larger subset of users to unvalidated outputs.

C. Deploy v2 to a new endpoint. Turn on data capturing for the production endpoint. Write a script to pass 100% of input data to v2. If v2 performs as expected, deactivate the v1 endpoint and direct the traffic to v2. — A separate endpoint and replay script can approximate shadow testing, but introduce custom replay, timing, and cutover logic. Deactivating v1 before a safe routing change could interrupt service.

D. Deploy v2 into a shadow variant that samples 100% of the inference requests. Collect all the output in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, promote v2 to production. — A shadow variant can receive copies of all live requests while v1 continues to answer clients. Capture and evaluate v2 outputs, then promote it through a controlled endpoint update.

analysis.keyConcept: Shadow testing runs a candidate on copies of live requests without returning candidate predictions to users.

options.A: Sending 1% of production traffic to v2 exposes that subset of users to potentially incorrect candidate responses before validation.
options.B: Sending 10% to v2 exposes an even larger subset of users to unvalidated outputs.
options.C: A separate endpoint and replay script can approximate shadow testing, but introduce custom replay, timing, and cutover logic. Deactivating v1 before a safe routing change could interrupt service.
options.D: A shadow variant can receive copies of all live requests while v1 continues to answer clients. Capture and evaluate v2 outputs, then promote it through a controlled endpoint update.

text: A company is building an ML model by using Amazon SageMaker, AWS owned libraries, and open source libraries. The company must ensure that SageMaker does not collect metadata about usage and errors during training. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Associate the SageMaker domain with a custom IAM role. Attach the role to a policy that denies Amazon CloudWatch service usage logs.
choices.B: Add an IAM role to the SageMaker domain to deny Amazon CloudWatch the permission to report metadata.
choices.C: Turn off the setting in the SageMaker domain to share metadata for console jobs. Opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs.
choices.D: Set a parameter to opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI, Boto3, or the SageMaker Python SDK.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must ensure that SageMaker does not collect metadata about usage and errors during training. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Aggregated training-library usage and error metadata is controlled by an explicit training job opt-out, separate from CloudWatch logging permissions.

A. Associate the SageMaker domain with a custom IAM role. Attach the role to a policy that denies Amazon CloudWatch service usage logs. — Denying CloudWatch logs can remove useful application diagnostics, but it is not the documented control for SageMaker training metadata collection.

B. Add an IAM role to the SageMaker domain to deny Amazon CloudWatch the permission to report metadata. — A domain role permission does not express the training job's metadata opt-out and need not be the role used by every submitted job.

C. Turn off the setting in the SageMaker domain to share metadata for console jobs. Opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs. — Console-created training jobs already disable this metadata collection by default. The proposed domain-wide console setting is not the documented mechanism.

D. Set a parameter to opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI, Boto3, or the SageMaker Python SDK. — Set OPT_OUT_TRACKING to '1' in each training job's creation configuration through the CLI or SDK. The opt-out must be submitted with the job, not set later inside the training script.

analysis.keyConcept: Aggregated training-library usage and error metadata is controlled by an explicit training job opt-out, separate from CloudWatch logging permissions.

options.A: Denying CloudWatch logs can remove useful application diagnostics, but it is not the documented control for SageMaker training metadata collection.
options.B: A domain role permission does not express the training job's metadata opt-out and need not be the role used by every submitted job.
options.C: Console-created training jobs already disable this metadata collection by default. The proposed domain-wide console setting is not the documented mechanism.
options.D: Set OPT_OUT_TRACKING to '1' in each training job's creation configuration through the CLI or SDK. The opt-out must be submitted with the job, not set later inside the training script.

text: An ML engineer is training an ML model to identify people’s health risk based on 20 features and 1 target. The target class has two values:• Likely to have health risk (positive class)• Unlikely to have health risk (negative class)The age range of people in the dataset is 30 years old to 60 years old. Age is one of the features. The ML engineer analyzes the features. For the positive class, the difference in proportions of labels (DPL) value is (+0.9) for the age range of 40 to 45 compared with all other age ranges. What should the ML engineer do to correct this data imbalance?

choices.A: Oversample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.
choices.B: Undersample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.
choices.C: Undersample the positive class for all age ranges except 40 to 45.
choices.D: Oversample the negative class for all age ranges except 40 to 45.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: For the positive class, the difference in proportions of labels (DPL) value is (+0.9) for the age range of 40 to 45 compared with all other age ranges. What should the ML engineer do to correct this data imbalance?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Difference in proportions of labels is DPL = q_a − q_d. The direction of correction depends on which age group is assigned to each facet.

A. Oversample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45. — Increasing positives among ages 40–45 raises that group's positive rate. This would worsen a positive DPL if that group is facet a, but could help if it is facet d.

B. Undersample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45. — Reducing positives among ages 40–45 lowers that group's positive rate. This is appropriate if ages 40–45 are facet a and have the higher positive rate.

C. Undersample the positive class for all age ranges except 40 to 45. — Reducing positives in the other ages lowers their positive rate. This helps only if those other ages are the higher-rate facet, not if ages 40–45 already have the higher rate.

D. Oversample the negative class for all age ranges except 40 to 45. — Adding negatives to the other ages also lowers their positive rate. Without naming the facets, the sign alone cannot justify this option. The conflicting source keys therefore remain unscored.

notes: Mâu thuẫn nội dung đáp án Q137/Q223. Cần xác định rõ hai facet trước khi chốt đáp án.

text: A company is building an Amazon SageMaker AI pipeline for an ML model. The pipeline uses distributed processing and training. An ML engineer needs to encrypt network communication between instances that run distributed jobs. The ML engineer configures the distributed jobs to run in a private VPC. What should the ML engineer do to meet the encryption requirement?

choices.A: Enable network isolation.
choices.B: Configure traffic encryption by using security groups.
choices.C: Enable inter-container traffic encryption.
choices.D: Enable VPC flow logs.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer configures the distributed jobs to run in a private VPC. What should the ML engineer do to meet the encryption requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Private network placement controls routing but does not itself encrypt worker-to-worker traffic in distributed jobs.

A. Enable network isolation. — Network isolation restricts container network access. It is not an encryption protocol for distributed worker communication.

B. Configure traffic encryption by using security groups. — Security groups filter traffic. They can permit the protocols required by encryption, but do not perform encryption themselves.

C. Enable inter-container traffic encryption. — Enable the distributed job's inter-container traffic encryption option. For training this is EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption; use the corresponding network configuration for processing jobs.

D. Enable VPC flow logs. — VPC flow logs record network flow metadata. They neither encrypt packet contents nor change how workers communicate.

analysis.keyConcept: Private network placement controls routing but does not itself encrypt worker-to-worker traffic in distributed jobs.

options.A: Network isolation restricts container network access. It is not an encryption protocol for distributed worker communication.
options.B: Security groups filter traffic. They can permit the protocols required by encryption, but do not perform encryption themselves.
options.C: Enable the distributed job's inter-container traffic encryption option. For training this is EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption; use the corresponding network configuration for processing jobs.
options.D: VPC flow logs record network flow metadata. They neither encrypt packet contents nor change how workers communicate.

text: An ML model is deployed in production. The model has performed well and has met its metric thresholds for months. An ML engineer who is monitoring the model observes a sudden degradation. The performance metrics of the model are now below the thresholds. What could be the cause of the performance degradation?

choices.A: Lack of training data
choices.B: Drift in production data distribution
choices.C: Compute resource constraints
choices.D: Model overfitting

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The performance metrics of the model are now below the thresholds. What could be the cause of the performance degradation?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A model can lose predictive quality when production inputs no longer resemble the data on which it was trained. Drift is a hypothesis to investigate, not proof from the performance drop alone.

A. Lack of training data — Insufficient original training data could limit generalization from the start, but does not directly explain a sudden decline after months of stable performance.

B. Drift in production data distribution — A change in production data distribution can make learned relationships less applicable, explaining the sudden degradation. Check input distributions and ground-truth performance to confirm the cause.

C. Compute resource constraints — Compute constraints commonly affect latency, throughput, and availability. They do not usually change prediction accuracy for successfully processed identical inputs.

D. Model overfitting — Overfitting usually appears as poor validation or early production generalization. It is a less direct explanation than a recent data change for this timeline.

text: An ML engineer is using AWS Glue to transform proprietary data from a third-party vendor to a format that the ML engineer intends to use with the Amazon SageMaker DeepAR forecasting algorithm. The data includes several similar time series data files that the ML engineer must convert to the appropriate format. The ML engineer must compress the files to optimize storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Snappy to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files.
choices.B: Use XZ to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files.
choices.C: Use XZ to convert the files to Apache Parquet format and to compress the files.
choices.D: Use gzip to convert the files to Apache Parquet and to compress the files.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must compress the files to optimize storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: DeepAR accepts supported JSON Lines or Parquet time-series data. Parquet compression must use a supported codec and the data must have the required schema.

A. Use Snappy to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files. — Snappy is supported for DeepAR Parquet input, but RecordIO-Protobuf is not the DeepAR input format described by this option.

B. Use XZ to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files. — Neither RecordIO-Protobuf input nor XZ compression matches the documented DeepAR data interface.

C. Use XZ to convert the files to Apache Parquet format and to compress the files. — Parquet is supported, but XZ is not one of the documented DeepAR Parquet compression choices.

D. Use gzip to convert the files to Apache Parquet and to compress the files. — Write the time-series fields to Parquet using gzip compression in Glue. Gzip supplies compression; the Glue transformation and Parquet writer perform format conversion.

options.B: Neither RecordIO-Protobuf input nor XZ compression matches the documented DeepAR data interface.
options.C: Parquet is supported, but XZ is not one of the documented DeepAR Parquet compression choices.
options.D: Write the time-series fields to Parquet using gzip compression in Glue. Gzip supplies compression; the Glue transformation and Parquet writer perform format conversion.

text: A company has significantly increased the amount of data that is stored as .csv files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Data transformation scripts and queries are now taking much longer than they used to take. An ML engineer must implement a solution to optimize the data for query performance. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Configure an AWS Lambda function to split the .csv files into smaller objects in the S3 bucket.
choices.B: Configure an AWS Glue job to drop columns that have string type values and to save the results to the S3 bucket.
choices.C: Configure an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Apache Parquet format.
choices.D: Configure an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data that is in the S3 bucket.

hint:

explanation:
Key Concept: Columnar formats such as Parquet reduce unnecessary column reads and support compression and predicate pruning for analytics.

A. Configure an AWS Lambda function to split the .csv files into smaller objects in the S3 bucket. — Splitting CSV into many smaller objects does not add columnar encoding and can increase per-file overhead.

B. Configure an AWS Glue job to drop columns that have string type values and to save the results to the S3 bucket. — Dropping all string columns may destroy needed features and information. It is not a justified performance optimization.

C. Configure an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Apache Parquet format. — A managed Glue ETL job can convert CSV to Parquet, reducing scanned bytes for column-selective queries and improving analytics efficiency.

D. Configure an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data that is in the S3 bucket. — EMR can process the data, but adds cluster operation and does not by itself improve the stored file layout for later queries.

text: An ML engineer is analyzing a classification dataset before training a model in Amazon SageMarker AI. The ML engineer suspects that the dataset has a significant imbalance between class labels that could lead to biased model predictions. To confirm class imbalance, the ML engineer needs to select an appropriate pre-training bias metric. Which metric will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Mean square error (MSE)
choices.B: Difference in proportions of labels (DPL)
choices.C: Silhouette score
choices.D: Structural similarity index measure (SSIM)

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: To confirm class imbalance, the ML engineer needs to select an appropriate pre-training bias metric. Which metric will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: class imbalance
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: DPL compares positive-label rates between two specified facets. Overall target-class imbalance is instead established by inspecting target-label counts and proportions.

A. Mean square error (MSE) — MSE measures numerical prediction error. It is not a pre-training label distribution or bias metric.

B. Difference in proportions of labels (DPL) — DPL is the only listed pre-training bias metric, but it requires defined comparison facets and measures differences between their label rates. It cannot by itself confirm overall class-label imbalance in the unspecified dataset, so the source key is conditional.

C. Silhouette score — Silhouette score measures cluster separation and compactness, not the distribution of supervised target labels.

D. Structural similarity index measure (SSIM) — SSIM compares structural similarity between images. It does not measure target-class imbalance.
notes: Source selects B. DPL compares positive-label proportions between specified facets, rather than measuring overall target-class imbalance without facets.

analysis.keyConcept: DPL compares positive-label rates between two specified facets. Overall target-class imbalance is instead established by inspecting target-label counts and proportions.

options.C: Silhouette score measures cluster separation and compactness, not the distribution of supervised target labels.
options.D: SSIM compares structural similarity between images. It does not measure target-class imbalance.

text: An ML engineer uses one ML framework to train multiple ML models. The ML engineer needs to optimize the inference costs and host the models on Amazon SageMaker AI. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

choices.A: Create a multi-container inference endpoint for direct invocation.
choices.B: Create a multi-model inference endpoint for all the models.
choices.C: Create a multi-container inference endpoint for sequential invocation.
choices.D: Create multiple single-model inference endpoint for each model.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer needs to optimize the inference costs and host the models on Amazon SageMaker AI. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MOST cost-effective, MOST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A multi-model endpoint shares a serving container and instance fleet across compatible models, loading models as needed.

A. Create a multi-container inference endpoint for direct invocation. — Direct multi-container hosting supports separate serving stacks, but adds distinct container overhead when all models use a compatible shared framework.

B. Create a multi-model inference endpoint for all the models. — A multi-model endpoint shares capacity across the compatible models and avoids provisioning a separate endpoint for each. Validate model size, traffic, and cold-load behavior for the workload.

C. Create a multi-container inference endpoint for sequential invocation. — Sequential multi-container invocation chains models for each request. That is a processing pipeline, not independent hosting of multiple alternative models.

D. Create multiple single-model inference endpoint for each model. — Separate endpoints reserve independent serving capacity, which can leave more paid resources idle when individual model traffic is low.

text: A company is using an ML model to classify motion in videos. The data is stored in MP4 format in Amazon S3. When the company created the model, the company needed 4 months to label all the video frames. The company needs to retrain the model with an existing training workflow in Amazon SageMaker AI. An ML engineer must implement a solution that decreases the labeling time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Ground Truth to annotate the video frames.
choices.B: Use SageMaker JumpStart to use pre-trained computer vision models to develop a labeling model.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a data workflow. Use the workflow to optimize the labeling process.
choices.D: Use the labeling interface of Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) with Amazon Rekognition to label the video frames.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer must implement a solution that decreases the labeling time. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Ground Truth video-frame labeling supports task-specific annotation interfaces and assistive workflows that reduce repetitive manual work.

A. Use SageMaker Ground Truth to annotate the video frames. — Use Ground Truth's supported video-frame annotation tasks and worker aids, such as object tracking and annotation propagation where applicable, to accelerate labeling and integrate results with the training workflow.

B. Use SageMaker JumpStart to use pre-trained computer vision models to develop a labeling model. — JumpStart models could provide candidate prelabels, but developing and validating a custom labeling model adds work and does not replace the annotation workflow.

C. Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a data workflow. Use the workflow to optimize the labeling process. — Data Wrangler prepares structured training data. It is not a video-frame annotation interface or workforce management system.

D. Use the labeling interface of Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) with Amazon Rekognition to label the video frames. — A2I is intended for human review workflows. A Rekognition integration does not automatically provide the specialized video-frame annotation and tracking workflow offered by Ground Truth.

text: An ecommerce company trains an ML model to forecast demand for near real-time inventory management based on historical customer activity. The company successfully deploys the trained model to a production Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. However, the company notices that the model’s forecast performance degrades over time. The company needs a long-term and automated solution to mitigate the performance degradation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to automatically send alerts when model performance anomalies are detected.
choices.B: Use AWS X-Ray to monitor the performance of the SageMaker AI endpoint and the incoming requests to inform model re-training.
choices.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to curate a high-quality dataset. Use the dataset to re-train the model.
choices.D: Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to monitor model and feature attribution bias to inform model re-training.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs a long-term and automated solution to mitigate the performance degradation. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time, near real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Long-term performance maintenance requires detecting relevant changes, acquiring current validated data, retraining, and evaluating the replacement before deployment.

A. Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to automatically send alerts when model performance anomalies are detected. — Debugger analyzes training behavior. Alerts alone neither monitor all production predictive drift nor retrain the model.

B. Use AWS X-Ray to monitor the performance of the SageMaker AI endpoint and the incoming requests to inform model re-training. — X-Ray traces request execution and service latency. It does not measure forecast error or refresh the training data.

C. Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to curate a high-quality dataset. Use the dataset to re-train the model. — Retraining on representative, high-quality data can help, but Ground Truth labeling alone does not establish an automated monitoring and retraining loop. Forecast targets also commonly come from later observed sales rather than manual annotation.

D. Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to monitor model and feature attribution bias to inform model re-training. — Clarify bias and feature-attribution drift may inform investigation, but these do not cover general forecast-performance degradation or implement automatic retraining. None of the listed solutions fully specifies the required automation.
notes: Source selects C. Curating labels and retraining once is not a complete automated long-term monitoring and retraining solution. None of the options defines the required loop.

options.B: X-Ray traces request execution and service latency. It does not measure forecast error or refresh the training data.

text: A logistics company has installed in-vehicle cameras for basic monitoring of its drivers. The company wants to improve driver safety by identifying distractions that could lead to accidents. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.B: Use Amazon SageMaker AI to customize an AI model to monitor driver behavior and identify distractions.
choices.C: Integrate a third-party driver monitoring system with Amazon Rekognition to monitor driver behavior and identify distractions
choices.D: Use Amazon Comprehend to analyze text-based driver feedback and identify distractions.

text: A company has trained an ML model that is packaged in a container. The company will integrate the model with an existing Python web application. The company needs to host the model on AWS by using Kubernetes. The company does not want to manage the control plane and must provision the resources in a repeatable manner. The infrastructure must be provisioned by using Python. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use AWS CloudFormation to provision Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Set up a Kubernetes cluster. Host the model container on the Kubernetes cluster.
choices.B: Use the AWS CLI to provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Store the image in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Host the model container on the EKS cluster.
choices.C: Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Store the image in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Host the model container on the EKS cluster.
choices.D: Use AWS CloudFormation to provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Store the image in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Host the model container on the EKS cluster.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The infrastructure must be provisioned by using Python. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: EKS manages the Kubernetes control plane. AWS CDK defines repeatable infrastructure using programming languages including Python.

A. Use AWS CloudFormation to provision Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Set up a Kubernetes cluster. Host the model container on the Kubernetes cluster. — Running Kubernetes directly on EC2 makes the company responsible for its control plane, and a raw CloudFormation template is not Python infrastructure code.

B. Use the AWS CLI to provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Store the image in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Host the model container on the EKS cluster. — EKS satisfies the managed control-plane requirement, but imperative CLI provisioning is not the requested Python infrastructure definition.

C. Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Store the image in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Host the model container on the EKS cluster. — Define the EKS cluster and related resources with Python CDK code, store the model image in ECR, and deploy its Kubernetes workload. EKS manages the control plane while CDK supports repeatable provisioning.

D. Use AWS CloudFormation to provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Store the image in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Host the model container on the EKS cluster. — CloudFormation can provision EKS repeatably, but templates are JSON or YAML. CDK is the option that meets the explicit Python authoring requirement.

analysis.keyConcept: EKS manages the Kubernetes control plane. AWS CDK defines repeatable infrastructure using programming languages including Python.

options.B: EKS satisfies the managed control-plane requirement, but imperative CLI provisioning is not the requested Python infrastructure definition.
options.C: Define the EKS cluster and related resources with Python CDK code, store the model image in ECR, and deploy its Kubernetes workload. EKS manages the control plane while CDK supports repeatable provisioning.
options.D: CloudFormation can provision EKS repeatably, but templates are JSON or YAML. CDK is the option that meets the explicit Python authoring requirement.

text: An ML engineer is developing a linear regression ML model. The model shows high accuracy on the training dataset but performs poorly on unseen new data. Which action should the ML engineer take to address this issue?

choices.A: Increase the complexity of the model to capture more patterns in the training data. Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to monitor for convergence issues.
choices.B: Apply ML techniques such as cross-validation and regularization. Use Amazon SageMaker Experiments to track and compare different model versions and their performance metrics.
choices.C: Directly deploy the model into production. Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to interpret model outputs on new data. Adjust the model based on these insights.
choices.D: Increase the size of the training dataset without adjusting the size of the model. Retrain the model on the new data. Generate a confusion matrix to analyze the results.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The model shows high accuracy on the training dataset but performs poorly on unseen new data. Which action should the ML engineer take to address this issue?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: High training performance with poor unseen-data performance suggests overfitting. Regularization controls model complexity, and cross-validation estimates generalization.

A. Increase the complexity of the model to capture more patterns in the training data. Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to monitor for convergence issues. — Increasing complexity can worsen overfitting. Debugger convergence checks do not directly resolve the training-to-validation gap.

B. Apply ML techniques such as cross-validation and regularization. Use Amazon SageMaker Experiments to track and compare different model versions and their performance metrics. — Apply regularization, evaluate candidates with cross-validation, and track the runs and metrics with Experiments. Select the configuration based on held-out performance.

C. Directly deploy the model into production. Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to interpret model outputs on new data. Adjust the model based on these insights. — Deploying a known poorly generalizing model exposes users to errors. Explainability after deployment is not a substitute for validation and regularization.

D. Increase the size of the training dataset without adjusting the size of the model. Retrain the model on the new data. Generate a confusion matrix to analyze the results. — More representative data can help, but a confusion matrix evaluates classification rather than continuous linear regression. The proposed evaluation is inappropriate.

text: A company is training a new ML model to replace a model that is deployed on an Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoint. An ML engineer needs to determine the latency and the accuracy of the new model. The ML engineer must evaluate the new model in a production scenario without affecting the users of the existing model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Perform a blue/green deployment with linear traffic shifting.
choices.B: Perform a blue/green deployment with canary traffic shifting.
choices.C: Perform a rolling deployment with a rolling batch size of 50% of the current fleet.
choices.D: Perform shadow testing with a traffic sampling percentage of 100%.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must evaluate the new model in a production scenario without affecting the users of the existing model. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Shadow testing measures a candidate under live traffic without allowing its predictions to affect the user-facing response.

A. Perform a blue/green deployment with linear traffic shifting. — Linear traffic shifting sends an increasing fraction of actual client responses through the new model, so users are affected during evaluation.

B. Perform a blue/green deployment with canary traffic shifting. — Canary shifting exposes a small group of users to the new model; it does not provide zero-impact evaluation.

C. Perform a rolling deployment with a rolling batch size of 50% of the current fleet. — A rolling deployment replaces serving capacity and returns new-model predictions to users. It is a rollout strategy rather than an isolated evaluation.

D. Perform shadow testing with a traffic sampling percentage of 100%. — Send copies of all requests to the shadow variant while the existing model answers clients. Measure latency and compare captured predictions with ground truth to assess accuracy.

analysis.keyConcept: Shadow testing measures a candidate under live traffic without allowing its predictions to affect the user-facing response.

options.A: Linear traffic shifting sends an increasing fraction of actual client responses through the new model, so users are affected during evaluation.
options.B: Canary shifting exposes a small group of users to the new model; it does not provide zero-impact evaluation.
options.C: A rolling deployment replaces serving capacity and returns new-model predictions to users. It is a rollout strategy rather than an isolated evaluation.
options.D: Send copies of all requests to the shadow variant while the existing model answers clients. Measure latency and compare captured predictions with ground truth to assess accuracy.

text: An ML engineer wants to use, prepare, and load data from Amazon S3 for analytics. The ML engineer must run an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to discover the schema of the data and to store the metadata. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST manual effort?

choices.A: Use AWS Glue to run the ETL job. Use the job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog.
choices.B: Create an Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler flow to run the ETL job. Use the job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in an S3 bucket.
choices.C: Create an ETL pipeline by using Amazon Athena integrated with AWs Step Functions. Use the pipeline to run the ETL job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in an S3 bucket.
choices.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that includes the scikit-learn library to run the ETL job. Use the job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in Amazon Redshift.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must run an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to discover the schema of the data and to store the metadata. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST manual effort?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Glue combines managed ETL with the Data Catalog. Schema discovery can use crawlers or inferred job schemas, and configured jobs can update catalog metadata.

A. Use AWS Glue to run the ETL job. Use the job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. — Use Glue's managed ETL and catalog integration, with a crawler or configured catalog updates to discover and register schemas. This avoids building a separate metadata management layer.

B. Create an Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler flow to run the ETL job. Use the job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in an S3 bucket. — Data Wrangler can prepare data, but exporting metadata to S3 does not provide the integrated shared catalog requested here.

C. Create an ETL pipeline by using Amazon Athena integrated with AWs Step Functions. Use the pipeline to run the ETL job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in an S3 bucket. — Athena queries data and Step Functions orchestrates work. Additional schema discovery and metadata storage logic would still be necessary.

D. Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that includes the scikit-learn library to run the ETL job. Use the job to discover the schema and to store the associated metadata in Amazon Redshift. — A self-managed EC2 script and Redshift metadata store introduce compute management and custom catalog implementation.

text: An ML engineer is building an ML pipeline. The pipeline must process a dataset in two ways by using Amazon Athena. The pipeline must use batch processing to perform large-scale data transformations and for model training. The pipeline must also use near real-time processing to perform low-latency queries for inference and analytics. Which file format will provide the LEAST latency for both types of processing?

choices.A: CSV

choices.D: Deserialized JSON

explanation:
Key Concept: Parquet improves analytical scans through columnar storage, compression, and pruning. File format alone does not guarantee real-time inference latency.

A. CSV — CSV is row-oriented text and often requires parsing and scanning fields that a query does not need.

B. Apache Parquet — Parquet allows Athena to read selected columns and skip irrelevant row groups, reducing I/O for both large transformations and selective analytical queries.

C. Nested JSON — Nested JSON requires text parsing and is generally less efficient for repeated tabular column scans.

D. Deserialized JSON — Flattening or deserializing JSON does not provide Parquet's on-disk columnar layout and pruning metadata.

text: A company uses an Amazon SageMaker AI ML model to make real-time inferences. The company has configured auto scaling for the Amazon EC2 instances that SageMaker AI uses for the inferences. During times of peak usage, new instances launch before existing instances are fully ready. As a result, the model experiences inefficiencies and delays. Which solution will optimize the scaling process without affecting response times?

choices.A: Change to a multi-model endpoint configuration in SageMaker AI.
choices.B: Integrate Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to manage invocations of the SageMaker AI inference endpoint.
choices.C: Decrease the cooldown period for scale-in activities. Increase the maximum number of instances.
choices.D: Increase the cooldown period after scale-out activities.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: As a result, the model experiences inefficiencies and delays. Which solution will optimize the scaling process without affecting response times?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A scale-out cooldown allows recently added capacity time to initialize and affect load metrics before another scaling action is considered.

A. Change to a multi-model endpoint configuration in SageMaker AI. — A multi-model endpoint changes how models share capacity. It does not address repeated scale-out before new instances become ready.

B. Integrate Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to manage invocations of the SageMaker AI inference endpoint. — Adding an API layer does not change the endpoint scaling policy's startup stabilization period.

C. Decrease the cooldown period for scale-in activities. Increase the maximum number of instances. — Shortening scale-in cooldown addresses removal of capacity, not premature additions. Raising the maximum can allow even more unnecessary instances.

D. Increase the cooldown period after scale-out activities. — Increase scale-out cooldown to reflect observed initialization time and avoid repeated reactions before capacity becomes effective. Tune it with load tests so it does not delay necessary scaling during genuine demand growth.

options.D: Increase scale-out cooldown to reflect observed initialization time and avoid repeated reactions before capacity becomes effective. Tune it with load tests so it does not delay necessary scaling during genuine demand growth.

text: A company deployed an Amazon SageMaker AI ML model to an endpoint by calling the CreateModel API operation. The network that was established with the API call includes two private subnets and one security group. The model must download data from an Amazon S3 bucket and must upload data to the S3 bucket. The traffic to the S3 bucket must not travel across the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the security group to allow outbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the NAT gateway.
choices.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint. Configure an endpoint policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
choices.C: Create an interface VPC endpoint. Verify that the security group allows only inbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
choices.D: Create a Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The traffic to the S3 bucket must not travel across the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: private subnet
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: An S3 gateway endpoint adds private AWS-network routing to S3 through VPC route tables, with an endpoint policy that limits accessible buckets.

A. Create a NAT gateway. Configure the security group to allow outbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the NAT gateway. — A NAT gateway enables access through public service endpoints and is unnecessary for the requested S3 endpoint path.

B. Create a gateway VPC endpoint. Configure an endpoint policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint. — Create an S3 gateway endpoint, associate the training or hosting subnets' route tables, and restrict bucket access through its endpoint policy along with IAM and bucket permissions.

C. Create an interface VPC endpoint. Verify that the security group allows only inbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint. — S3 interface endpoints can provide private access, but this option incorrectly describes route-table redirection and ignores required outbound connectivity. Interface endpoints use private endpoint addresses and DNS.

D. Create a Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint. — Gateway Load Balancer endpoints route traffic through network appliances. They are not S3 gateway service endpoints.

analysis.keyConcept: An S3 gateway endpoint adds private AWS-network routing to S3 through VPC route tables, with an endpoint policy that limits accessible buckets.

options.A: A NAT gateway enables access through public service endpoints and is unnecessary for the requested S3 endpoint path.
options.B: Create an S3 gateway endpoint, associate the training or hosting subnets' route tables, and restrict bucket access through its endpoint policy along with IAM and bucket permissions.

options.D: Gateway Load Balancer endpoints route traffic through network appliances. They are not S3 gateway service endpoints.

text: A company is developing a new ML model to rank customers in order of their potential to pay back loans. The company needs to use an Amazon SageMaker AI built-in algorithm. Which algorithm should the company use to meet these requirements?

choices.A: XGBoost
choices.B: K-means clustering
choices.C: Principal component analysis (PCA)
choices.D: Neural Topic Model (NTM)

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to use an Amazon SageMaker AI built-in algorithm. Which algorithm should the company use to meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: XGBoost supports supervised ranking objectives and can also estimate credit-related scores that are ordered for a business decision.

A. XGBoost — Use XGBoost with a suitable ranking objective and correctly grouped relevance data, or train a validated repayment-probability model and rank its scores.

B. K-means clustering — K-means groups similar customers without using the repayment target. Cluster assignments are not a learned repayment ranking.

C. Principal component analysis (PCA) — PCA produces lower-dimensional feature representations. It does not predict the requested ranking target.

D. Neural Topic Model (NTM) — Neural Topic Model discovers topics in text. It is not a supervised customer repayment ranking algorithm.

text: An ML engineer is setting up an Amazon SageMaker AI pipeline for an ML model. The pipeline must automatically initiate a re-training job if any data drift is detected. How should the ML engineer set up the pipeline to meet this requirement?

choices.A: Use an AWS Glue crawler and an AWS Glue extract, transform and load (ETL) job to detect data drift. Use AWS Glue triggers to automate the re-training job.
choices.B: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to detect data drift. Use an AWS Lambda function to automate the re-training job.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Model Monitor to detect data drift. Use an AWS Lambda function to automate the re-training job.
choices.D: Use Amazon QuickSight anomaly detection to detect data drift. Use an AWS Step Functions workflow to automate the re-training job.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The pipeline must automatically initiate a re-training job if any data drift is detected. How should the ML engineer set up the pipeline to meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: data drift
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A drift detector must be connected to an event or alarm that starts retraining. Detection alone does not invoke the training pipeline.

A. Use an AWS Glue crawler and an AWS Glue extract, transform and load (ETL) job to detect data drift. Use AWS Glue triggers to automate the re-training job. — Glue crawlers discover schemas, and ETL jobs transform data. They do not supply the configured SageMaker production drift baseline by default.

B. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to detect data drift. Use an AWS Lambda function to automate the re-training job. — Flink could implement custom drift statistics, but the detector and orchestration would need to be built and maintained.

C. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to detect data drift. Use an AWS Lambda function to automate the re-training job. — Use Model Monitor to compare captured inputs with a baseline, emit an alarm or event, and invoke Lambda to start the retraining pipeline. Keep model evaluation and approval checks before any replacement is deployed.

D. Use Amazon QuickSight anomaly detection to detect data drift. Use an AWS Step Functions workflow to automate the re-training job. — QuickSight anomaly detection concerns analytical time series. It is not the direct production feature-distribution monitoring integration for this SageMaker pipeline.
