text: A company has developed a computer vision model. The company needs to deploy the model into production on Amazon SageMaker AI. The company has not hosted a model on SageMaker AI previously. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to track model versions. The solution also must provide recommendations about which Amazon EC2 instance types to use to host the model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Register the model in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use AWS Compute Optimizer for recommendations about instance types.
choices.B: Register the model in the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker Autopilot for recommendations about instance types.
choices.C: Register the model in the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for recommendations about instance types.
choices.D: Register the model in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use SageMaker Experiments for recommendations about instance types.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution also must provide recommendations about which Amazon EC2 instance types to use to host the model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Model Registry manages model versions. Inference Recommender benchmarks supported hosting configurations to guide instance selection.

A. Register the model in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use AWS Compute Optimizer for recommendations about instance types. — ECR stores container images rather than model lifecycle versions, and Compute Optimizer is not the tool for benchmarking this new SageMaker model's inference requirements.

B. Register the model in the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker Autopilot for recommendations about instance types. — Model Registry is appropriate, but Autopilot automates model development rather than performing the requested serving-instance recommendation task.

C. Register the model in the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for recommendations about instance types. — Register the model package and use Inference Recommender to test supported serving configurations against sample payloads and performance goals.

D. Register the model in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use SageMaker Experiments for recommendations about instance types. — ECR alone is not the model version registry, and Experiments records training runs rather than recommending inference instance types.

text: A company is using Amazon SageMaker AI to develop a credit risk assessment model. During model validation, the company finds that the model achieves 82% accuracy on the validation data. However, the model achieved 99% accuracy on the training data. The company needs to address the model accuracy issue before deployment. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Add more dense layers to increase model complexity. Implement batch normalization. Use early stopping during training.
choices.B: Implement dropout layers. Use L1 or L2 regularization. Perform k-fold cross-validation.
choices.C: Use principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the feature dimensionality. Decrease model layers. Implement cross-entropy loss functions.
choices.D: Augment the training dataset. Remove duplicate records from the training dataset. Implement stratified sampling.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to address the model accuracy issue before deployment. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: A large training-versus-validation accuracy gap is a warning sign of overfitting. Regularization and robust validation help control it.

A. Add more dense layers to increase model complexity. Implement batch normalization. Use early stopping during training. — Early stopping may help, but adding dense layers increases capacity and can worsen the existing overfitting problem.

B. Implement dropout layers. Use L1 or L2 regularization. Perform k-fold cross-validation. — Dropout and L1/L2 penalties reduce reliance on overly specific training patterns. Cross-validation helps select and assess these settings across multiple splits.

C. Use principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the feature dimensionality. Decrease model layers. Implement cross-entropy loss functions. — Dimensionality reduction and fewer layers might help, but switching to cross-entropy alone does not address overfitting and may already be the classification loss.

D. Augment the training dataset. Remove duplicate records from the training dataset. Implement stratified sampling. — Augmentation and data cleanup can help when appropriate, but this option does not directly control model complexity. It is less targeted than explicit regularization for the described gap.

text: A company collects customer data every day. The company stores the data as compressed files in an Amazon S3 bucket that is partitioned by date. Every month, analysts download the data, process the data to check the data quality, and then upload the data to Amazon QuickSight dashboards. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to automatically check the data quality before the data is sent to QuickSight. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue Data Quality rules to check the data quality.
choices.B: Use an AWS Glue trigger to run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an AWS Glue job that loads the data into a PySpark DataFrame. Configure the job to apply custom functions and to evaluate the data quality.
choices.C: Run Python scripts on an AWS Lambda function every month to evaluate data quality. Configure the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function when objects are added to the S3 bucket.
choices.D: Configure the S3 bucket to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when objects are uploaded. Use Amazon CloudWatch insights every month for the SQS queue to evaluate the data quality.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to automatically check the data quality before the data is sent to QuickSight. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Glue Data Quality evaluates declarative rules on cataloged or ETL data, reducing custom validation code.

A. Run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue Data Quality rules to check the data quality. — Update the catalog for newly added partitions and schedule Data Quality rule evaluation before publishing dashboard inputs. Gate the downstream step on the rule results.

B. Use an AWS Glue trigger to run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an AWS Glue job that loads the data into a PySpark DataFrame. Configure the job to apply custom functions and to evaluate the data quality. — Custom PySpark validation can work, but requires more rule implementation and maintenance than the managed Data Quality feature.

C. Run Python scripts on an AWS Lambda function every month to evaluate data quality. Configure the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function when objects are added to the S3 bucket. — Custom Lambda validation must handle the compressed dataset and execution limits. The option also mixes per-object triggers with monthly processing without defining coordination.

D. Configure the S3 bucket to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when objects are uploaded. Use Amazon CloudWatch insights every month for the SQS queue to evaluate the data quality. — SQS notifications contain event metadata, not a queryable copy of every dataset value. CloudWatch log queries over those notifications cannot establish the data's quality.

options.B: Custom PySpark validation can work, but requires more rule implementation and maintenance than the managed Data Quality feature.
options.C: Custom Lambda validation must handle the compressed dataset and execution limits. The option also mixes per-object triggers with monthly processing without defining coordination.

text: A company has an ML model in Amazon SageMaker AI. An ML engineer needs to implement a monitoring solution to automatically detect changes in the input data distribution of model features. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a data quality baseline. Ensure that the emit_metrics option is enabled in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in specific metrics that are related to data quality.
choices.B: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a model quality baseline. Ensure that the comparison_method option is set to Robust in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in model quality metrics.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Debugger with custom rules to track shifts in feature distributions. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify the company when the rules detect significant changes.
choices.D: Use Amazon CloudWatch to directly observe the SageMaker AI endpoint’s performance metrics. Manually analyze the CloudWatch logs for indicators of data drift or shifts in feature distribution.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer needs to implement a monitoring solution to automatically detect changes in the input data distribution of model features. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Data-quality monitoring can compare current feature distributions with a reference baseline and emit metrics for CloudWatch alarms.

A. Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a data quality baseline. Ensure that the emit_metrics option is enabled in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in specific metrics that are related to data quality. — Create the data-quality baseline, enable emitted monitoring metrics, and alarm on the relevant violations. Schedule monitoring over captured production inputs so changes are detected automatically.

B. Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a model quality baseline. Ensure that the comparison_method option is set to Robust in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in model quality metrics. — Model-quality monitoring compares predictions with ground truth. It is not the baseline type for measuring input feature distribution drift.

C. Use SageMaker Debugger with custom rules to track shifts in feature distributions. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify the company when the rules detect significant changes. — Debugger targets training diagnostics. Implementing production feature-drift checks there is not the managed monitoring path.

D. Use Amazon CloudWatch to directly observe the SageMaker AI endpoint’s performance metrics. Manually analyze the CloudWatch logs for indicators of data drift or shifts in feature distribution. — Endpoint operational metrics measure latency, errors, and utilization. Manual log inspection does not provide the requested automatic distribution comparison.

text: A company is using Amazon SageMaker AI to deploy a new recommendation model for its ecommerce website. The model must use data from all client website interactions as input. Traffic is variable throughout the day. The company needs to create an inference endpoint for the model. Which type of inference endpoint will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

choices.A: Batch transform inference endpoint
choices.B: Asynchronous inference endpoint
choices.C: Real-time inference endpoint
choices.D: Serverless inference endpoint

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to create an inference endpoint for the model. Which type of inference endpoint will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: MOST cost-effective, MOST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: On-demand serverless inference adjusts serving resources to request traffic and can avoid paying for idle provisioned capacity, within its payload and runtime limits.

A. Batch transform inference endpoint — Batch transform is an offline job rather than an interactive recommendation endpoint.

B. Asynchronous inference endpoint — Asynchronous inference returns results later, making it a poor fit for immediate website recommendations unless the application explicitly tolerates that behavior.

C. Real-time inference endpoint — A real-time endpoint fits synchronous recommendations but normally carries provisioned capacity costs during quiet periods.

D. Serverless inference endpoint — Serverless inference is the intended fit for variable, compatible CPU workloads without a strict cold-start latency requirement. Verify payload, execution time, and traffic economics; variable traffic alone does not guarantee it is cheapest at every scale.

analysis.keyConcept: On-demand serverless inference adjusts serving resources to request traffic and can avoid paying for idle provisioned capacity, within its payload and runtime limits.

The column’s data consists of the following values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. choices.A: Binary encoding
choices.B: Label encoding
choices.C: One-hot encoding
choices.D: Tokenization

explanation:
Key Concept: One-hot encoding represents each weekday with its own 0/1 indicator, without imposing a numeric ordering between categories.

text: An ML engineer wants to use Amazon SageMaker AI to prepare data for training. During exploratory data analysis, the ML engineer notices that several categorical features are missing values. How can the ML engineer use SageMaker AI to solve this problem?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Clarify to impute categorical features with the mean value.
choices.B: Use SageMaker Clarity to impute categorical features with the mode value.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mean value.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mode value.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: During exploratory data analysis, the ML engineer notices that several categorical features are missing values. How can the ML engineer use SageMaker AI to solve this problem?

explanation:
Key Concept: The mode is the most frequent category and can be used to impute missing categorical values. Fit imputation rules on training data to avoid leakage.

A. Use SageMaker Clarify to impute categorical features with the mean value. — Clarify analyzes bias and explanations rather than serving as the data preparation tool, and a mean is not meaningful for unordered category labels.

B. Use SageMaker Clarity to impute categorical features with the mode value. — There is no SageMaker 'Clarity' data-imputation feature. Even interpreting this as Clarify, it is not the requested data transformation tool.

C. Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mean value. — Data Wrangler is the appropriate tool, but mean imputation is for numerical values rather than categorical labels.

D. Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mode value. — Configure Data Wrangler to replace missing categorical values with the training-set mode, while considering a distinct missing-value category if absence itself carries information.

text: A company stores user clickstream data in an Amazon S3 bucket in AWS Account A. The company needs to use the data to train an ML model in Amazon SageMaker AI in AWS Account B. The training will take 10 days. The company needs to use only private IP addresses in the training. The company also must make sure that no training metadata is shared with AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Set up VPC peering between Account A and Account B. Contact AWS by email to opt out of metadata collection.
choices.B: Set up a VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket. Set the SageMaker AI OPT_OUT_TRACKING environment variable to 1 in the training job.
choices.C: Configure a security group policy that is assigned to the S3 bucket in Account A to allow access from only Account B. Create AI services opt-out policies.
choices.D: Generate presigned URLs with expiration times for the objects that are stored in the S3 bucket. Access the data by using the presigned URLs. Set the SageMaker AI OPT_OUT_TRACKING environment variable to 1 in the training job.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company also must make sure that no training metadata is shared with AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Private S3 access and training telemetry opt-out are separate controls. Cross-account IAM, bucket, and any KMS permissions must also authorize the training role.

A. Set up VPC peering between Account A and Account B. Contact AWS by email to opt out of metadata collection. — VPC peering connects VPC networks but does not directly create private access to S3. The documented metadata opt-out is configured on job submission rather than requested by email.

B. Set up a VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket. Set the SageMaker AI OPT_OUT_TRACKING environment variable to 1 in the training job. — Use an S3 VPC endpoint and set OPT_OUT_TRACKING to '1' in the training job creation request. For a literal private-IP requirement, use an S3 interface endpoint with private DNS; a gateway endpoint keeps traffic on AWS but uses S3 service addresses.

C. Configure a security group policy that is assigned to the S3 bucket in Account A to allow access from only Account B. Create AI services opt-out policies. — S3 buckets do not have attached security groups. AI services opt-out policies are not a substitute for the SageMaker training metadata setting.

D. Generate presigned URLs with expiration times for the objects that are stored in the S3 bucket. Access the data by using the presigned URLs. Set the SageMaker AI OPT_OUT_TRACKING environment variable to 1 in the training job. — Presigned URLs authorize access but do not establish a private network path. Their expiration also must not be assumed to cover a ten-day training workflow.

options.B: Use an S3 VPC endpoint and set OPT_OUT_TRACKING to '1' in the training job creation request. For a literal private-IP requirement, use an S3 interface endpoint with private DNS; a gateway endpoint keeps traffic on AWS but uses S3 service addresses.
options.C: S3 buckets do not have attached security groups. AI services opt-out policies are not a substitute for the SageMaker training metadata setting.

text: A music streaming company constantly streams song ratings from an application to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use the ratings as an input for training and inference of an Amazon SageMaker AI model. The company has an AWS Glue Data Catalog that is configured with the S3 bucket as the source. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to create a repository for this data. The solution must ensure that the data stays synchronized during batch training and real-time inference. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Ingest data into SageMaker Feature Store from the S3 bucket. Apply tags and indexes.
choices.B: Use Amazon Athena. Create tables by using CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) queries to group data.
choices.C: Use AWS Lake Formation. Apply tag-based control on the data.
choices.D: Use the Generate Data Insights function in SageMaker Data Wrangler.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution must ensure that the data stays synchronized during batch training and real-time inference. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: real-time, batch
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Feature Store provides a shared feature definition and ingestion path for low-latency online values and historical offline training records.

A. Ingest data into SageMaker Feature Store from the S3 bucket. Apply tags and indexes. — Ingest the prepared rating features into a feature group with suitable online and offline stores and event times. Keep ingestion running as source data arrives; tags or indexes alone do not synchronize new records.

B. Use Amazon Athena. Create tables by using CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) queries to group data. — CTAS creates a query result table at a point in time. It does not automatically maintain fresh online serving features and historical feature versions.

C. Use AWS Lake Formation. Apply tag-based control on the data. — Lake Formation manages lake access and governance. Tag-based authorization is not a feature ingestion or synchronization mechanism.

D. Use the Generate Data Insights function in SageMaker Data Wrangler. — Data Insights assesses a dataset. It does not create a shared online/offline feature repository.

text: A company needs to ingest data from data sources into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. The data sources are Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, and Snowflake. The ingested data must always be up to date with the latest changes in the source systems. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use direct connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler.
choices.B: Use cataloged connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler.
choices.C: Use AWS Glue to extract data from the data sources. Use AWS Glue also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler.
choices.D: Use AWS Lambda to extract data from the data sources. Use Lambda also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ingested data must always be up to date with the latest changes in the source systems. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: Data Wrangler direct connections read from the source system, whereas cataloged transfers can reflect an earlier extracted copy.

A. Use direct connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler. — Use direct connections to import the latest source contents when the flow runs or data is reimported. The connection does not continuously mutate an already imported snapshot without a refresh or job execution.

B. Use cataloged connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler. — A cataloged connection can refer to the result of an earlier data transfer and therefore can lag behind the original source.

C. Use AWS Glue to extract data from the data sources. Use AWS Glue also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler. — A separate Glue extraction introduces another scheduled copy and freshness dependency instead of using the native source connection.

D. Use AWS Lambda to extract data from the data sources. Use Lambda also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler. — Custom Lambda extraction also adds code and a refresh pipeline, with no inherent guarantee that it stays synchronized.

text: An ML engineer is using Amazon SageMaker Canvas to build a custom ML model from an imported dataset. The ML engineer wants the model to make continuous numeric predictions based on 10 years of data. Which metric should the ML engineer use to evaluate the model’s performance?

choices.A: Accuracy
choices.B: InferenceLatency
choices.C: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)
choices.D: Root mean square error (RMSE)

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer wants the model to make continuous numeric predictions based on 10 years of data. Which metric should the ML engineer use to evaluate the model’s performance?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Continuous numerical predictions are evaluated with regression error metrics. RMSE expresses error in the target's units and penalizes large misses.

A. Accuracy — Accuracy counts correct class predictions. It is not the usual metric for continuous numerical error.

B. InferenceLatency — InferenceLatency measures response speed, not prediction quality.

C. Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) — ROC AUC evaluates ranking of positive versus negative classes, not continuous-value forecast or regression error.

D. Root mean square error (RMSE) — RMSE measures the magnitude of the model's numerical errors. Use a time-aware evaluation split when the ten years of data have temporal dependence.

text: A company has built, trained, and tuned two new ML models:• Model A detects if a transaction is fraudulent based on the IP address, location, and user credentials. This model will be accessed every time a transaction occurs.• Model B forecasts sales totals for the next month based on historical sales data. This model will be accessed one time each month. The company must deploy both models to production by using Amazon SageMaker AI. Which hosting solution for the models should the company use to meet these requirements?

choices.A: Host both models in one container behind one real-time endpoint.
choices.B: Host Model A with an asynchronous endpoint. Host Model B with a real-time endpoint.
choices.C: Host Model A with a real-time endpoint. Use batch transform for Model B.
choices.D: Use batch transform for Model A. Host Model B with an asynchronous endpoint.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company must deploy both models to production by using Amazon SageMaker AI. Which hosting solution for the models should the company use to meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Deployment should match each model's invocation pattern: immediate per-transaction scoring versus infrequent offline forecasting.

A. Host both models in one container behind one real-time endpoint. — A combined always-running endpoint pays to host the monthly model continuously and couples two different serving workloads.

B. Host Model A with an asynchronous endpoint. Host Model B with a real-time endpoint. — This reverses the natural fit: queued fraud results delay a transaction decision, while a monthly forecast does not need continuously provisioned serving.

C. Host Model A with a real-time endpoint. Use batch transform for Model B. — Serve fraud predictions synchronously through a real-time endpoint. Run the monthly sales forecast with batch transform and store its results for downstream use.

D. Use batch transform for Model A. Host Model B with an asynchronous endpoint. — Batch fraud scoring cannot answer each transaction immediately. An asynchronous forecast endpoint is possible, but adds endpoint workflow management for an infrequent batch need.

options.B: This reverses the natural fit: queued fraud results delay a transaction decision, while a monthly forecast does not need continuously provisioned serving.

text: A bank needs to use Amazon SageMaker AI to create an ML model to determine which customers qualify for a new product. The bank must use algorithms that SageMaker AI directly supports. The model must be explainable to the bank’s regulators. Which modeling approach will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Train the model by using the Object2Vec algorithm.
choices.B: Train the model by using the linear learner algorithm.
choices.C: Train a neural network.
choices.D: Train the model by using the k-means algorithm.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The model must be explainable to the bank’s regulators. Which modeling approach will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: Linear models expose coefficients that connect input features to a score, supporting explanation when features and preprocessing are well defined.

A. Train the model by using the Object2Vec algorithm. — Object2Vec learns dense representations and is less directly interpretable than a linear decision function for this tabular eligibility task.

B. Train the model by using the linear learner algorithm. — Linear Learner supports supervised classification with an interpretable linear score. Document feature encoding, scaling, coefficients, and validation to support regulatory review.

C. Train a neural network. — A neural network can model complex relationships, but its internal representation is generally harder to explain directly than a linear model.

D. Train the model by using the k-means algorithm. — K-means produces unsupervised clusters, not a supervised eligibility prediction tied to the bank's target labels.

The company needs to increase the data quality and detect any statistical bias in the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use SageMaker Clarify to create data quality rules. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to detect bias.
choices.B: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to create data quality rules. Use SageMaker Clarify to detect bias.
choices.C: Use SageMaker Debugger to create data quality rules. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to detect bias.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Model Monitor to create data quality rules. Use SageMaker Clarify to detect bias.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to increase the data quality and detect any statistical bias in the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: Data preparation resolves duplicates and missing values. Bias analysis separately measures representation and label disparities across defined groups.

A. Use SageMaker Clarify to create data quality rules. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to detect bias. — Clarify is not the main deduplication and imputation tool. Model Monitor's production monitoring role does not replace initial data preparation.

B. Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to create data quality rules. choices.B: Keep the outliers and perform normalization on the Square Meters variable.

explanation:
Key Concept: Preprocessing for a defined target population can exclude observations outside that scope and transform a positive skewed size feature. Price must be the prediction target, not an input that leaks the answer.

A. Remove the outliers and perform a log transformation on the Square Meters variable. — For a model explicitly limited to typical properties, validate and exclude the out-of-scope size extremes, then consider a log transform for positive Square Meters values. An ML engineer has configured SageMaker Model Monitor to run as part of a SageMaker AI pipeline. In the MonitoringExecution output, the ML engineer observes several baseline_drift_check violations that are failing the pipeline. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this issue?

choices.A: Retrain the model by using a new SageMaker AI training job. Check for errors by using SageMaker Debugger.
choices.B: Retrain the model with new training data. Reuse the original baseline in Model Monitor.
choices.C: Retrain the model with new training data. Use the new baseline in Model Monitor.
choices.D: Rerun the SageMaker AI pipeline after enabling the emit_metrics option in the baseline constraints file.

explanation:
Key Concept: A baseline drift violation requires investigation. Replacing a baseline is justified only after confirming that the new data represents an intended, valid population change.

A. Retrain the model by using a new SageMaker AI training job. Check for errors by using SageMaker Debugger. — Retraining and checking training errors do not identify whether the production data is corrupt, incorrectly transformed, or legitimately different.

B. Retrain the model with new training data. Reuse the original baseline in Model Monitor. — Keeping the old baseline is appropriate if it still defines valid data, but retraining alone will not remove an input distribution violation.

C. Retrain the model with new training data. Use the new baseline in Model Monitor. — This is appropriate only after validating the new distribution and the retrained model. D. Rerun the SageMaker AI pipeline after enabling the emit_metrics option in the baseline constraints file. — emit_metrics enables metric publication. It does not repair the data or change the constraints that produced the violations.

text: A company uses ML models to predict whether transactions are fraudulent. The company needs to identify as many fraudulent transactions as possible. Which evaluation metric should the company use to evaluate the models to meet this requirement?

choices.A: F1 score
choices.B: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)
choices.C: Precision
choices.D: Recall

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to identify as many fraudulent transactions as possible. Which evaluation metric should the company use to evaluate the models to meet this requirement?

explanation:
Key Concept: Recall measures the fraction of actual positive cases that are detected. Here, the positive class is fraud.

A. F1 score — F1 balances precision and recall. The stated priority is specifically to miss as few fraudulent transactions as possible.

B. Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) — ROC AUC evaluates ranking across thresholds. It does not directly report the fraction of fraud detected at the deployed threshold.

C. Precision — Precision measures how many flagged transactions are actually fraudulent. High precision can coexist with many missed fraud cases.

D. Recall — Recall = true positives / (true positives + false negatives). Maximizing it directly targets catching the largest fraction of fraud, while separately monitoring the false-positive burden.

text: An ML engineer has trained an ML model by using Amazon SageMaker AI. The ML engineer determines that the model is overfitting and that the training data contains unnecessary features. The ML engineer must reduce the overfitting and the impact of the unnecessary features. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Increase the number of training iterations. Retrain the model.
choices.B: Apply L1 regularization to the training data. Retrain the model.
choices.C: Decrease the number of training iterations. Retrain the model.
choices.D: Use SageMaker Debugger to apply L1 regularization to the running model.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must reduce the overfitting and the impact of the unnecessary features. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: L1 regularization penalizes the absolute values of model coefficients and can drive some coefficients to zero, reducing reliance on unnecessary features.

A. Increase the number of training iterations. Retrain the model. — Additional iterations can fit training noise more closely and worsen overfitting.

B. Apply L1 regularization to the training data. Retrain the model. — Add an L1 penalty to the model's training objective and retrain. The penalty applies to model parameters, rather than being a transformation of the raw training data.

C. Decrease the number of training iterations. Retrain the model. — Fewer iterations can limit overtraining, but do not specifically encourage sparse coefficients or remove irrelevant feature effects.

D. Use SageMaker Debugger to apply L1 regularization to the running model. — Debugger diagnoses training behavior. It does not retrofit L1 regularization into a running model's optimization objective.

choices.B: Perform similarity encoding to represent categories of the feature.

explanation:
Key Concept: Similarity encoding maps similar category strings to similar low-dimensional representations, helping with high-cardinality categories that contain spelling noise.

A. Perform ordinal encoding to represent categories of the feature. — Ordinal encoding assigns arbitrary ordered numbers to these names and does not make spelling variants semantically close.

B. Perform similarity encoding to represent categories of the feature. — Data Wrangler similarity encoding uses string similarity to keep variants such as a correctly spelled name and a typo close in the encoded space.

D. Perform target encoding to represent categories of the feature. — Target encoding summarizes labels by category. It does not inherently merge spelling variants and requires careful leakage control.

text: An ML engineer is training a text generation model on Amazon SageMaker AI. After several epochs, the loss function does not converge, and the model’s accuracy on the validation dataset starts to show oscillating results. The ML engineer needs to ensure that the model achieves generalization. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Increase the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size.
choices.B: Increase the learning rate as the number of epochs increases.
choices.C: Decrease the learning rate and increase the mini-batch size.
choices.D: Decrease the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer needs to ensure that the model achieves generalization. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.

explanation:
Key Concept: An excessive learning rate and noisy gradient estimates can cause unstable optimization. Smaller updates and a larger mini-batch can stabilize the training trajectory.

A. Increase the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size. — Increasing the learning rate enlarges updates, while smaller batches usually increase gradient noise. Both can worsen oscillation.

B. Increase the learning rate as the number of epochs increases. — Raising the learning rate over time can make an already unstable optimizer overshoot further.

C. Decrease the learning rate and increase the mini-batch size. — Lower the learning rate and increase the mini-batch size within memory limits to reduce update magnitude and gradient noise. Validate generalization separately; stable convergence alone does not guarantee it.

D. Decrease the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size. — Lowering the learning rate may help, but reducing the batch size adds gradient noise and is less targeted to the observed oscillation than C.

A. Configure an AWS Glue DataBrew project that connects to the data. Use the DataBrew interactive interface to create a recipe that performs the one-hot encoding transformation. Create a job to apply the transformation and to write the output back to an S3 bucket. — Create the one-hot encoding recipe visually and run a recipe job over the Parquet dataset. Write to a separate output prefix in the same bucket to avoid mixing source and transformed records.

B. Configure an AWS Glue Data Catalog table that points to the data. Use Amazon Athena to write SQL commands to perform the one-hot encoding transformation. Configure Athena to write the query results back to an S3 bucket. — Athena can express transformations in SQL, but authoring SQL does not meet the no-code requirement.

C. Configure an AWS Glue Data Catalog table that points to the data. Create an AWS Glue ETL interactive notebook. Use the notebook to perform the one-hot encoding transformation. Run the configured cells and write the results back to an S3 bucket. — An interactive Glue notebook requires code to define and execute the transformation.

D. Configure an Amazon Redshift cluster to access the data by using Redshift Spectrum. Use SQL commands to perform the one-hot encoding transformation within Amazon Redshift. Configure Amazon Redshift to write the results back to an S3 bucket. — Redshift adds a database setup and SQL implementation when a visual managed transformation is sufficient.
notes: DataBrew ONE_HOT_ENCODING supports at most ten distinct values per source column. Validate the column cardinality before applying the recipe.

text: A company wants to migrate ML models from an on-premises environment to Amazon SageMaker AI. The models are based on the PyTorch algorithm. The company needs to reuse its existing custom scripts as much as possible on AWS. Which feature of SageMaker AI should the company use to meet these requirements?

choices.A: SageMaker AI built-in algorithms
choices.B: SageMaker Canvas
choices.C: SageMaker JumpStart
choices.D: SageMaker AI script mode

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to reuse its existing custom scripts as much as possible on AWS. Which feature of SageMaker AI should the company use to meet these requirements?

explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker script mode runs user-provided training scripts inside supported framework containers, preserving much of an existing framework workflow.

A. SageMaker AI built-in algorithms — Built-in algorithms replace the training implementation with predefined algorithms rather than running the company's custom PyTorch script.

B. SageMaker Canvas — Canvas offers a visual model-building workflow but is not the direct path for reusing arbitrary existing PyTorch training scripts.

C. SageMaker JumpStart — JumpStart accelerates deployment and customization of supported models and solutions. It does not primarily provide execution of the company's existing custom training code.

D. SageMaker AI script mode — Use the PyTorch framework container with script mode and adapt data paths, arguments, and model output locations as needed. This minimizes changes to the existing code.

text: A company uses an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to track the sale prices of sneakers over time. The dashboard aggregates sale prices scraped from many retail websites. The company wants to determine which prices are unusually high outliers and to display the outliers visually. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to take the square roots of the outlier prices to generate the chart. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to scan the data for anomalies.
choices.B: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to preprocess the data. Set the REMOVE_OUTLIERS operation to eliminate data rows that include unusually high prices. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to store the removed rows in Amazon DynamoDB.
choices.C: Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to square the outlier prices to generate the chart. Use QuickSight anomaly detection insights to determine which prices are unusually high.
choices.D: Use a QuickSight filter to find the lowest 10 values for sneaker price. Assign a specific color to the 10 lowest values.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company wants to determine which prices are unusually high outliers and to display the outliers visually. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: QuickSight anomaly detection identifies unexpected deviations in time-series measures. A display transformation can emphasize large positive values but is not the detector itself.

A. Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to take the square roots of the outlier prices to generate the chart. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to scan the data for anomalies. — A square-root transform compresses large positive differences, and a custom Lambda detector adds unnecessary implementation effort.

B. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to preprocess the data. Set the REMOVE_OUTLIERS operation to eliminate data rows that include unusually high prices. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to store the removed rows in Amazon DynamoDB. — Removing outliers from the data does not display them in the existing dashboard. Writing removed rows to DynamoDB creates a separate workflow.

C. Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to square the outlier prices to generate the chart. Use QuickSight anomaly detection insights to determine which prices are unusually high. — Use QuickSight anomaly insights to identify unexpectedly high prices and display the flagged observations. Squaring positive prices can exaggerate visual differences, but is optional and changes the displayed units; label the chart accordingly.

D. Use a QuickSight filter to find the lowest 10 values for sneaker price. Assign a specific color to the 10 lowest values. — Selecting the ten lowest prices addresses the opposite tail and does not identify unexpectedly high values.

analysis.keyConcept: QuickSight anomaly detection identifies unexpected deviations in time-series measures. A display transformation can emphasize large positive values but is not the detector itself.

options.A: A square-root transform compresses large positive differences, and a custom Lambda detector adds unnecessary implementation effort.
options.B: Removing outliers from the data does not display them in the existing dashboard. Writing removed rows to DynamoDB creates a separate workflow.
options.C: Use QuickSight anomaly insights to identify unexpectedly high prices and display the flagged observations. Squaring positive prices can exaggerate visual differences, but is optional and changes the displayed units; label the chart accordingly.
options.D: Selecting the ten lowest prices addresses the opposite tail and does not identify unexpectedly high values.

text: An ML engineer is using Amazon QuickSight anomaly detection to detect very high or very low machine operating temperatures compared to normal. The ML engineer sets the Severity parameter to Low and above. The ML engineer sets the Direction parameter to All. What effect will the ML engineer observe in the anomaly detection results if the ML engineer changes the Direction parameter to Lower than expected?

choices.A: Increased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall
choices.B: Decreased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall
choices.C: Increased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall
choices.D: Decreased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer sets the Direction parameter to All. What effect will the ML engineer observe in the anomaly detection results if the ML engineer changes the Direction parameter to Lower than expected?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Changing anomaly direction filters which tail is reported. Restricting alerts to low temperatures removes high-temperature anomalies from the results.

A. Increased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall — The narrower direction cannot increase the set of reported anomalies under the same severity setting, and it omits true high-temperature events.

B. Decreased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall — Fewer anomalies are reported, and recall across both high and low abnormal temperatures decreases when true high-temperature anomalies are excluded. If no high anomalies occur, the measured counts may remain unchanged.

C. Increased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall — Recall may decrease, but the reporting frequency does not increase merely by filtering out the upper tail.

D. Decreased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall — Frequency can decrease, but recall over the original two-sided target cannot improve by discarding detected high-temperature cases.

analysis.keyConcept: Changing anomaly direction filters which tail is reported. Restricting alerts to low temperatures removes high-temperature anomalies from the results.

options.A: The narrower direction cannot increase the set of reported anomalies under the same severity setting, and it omits true high-temperature events.
options.B: Fewer anomalies are reported, and recall across both high and low abnormal temperatures decreases when true high-temperature anomalies are excluded. If no high anomalies occur, the measured counts may remain unchanged.
options.C: Recall may decrease, but the reporting frequency does not increase merely by filtering out the upper tail.
options.D: Frequency can decrease, but recall over the original two-sided target cannot improve by discarding detected high-temperature cases.

text: A company runs its ML workflows on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. The ML workflows include ML services that perform training and inferences for ML models. Each ML service runs from its own standalone Docker image. The company needs to perform a lift and shift from the on-premises Kubernetes cluster to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.A: Redesign the ML services to be configured in Kubeflow. Deploy the new Kubeflow managed ML services to the EKS cluster.
choices.B: Upload the Docker images to an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Configure a deployment pipeline to deploy the images to the EKS cluster.
choices.C: Migrate the training data to an Amazon Redshift cluster. Retrain the models from the migrated training data by using Amazon Redshift ML. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster.
choices.D: Configure an Amazon SageMaker AI notebook. Retrain the models with the same code. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company needs to perform a lift and shift from the on-premises Kubernetes cluster to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: LEAST operational overhead, LEAST
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Container images and Kubernetes workload definitions can be moved to EKS without redesigning the underlying ML services.

A. Redesign the ML services to be configured in Kubeflow. Deploy the new Kubeflow managed ML services to the EKS cluster. — Rewriting services for Kubeflow is a platform redesign rather than a minimal lift and shift.

B. Upload the Docker images to an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Configure a deployment pipeline to deploy the images to the EKS cluster. — Push the existing images to ECR and adapt the Kubernetes deployment pipeline for EKS, including IAM, storage, networking, and secrets. The existing service packaging can remain largely intact.

C. Migrate the training data to an Amazon Redshift cluster. Retrain the models from the migrated training data by using Amazon Redshift ML. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster. — Redshift ML changes the training platform and requires data migration and retraining that the requested cluster migration does not need.

D. Configure an Amazon SageMaker AI notebook. Retrain the models with the same code. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster. — Retraining through notebooks is unnecessary for moving already packaged training and inference services to EKS.

analysis.keyConcept: Container images and Kubernetes workload definitions can be moved to EKS without redesigning the underlying ML services.

options.A: Rewriting services for Kubeflow is a platform redesign rather than a minimal lift and shift.
options.B: Push the existing images to ECR and adapt the Kubernetes deployment pipeline for EKS, including IAM, storage, networking, and secrets. The existing service packaging can remain largely intact.
options.C: Redshift ML changes the training platform and requires data migration and retraining that the requested cluster migration does not need.
options.D: Retraining through notebooks is unnecessary for moving already packaged training and inference services to EKS.

text: A retail company is creating an AI-powered assistant for customers. The company has a large body of documentation that the assistant needs to use for general inquiries. The company wants any responses about prices to use only documentation that is less than 1 month old. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Amazon Q Business to develop the responses. Configure a document attribute filter so that responses about prices use only the documents from the past month.
choices.B: Use Amazon Q Business to develop the responses. Configure the source attribution citation so that responses about prices use only the documents from the past month.
choices.C: Segment the documents into folders based on the month of document creation. Configure Amazon Q Developer to use only the documents from the past month to develop responses about prices.
choices.D: Segment the documents into folders based on the month of document creation. Grant the assistant access to only the documents from the past month for responses about prices. Use Amazon Q Developer to develop the responses.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The company wants any responses about prices to use only documentation that is less than 1 month old. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Document metadata filters constrain retrieval before answer generation, allowing freshness rules for a selected category of questions.

A. Use Amazon Q Business to develop the responses. Configure a document attribute filter so that responses about prices use only the documents from the past month. — Index the relevant document date and apply a last-month attribute filter when handling price questions. Keep broader retrieval for general questions and ensure the filter is enforced by the application.

B. Use Amazon Q Business to develop the responses. Configure the source attribution citation so that responses about prices use only the documents from the past month. — Source citations identify supporting documents after retrieval; they do not by themselves exclude outdated documents.

C. Segment the documents into folders based on the month of document creation. Configure Amazon Q Developer to use only the documents from the past month to develop responses about prices. — Q Developer is oriented toward software development, and folder organization alone does not implement the required customer-document retrieval rule.

D. Segment the documents into folders based on the month of document creation. Grant the assistant access to only the documents from the past month for responses about prices. Use Amazon Q Developer to develop the responses. — Manual folder permissions are a coarse access control and Q Developer is not the intended business knowledge assistant. This is less direct than a query-specific date filter.

analysis.keyConcept: Document metadata filters constrain retrieval before answer generation, allowing freshness rules for a selected category of questions.

options.A: Index the relevant document date and apply a last-month attribute filter when handling price questions. Keep broader retrieval for general questions and ensure the filter is enforced by the application.
options.B: Source citations identify supporting documents after retrieval; they do not by themselves exclude outdated documents.
options.C: Q Developer is oriented toward software development, and folder organization alone does not implement the required customer-document retrieval rule.
options.D: Manual folder permissions are a coarse access control and Q Developer is not the intended business knowledge assistant. This is less direct than a query-specific date filter.

text: A travel company wants to create an ML model to recommend the next airport destination for its users. The company has collected millions of data records about user location, recent search history on the company’s website, and 2,000 available airports. The data has several categorical features with a target column that is expected to have a high-dimensional sparse matrix. The company needs to use Amazon SageMaker AI built-in algorithms for the model. An ML engineer converts the categorical features by using one-hot encoding. Which algorithm should the ML engineer implement to meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use the CatBoost algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.
choices.B: Use the DeepAR forecasting algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.
choices.C: Use the Factorization Machines algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.
choices.D: Use the k-means algorithm to cluster users into groups. Map each group to the next airport destination based on user search history.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: An ML engineer converts the categorical features by using one-hot encoding. Which algorithm should the ML engineer implement to meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Sparse recommendation features suit Factorization Machines when the target is a binary interaction or a numeric preference score. A direct airport identifier target is a different multiclass problem.

A. Use the CatBoost algorithm to recommend the next airport destination. — CatBoost is a supported tabular algorithm and can handle multiclass labels. It cannot be dismissed merely because the input has categorical features; the appropriate choice depends on the target formulation.

B. Use the DeepAR forecasting algorithm to recommend the next airport destination. — DeepAR forecasts numerical time series. It does not directly predict one airport among thousands of categorical destinations.

C. Use the Factorization Machines algorithm to recommend the next airport destination. — This is appropriate after constructing user-airport pairs and learning interaction scores, then ranking airports. SageMaker Factorization Machines does not directly support a 2,000-class airport target, so the source answer needs this missing reformulation.

D. Use the k-means algorithm to cluster users into groups. Map each group to the next airport destination based on user search history. — Clustering can group users but does not learn the supervised next-airport target directly. Mapping clusters to destinations requires additional logic and loses individualized ranking information.
notes: Source selects C. SageMaker Factorization Machines supports binary classification or regression, not a direct 2,000-class target. C requires reformulating the task as scoring user-airport pairs.

analysis.keyConcept: Sparse recommendation features suit Factorization Machines when the target is a binary interaction or a numeric preference score. A direct airport identifier target is a different multiclass problem.

options.A: CatBoost is a supported tabular algorithm and can handle multiclass labels. It cannot be dismissed merely because the input has categorical features; the appropriate choice depends on the target formulation.
options.B: DeepAR forecasts numerical time series. It does not directly predict one airport among thousands of categorical destinations.
options.C: This is appropriate after constructing user-airport pairs and learning interaction scores, then ranking airports. SageMaker Factorization Machines does not directly support a 2,000-class airport target, so the source answer needs this missing reformulation.
options.D: Clustering can group users but does not learn the supervised next-airport target directly. Mapping clusters to destinations requires additional logic and loses individualized ranking information.

text: An ML engineer is configuring auto scaling for an inference component of a model that runs behind an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. The ML engineer configures SageMaker AI auto scaling with a target tracking scaling policy set to 100 invocations per model per minute. The SageMaker AI endpoint scales appropriately during normal business hours. However, the ML engineer notices that at the start of each business day, there are zero instances available to handle requests, which causes delays in processing. The ML engineer must ensure that the SageMaker AI endpoint can handle incoming requests at the start of each business day. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Reduce the SageMaker AI auto scaling cooldown period to the minimum supported value. Add an auto scaling lifecycle hook to scale the SageMaker AI instances.
choices.B: Change the target metric to CPU utilization.
choices.C: Modify the scaling policy target value to one.
choices.D: Apply a step scaling policy that scales based on an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Apply a second CloudWatch alarm and scaling policy to scale the minimum number of instances from zero to one at the start of each business day.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must ensure that the SageMaker AI endpoint can handle incoming requests at the start of each business day. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Scaling from zero is reactive unless capacity is scheduled in advance. Provisioning an instance after a failed invocation still causes startup delay.

A. Reduce the SageMaker AI auto scaling cooldown period to the minimum supported value. Add an auto scaling lifecycle hook to scale the SageMaker AI instances. — A shorter cooldown does not create capacity before a request arrives. EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks are not the control mechanism for SageMaker inference component copies.

B. Change the target metric to CPU utilization. — With zero instances, there is no running instance CPU utilization to trigger the desired proactive capacity change.

C. Modify the scaling policy target value to one. — Lowering the per-copy request target does not provide an advance signal while no copies are running.

D. Apply a step scaling policy that scales based on an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Apply a second CloudWatch alarm and scaling policy to scale the minimum number of instances from zero to one at the start of each business day. — A no-capacity alarm and step policy can recover from zero, but cannot guarantee a ready endpoint at the start of the day. Use scheduled scaling before business hours or a nonzero minimum; an alarm does not itself schedule a minimum-capacity change.
notes: Source selects D. Reactive step scaling begins after capacity failures and still takes minutes. Scheduled prewarming or a nonzero minimum is needed for readiness at the start of the day.

analysis.keyConcept: Scaling from zero is reactive unless capacity is scheduled in advance. Provisioning an instance after a failed invocation still causes startup delay.

options.A: A shorter cooldown does not create capacity before a request arrives. EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks are not the control mechanism for SageMaker inference component copies.
options.B: With zero instances, there is no running instance CPU utilization to trigger the desired proactive capacity change.
options.C: Lowering the per-copy request target does not provide an advance signal while no copies are running.
options.D: A no-capacity alarm and step policy can recover from zero, but cannot guarantee a ready endpoint at the start of the day. Use scheduled scaling before business hours or a nonzero minimum; an alarm does not itself schedule a minimum-capacity change.

text: An ML engineer is using an Amazon SageMaker Studio notebook to train a neural network by creating an estimator. The estimator runs a Python training script that uses Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) on a single instance that has more than one GPU. The ML engineer discovers that the training script is underutilizing GPU resources. The ML engineer must identify the point in the training script where resource utilization can be optimized. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to create a report that describes GPU utilization over time.
choices.B: Add SageMaker Profiler annotations to the training script. Run the script and generate a report from the results.
choices.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to create a report that describes GPU utilization and GPU memory utilization over time.
choices.D: Create a default monitor in Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor and suggest a baseline. Generate a report based on the constraints and statistics the monitor generates.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer must identify the point in the training script where resource utilization can be optimized. Which solution will meet this requirement?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Detailed profiling correlates CPU/GPU work with labeled regions of training code, helping identify compute, communication, and input bottlenecks.

A. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to create a report that describes GPU utilization over time. — Aggregate GPU metrics show underutilization over time but do not precisely attribute it to a section of the training script.

B. Add SageMaker Profiler annotations to the training script. Run the script and generate a report from the results. — Add Profiler annotations around relevant training regions and inspect the resulting timeline/report to locate GPU idle time or communication bottlenecks. Use a supported Profiler environment and check its service lifecycle.

C. Use AWS CloudTrail to create a report that describes GPU utilization and GPU memory utilization over time. — CloudTrail records API calls. It does not capture a GPU execution timeline or GPU memory utilization profile.

D. Create a default monitor in Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor and suggest a baseline. Generate a report based on the constraints and statistics the monitor generates. — Model Monitor compares production data or predictions with baselines. It does not profile DDP training code.

sources.title: AWS — Training CPU and GPU profiling

notes: AWS has announced the end of SageMaker Profiler support on June 30, 2027. The profiling concept remains valid; check the service lifecycle for implementation.

analysis.keyConcept: Detailed profiling correlates CPU/GPU work with labeled regions of training code, helping identify compute, communication, and input bottlenecks.

options.A: Aggregate GPU metrics show underutilization over time but do not precisely attribute it to a section of the training script.
options.B: Add Profiler annotations around relevant training regions and inspect the resulting timeline/report to locate GPU idle time or communication bottlenecks. Use a supported Profiler environment and check its service lifecycle.
options.C: CloudTrail records API calls. It does not capture a GPU execution timeline or GPU memory utilization profile.
options.D: Model Monitor compares production data or predictions with baselines. It does not profile DDP training code.

text: An ML engineer at an insurance company trains a regression model to predict the number of insurance policy sales each month. After training the model, the ML engineer uses Amazon SageMaker AI to deploy the model for inference. The ML engineer wants to monitor the model predictions to detect whether the production data distribution differs from the training data distribution when there are changes in customer behaviors. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.A: Determine whether there is drift in the data quality.
choices.B: Determine whether there is drift in the model quality.
choices.C: Determine whether there is drift in the model bias.
choices.D: Determine whether there is drift in the feature attribution.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The ML engineer wants to monitor the model predictions to detect whether the production data distribution differs from the training data distribution when there are changes in customer behaviors. Which solution will meet these requirements?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: Data quality drift includes changes in production input distributions relative to a training reference. Predictive quality and attribution drift are separate monitoring targets.

A. Determine whether there is drift in the data quality. — Compare current feature statistics and distributions with the training-data baseline to detect the customer-behavior distribution changes described.

B. Determine whether there is drift in the model quality. — Model quality drift measures prediction performance against actual outcomes. It requires ground truth and answers a different question from input distribution change.

C. Determine whether there is drift in the model bias. — Bias drift compares disparities across configured groups. It does not cover all input distribution changes.

D. Determine whether there is drift in the feature attribution. — Attribution drift concerns changes in feature importance for predictions, which can differ from changes in the raw feature distributions.

text: A healthcare company uses an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint to host a model that predicts patient readmission risk to hospitals. The company wants to predict patient readmissions with high accuracy and is willing to tolerate false positives. The current model performance has degraded over the previous year. The company trains and deploys a new model as a shadow variant for testing on live traffic from hospitals. The company monitors the performance of the new model for a month. During the month of testing, the shadow variant has a higher recall than the existing model but has a lower precision. What should the company do next?

choices.A: Promote the shadow variant to full production.
choices.B: Extend the shadow testing period to capture more data. Monitor the new model to determine whether precision improves.
choices.C: Use a blue/green deployment strategy to allocate a small percentage of traffic to the shadow variant to reduce model errors.
choices.D: Disable the shadow variant and roll back to the main variant.

hint:
- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: During the month of testing, the shadow variant has a higher recall than the existing model but has a lower precision. What should the company do next?
- Keyword/constraint nên gạch chân: mục tiêu cuối cùng, loại workload, yêu cầu latency/cost/operational effort và phạm vi dữ liệu.
- Cách loại trừ: Xác định dịch vụ hoặc tính năng được AWS thiết kế trực tiếp cho requirement; sau đó loại phương án chỉ technically possible nhưng tăng vận hành, chi phí hoặc không giải quyết đúng mục tiêu.
explanation:
Key Concept: When missing a positive case is more costly than a false alert, recall receives greater emphasis than precision, subject to agreed validation and operational limits.

A. Promote the shadow variant to full production. — The higher recall aligns with the stated tolerance for false positives. Promote the candidate after confirming its absolute acceptance thresholds, subgroup results, and operational readiness, then continue monitoring.

B. Extend the shadow testing period to capture more data. Monitor the new model to determine whether precision improves. — Collecting more data can improve confidence, but waiting alone does not cause a fixed model's precision to improve and does not address the stated preference for recall.

C. Use a blue/green deployment strategy to allocate a small percentage of traffic to the shadow variant to reduce model errors. — A gradual rollout can limit exposure during deployment, but traffic allocation does not intrinsically reduce the model's prediction errors or resolve the metric tradeoff.

D. Disable the shadow variant and roll back to the main variant. — Rejecting the candidate solely for lower precision ignores the explicit priority of detecting more readmissions while accepting false positives.

text: An airline company uses an ML model to adjust ticket prices based on demand. The model runs on Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoints. During previous deployments, the model failed to scale quickly enough when website traffic increased, which caused delays in price adjustments. An ML engineer needs to configure auto scaling for the SageMaker endpoints to respond rapidly to traffic changes. The solution must use target tracking scaling policies. Which configuration will be MOST responsive to sudden changes in traffic?

choices.A: Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker AI InvocationsPerInstance standard metric. Configure 10-second interval resolution, and set the default 300-second scale-in cooldown period.
choices.B: Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker AI InvocationsPerInstance metric. Configure high-resolution 10-second intervals, and set a 600-second scale-in cooldown period.
choices.C: Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker InvocationsPerInstance standard metric. Configure 10-second intervals resolution, and set a 600-second scale-in cooldown period.
choices.D: Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker InvocationsPerInstance metric. Configure high-resolution 10-second intervals, and set the default 300-second scale-in cooldown period.

- Bài toán thực sự đang hỏi: The solution must use target tracking scaling policies. Which configuration will be MOST responsive to sudden changes in traffic?

explanation:
Key Concept: SageMaker's predefined high-resolution scaling metrics are ConcurrentRequestsPerModel and ConcurrentRequestsPerCopy. InvocationsPerInstance is a standard one-minute metric.

A. Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker AI InvocationsPerInstance standard metric. Configure 10-second interval resolution, and set the default 300-second scale-in cooldown period. — Configuring a ten-second evaluation does not make the standard InvocationsPerInstance metric publish ten-second data.

B. Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker AI InvocationsPerInstance metric. Configure high-resolution 10-second intervals, and set a 600-second scale-in cooldown period. — This incorrectly calls InvocationsPerInstance a high-resolution metric. A longer scale-in cooldown also does not accelerate scale-out for a traffic spike.

C. Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker InvocationsPerInstance standard metric. Configure 10-second intervals resolution, and set a 600-second scale-in cooldown period. — The standard metric still has one-minute publication, and the scale-in cooldown governs capacity removal rather than reaction speed to increasing traffic.

D. Configure auto scaling based on the SageMaker InvocationsPerInstance metric. Configure high-resolution 10-second intervals, and set the default 300-second scale-in cooldown period. — This is the source answer, but it names the wrong metric. Use the supported high-resolution concurrent-request metric for ten-second publication; none of the options states that configuration correctly.
